en: And if they had been entered upon from all its [surrounding] regions and fitnah [i.e., disbelief] had been demanded of them, they would have done it and not hesitated over it except briefly.
gloss: [cond: IF ENEMY ENTER CITY EVERY SIDE , ASK THEM FITNAH] , THEY DO , NOT WAIT , ONLY LITTLE .

en: He who has settled us in the home of duration [i.e., Paradise] out of His bounty. There touches us not in it any fatigue, and there touches us not in it weariness [of mind]."
gloss: [rs-b: [happy: IX SETTLED US HOME FOREVER , IX FAVOR . TIRED NONE , WEAK NONE]] .

en: It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished.
gloss: ONLY ONE SHOUT , THEY DIE , GONE .

en: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -
gloss: [happy: PEOPLE PARADISE TODAY , BUSY ENJOY] ,

en: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary?
gloss: [rhq: PERSON NOT SEE , ALLAH CREATE IX FROM SEED] ? NOW IX ARGUE CLEAR .

en: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,
gloss: THEY NOT LISTEN HIGHEST GROUP , THROW AT THEM EVERY SIDE ,

en: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."
gloss: SAY , [rs-a: YES , YOU HUMILIATE] .

en: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.
gloss: [neg: HEADACHE NONE , DRUNK NONE] .

en: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth].
gloss: [rs-a: ONE SAY , BEFORE ME HAVE FRIEND] ,

en: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.
gloss: FOR THIS , LET WORK PEOPLE WORK .

en: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]
gloss: IX CHILD+ REMAIN .

en: And he drew lots and was among the losers.
gloss: CHOOSE BY LUCK , IX LOSE .

en: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,
gloss: [aff: THEIR LIE , THEY SAY] ,

en: "If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,
gloss: [rs-b: [cond: IF WE HAVE REMINDER FROM PEOPLE BEFORE]] ,

en: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers [i.e., the believers] will be those who overcome.
gloss: OUR ARMY WIN .

en: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.
gloss: WATCH THEM , LATER THEY SEE .

en: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.
gloss: AFTERNOON , SHOW IX HORSE BEAUTIFUL STAND .

en: Or am I [not] better than this one [i.e., Moses] who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?
gloss: [rs-b: ME BETTER THAN THIS PERSON LOW , CAN NOT TALK CLEAR] ?

en: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.
gloss: FROM PHARAOH . IX HIGH , EXCEED .

en: And admit them to Paradise, which He has made known to them.
gloss: ENTER GARDEN , IX TELL THEM .

en: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allāh].
gloss: LESSON , REMINDER FOR SERVANT RETURN .

en: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.
gloss: DEATH SHOCK COME WITH TRUE . [rs-c: THIS THING YOU FLEE] .

en: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."
gloss: HIS COMPANION SAY , [rs-b: OUR LORD , ME NOT MAKE IX EXCEED , IX ASTRAY FAR] .

en: And the [angels] apportioning [each] matter,
gloss: SWEAR ANGEL DIVIDE COMMAND ,

en: By the heaven containing pathways,
gloss: SWEAR SKY PATH+ ,

en: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.
gloss: [neg: NOT LEAVE ANYTHING] , ONLY MAKE ROTTEN .

en: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.
gloss: [rhq: THEY ADVISE EACH-OTHER] ? NO , THEY PEOPLE EXCEED .

en: So leave them, [O Muḥammad], for you are not to be blamed.
gloss: SO TURN-AWAY THEM , [neg: NOT BLAME YOU] .

en: In parchment spread open
gloss: ON PAGE OPEN ,

en: And the mountains will pass on, departing -
gloss: MOUNTAIN MOVE .

en: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.
gloss: PEOPLE PLAY EMPTY .

en: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.
gloss: SHARE CUP , [neg: NOT TALK EMPTY , NOT SIN] .

en: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."
gloss: [rs-a: BEFORE WE CALL IX . IX KIND , MERCIFUL] .

en: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.
gloss: [rs-c: BRING WORD SAME , IF TRUE] .

en: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.
gloss: IN HORIZON HIGH .

en: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations] -
gloss: IBRAHIM , KEEP PROMISE ?

en: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted
gloss: FROM SEED , [top: WHEN EMIT] ,

en: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the other [i.e., next] creation.
gloss: IX RESPONSIBLE CREATE AGAIN ,

en: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.
gloss: HOUR , THEIR PROMISE . HOUR WORSE , BITTER .

en: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.
gloss: PLACE TRUE , NEAR KING POWER .

en: We will attend to you, O prominent beings.
gloss: [warn: FUTURE ALLAH ATTEND YOU-ALL , TWO GROUP] .

en: They will circulate between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree].
gloss: THEY GO BETWEEN FIRE , WATER BOIL .

en: Fair ones reserved in pavilions -
gloss: EYE BEAUTIFUL , STAY TENT .

en: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling
gloss: MOUNTAIN CRUSH ,

en: And fruit, abundant [and varied],
gloss: FRUIT MANY ,

en: And [upon] beds raised high.
gloss: COUCH HIGH .

en: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower?
gloss: [rhq: YOU-ALL GROW , OR ALLAH GROW] ?

en: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down?
gloss: [rhq: YOU-ALL SEND-DOWN FROM CLOUD , OR ALLAH] ?

en: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer?
gloss: [rhq: YOU-ALL CREATE TREE , OR ALLAH CREATE] ?

en: In a Register well-protected;.
gloss: IN BOOK KEEP ,

en: And We [i.e., Our angels] are nearer to him than you, but you do not see -
gloss: ALLAH NEAR IX , MORE NEAR YOU , BUT YOU-ALL NOT SEE .

en: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
gloss: PEOPLE BEFORE DENY , [rhq: MY PUNISH HOW] ?

en: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.
gloss: [rhq: WHO GIVE YOU FOOD , IF ALLAH STOP] ? BUT THEY CONTINUE PROUD , FLEE .

en: They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you].
gloss: THEY WISH YOU SOFT , THEY SOFT .

en: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals?
gloss: [rhq: WE MAKE MUSLIM SAME SINNER] ?

en: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?
gloss: [rhq: YOU KNOW HOUR TRUE SURE WHAT] ?

en: [Allāh will say], "Seize him and shackle him.
gloss: [warn: TAKE IX , BIND IX] ,

en: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors -
gloss: [top: PERSON WANT MORE] , THOSE EXCEED .

en: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer:
gloss: PROTECT THEIR PRAY .

en: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.
gloss: CHANGE THEM , BRING PEOPLE BETTER . [neg: NONE CAN STOP] .

en: That you may follow therein roads of passage.'"
gloss: [rs-a: FOR YOU WALK PATH WIDE] .

en: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.
gloss: [top: DAY] , YOU BUSY LONG .

en: And do not confer favor to acquire more.
gloss: [neg: NOT GIVE , EXPECT GET MORE] ,

en: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].
gloss: [rs-b: SAY , THIS ONLY MAGIC FROM PAST] ,

en: Altering [i.e., blackening] the skins.
gloss: BURN SKIN .

en: Indeed, it [i.e., the Fire] is of the greatest [afflictions].
gloss: [aff: HELL , ONE BIG DISASTER] ,

en: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained.
gloss: EACH SOUL HOLD BECAUSE ITS DO ,

en: No! But you [i.e., mankind] love the immediate
gloss: [neg: NO] ! YOU-ALL LOVE WORLD-LIFE NOW ,

en: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.
gloss: ALLAH SHOW PATH . PERSON THANK , OR DENY .

en: And the winds that blow violently
gloss: STORM STRONG ,

en: And when the mountains are blown away
gloss: [top: WHEN MOUNTAIN SCATTER] ,

en: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?
gloss: [rhq: ALLAH NOT CREATE YOU FROM WATER WEAK] ?

en: And gardens of entwined growth.
gloss: GARDEN TREE MANY THICK .

en: For the transgressors, a place of return,
gloss: [top: PEOPLE:b SIN] , HELL THEIR HOME .

en: In which they will remain for ages [unending].
gloss: THERE THEY STAY TIME LONG+ .

en: And when Hellfire is set ablaze
gloss: [top: WHEN HELL FIRE BIG] ,

en: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],
gloss: POWER , BEFORE LORD THRONE HIGH ,

en: On adorned couches, observing.
gloss: SIT COUCH , LOOK .

en: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
gloss: [top: WHEN SEE BELIEVER] , SAY [rs-b: THOSE ASTRAY] .

en: On adorned couches, observing.
gloss: SIT COUCH , LOOK .

en: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
gloss: [rhq: DISBELIEVER GET PAY FOR THEIR DO] ? [aff: YES] .

en: And return to his people in happiness.
gloss: [happy: RETURN FAMILY HAPPY] .

en: [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate.
gloss: IN TABLET KEEP .

en: So let man observe from what he was created.
gloss: PERSON LOOK , CREATE FROM WHAT .

en: He was created from a fluid, ejected,
gloss: CREATE FROM WATER SPURT ,

en: And [then] makes it black stubble.
gloss: AFTER MAKE DRY DARK .

en: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul,
gloss: [awe: SOUL PEACE] ,

en: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?
gloss: [rhq: PERSON THINK , NONE CAN CONTROL IX] ?

en: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.
gloss: BUT IX NOT TRY PATH HARD .

en: An orphan of near relationship
gloss: ORPHAN RELATIVE ,

en: Did We not expand for you, [O Muḥammad], your breast?
gloss: [rhq: ALLAH NOT OPEN YOUR CHEST] ?

en: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.
gloss: TO YOUR LORD , WANT .

en: And the earth discharges its burdens
gloss: EARTH THROW OUT HEAVY INSIDE ,

en: Stirring up thereby [clouds of] dust,
gloss: RAISE DUST ,

en: Arriving thereby in the center collectively,
gloss: ENTER MIDDLE ARMY .

en: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
gloss: [aff: PERSON , LORD , NOT THANK] .

en: Woe to every scorner and mocker
gloss: [warn: WOE PERSON MOCK , GOSSIP] ,

en: Which mounts directed at the hearts.
gloss: REACH HEART .

en: Have you not considered, [O Muḥammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?
gloss: [rhq: YOU NOT SEE , YOUR LORD DO WHAT TO PEOPLE ELEPHANT] ?

en: If you [disbelievers] seek the decision [i.e., victory] - the decision [i.e., defeat] has come to you. And if you desist [from hostilities], it is best for you; but if you return [to war], We will return, and never will you be availed by your [large] company at all, even if it should increase; and [that is] because Allāh is with the believers.
gloss: [cond: IF YOU ASK DECIDE] , DECIDE COME . [cond: IF STOP] , BEST FOR YOU . [cond: IF RETURN] , WE RETURN . YOUR GROUP [neg: NOT HELP] , EVEN MANY . ALLAH WITH BELIEVER .

en: So if they deny you, [O Muḥammad], say, "Your Lord is the possessor of vast mercy; but His punishment cannot be repelled from the people who are criminals."
gloss: [cond: IF THEY DENY YOU] , SAY , [rs-a: YOUR LORD MERCY WIDE . IX PUNISH NOT STOP FROM SINNER] .

en: But, [on the contrary], We have provided good things for these [disbelievers] and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. Then do they not see that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? Is it they who will overcome?
gloss: NO , WE GIVE THESE , FATHER , ENJOY , LIFE LONG . [rhq: THEY NOT SEE , WE COME LAND , MAKE SMALL FROM EDGE] ? [rhq: THEY WIN] ?

en: And when they have [nearly] fulfilled their term, either retain them according to acceptable terms or part with them according to acceptable terms. And bring to witness two just men from among you and establish the testimony for [the acceptance of] Allāh. That is instructed to whoever should believe in Allāh and the Last Day. And whoever fears Allāh - He will make for him a way out
gloss: [top: WHEN THEY REACH TIME] , KEEP WITH GOOD , OR SEPARATE WITH GOOD . TWO WITNESS FAIR FROM YOU , WITNESS FOR ALLAH . THAT ADVISE PERSON BELIEVE ALLAH , HEREAFTER . PERSON FEAR-GOD ALLAH , ALLAH MAKE WAY OUT ,

en: And among them are unlettered ones who do not know the Scripture except [indulgement in] wishful thinking, but they are only assuming.
gloss: SOME NOT READ , NOT KNOW BOOK , ONLY WISH , ONLY GUESS .

en: And do not argue on behalf of those who deceive themselves. Indeed, Allāh loves not one who is a habitually sinful deceiver.
gloss: [neg: NOT ARGUE FOR PEOPLE BETRAY SELF] . ALLAH NOT LIKE BETRAY SINNER .

en: And if We had made him [i.e., the messenger] an angel, We would have made him [appear as] a man, and We would have covered them with that in which they cover themselves [i.e., confusion and doubt].
gloss: [cond: IF WE MAKE MESSENGER ANGEL] , MAKE IX MAN , MIX THEM SAME THEY MIX .

en: Or do they say [about Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)], "He invented it"? Say, "If I have invented it, then upon me is [the consequence of] my crime; but I am innocent of what [crimes] you commit."
gloss: [rhq: THEY SAY , IX INVENT] ? SAY , [rs-a: [cond: IF ME INVENT] , MY SIN ON ME . ME FREE FROM YOUR SIN] .

en: And they sold him for a reduced price - a few dirhams - and they were, concerning him, of those content with little.
gloss: SELL IX PRICE LOW , MONEY FEW , NOT WANT IX .

en: And they requested decision [i.e., victory from Allāh], and disappointed, [therefore], was every obstinate tyrant.
gloss: THEY ASK DECIDE . EVERY STUBBORN CRUEL FAIL .

en: And that declaration of theirs did not cease until We made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished [like a fire].
gloss: CONTINUE SAY , UNTIL WE MAKE THEM HARVEST , FIRE GONE .

en: Rather, We dash the truth upon falsehood, and it destroys it, and thereupon it departs. And for you is destruction from that which you describe.
gloss: NO , WE THROW TRUE ON FALSE , BREAK IT , FALSE DISAPPEAR . [warn: WOE YOU , YOUR DESCRIBE] .

en: And We taught him the fashioning of coats of armor to protect you from your [enemy in] battle. So will you then be grateful?
gloss: WE TEACH IX MAKE CLOTHES IRON , PROTECT YOU IN FIGHT . [rhq: YOU THANK] ?

en: And for how many a city did I prolong enjoyment while it was committing wrong. Then I seized it, and to Me is the [final] destination.
gloss: [rhq: HOW-MANY CITY ME DELAY , WRONGDOER] ? THEN ME CATCH . TO ME DESTINATION .

en: For every [religious] community We have appointed rites which they perform. So, [O Muḥammad], let them [i.e., the disbelievers] not contend with you over the matter but invite [them] to your Lord. Indeed, you are upon straight guidance.
gloss: EVERY NATION WE APPOINT WORSHIP WAY . [neg: NOT LET THEM ARGUE WITH YOU] . INVITE TO YOUR LORD . YOU ON GUIDE STRAIGHT .

en: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.
gloss: [rs-a: [neg: NOT TAKE PEOPLE RIGHT , NOT CORRUPT EARTH]] .

en: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
gloss: SUN MOVE TO PLACE . THAT DECREE ALLAH , POWER , KNOW .

en: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."
gloss: [rs-b: THIS MY BROTHER , OWN NINETY NINE ANIMAL . ME OWN ONE . IX SAY , GIVE ME . IX WIN ARGUE] .

en: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning
gloss: ALLAH TEST THEM , SAME TEST PEOPLE GARDEN , [top: WHEN THEY SWEAR] , HARVEST MORNING ,

en: And [Allāh revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant rain [i.e., provision].
gloss: [cond: IF THEY STRAIGHT ON PATH] , ALLAH GIVE WATER MANY ,

en: And that when the Servant [i.e., Prophet] of Allāh stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."
gloss: [top: WHEN SERVANT ALLAH STAND PRAY] , JINN CROWD AROUND .

en: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.
gloss: LEAVE ME , DENIER RICH ENJOY . GIVE THEM TIME LITTLE .

en: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.
gloss: SIT COUCH , [neg: SUN HOT NONE , COLD NONE] .

en: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
gloss: [top: THAT DAY] , PEOPLE EXIT SCATTER , SEE THEIR DO .

en: [Allāh said], "O John, take the Scripture [i.e., adhere to it] with determination." And We gave him judgement [while yet] a boy
gloss: [rs-c: YAHYA , TAKE BOOK STRONG] . WE GIVE IX WISDOM , STILL CHILD ,

en: And do not make your hand [as] chained to your neck or extend it completely and [thereby] become blamed and insolvent.
gloss: [neg: NOT TIE HAND NECK , NOT OPEN HAND ALL] , YOU BLAME , POOR .

en: And We have certainly diversified [the contents] in this Qur’ān that they [i.e., mankind] may be reminded, but it does not increase them [i.e., the disbelievers] except in aversion.
gloss: WE EXPLAIN IN QURAN , MAYBE REMEMBER . BUT ADD ONLY TURN-AWAY .

en: And We did not give him [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur’ān
gloss: [neg: ALLAH NOT TEACH IX POETRY , NOT FITTING] . THIS ONLY REMINDER , QURAN CLEAR ,

en: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when We directed to you a few of the jinn, listening to the Qur’ān. And when they attended it, they said, "Listen attentively." And when it was concluded, they went back to their people as warners.
gloss: [top: WHEN ALLAH SEND GROUP JINN TO YOU , LISTEN QURAN] , [rs-b: SAY , QUIET] . [top: FINISH] , RETURN TO PEOPLE , WARN .

en: Let a man of wealth spend from his wealth, and he whose provision is restricted - let him spend from what Allāh has given him. Allāh does not charge a soul except [according to] what He has given it. Allāh will bring about, after hardship, ease [i.e., relief].
gloss: RICH SPEND FROM RICH . POOR SPEND FROM THING ALLAH GIVE . [neg: ALLAH NOT GIVE SOUL BURDEN MORE THAN GIVE] . ALLAH MAKE EASY AFTER HARD .

en: And when [other] relatives and orphans and the needy are present at the [time of] division, then provide for them [something] out of it [i.e., the estate] and speak to them words of appropriate kindness.
gloss: [top: RELATIVE , ORPHAN , POOR PRESENT DIVIDE] , GIVE THEM SOME , TALK KIND .

en: And We have certainly diversified in this Qur’ān for the people from every [kind of] example; but man has ever been, most of anything, [prone to] dispute.
gloss: WE EXPLAIN IN QURAN EVERY KIND EXAMPLE . PERSON ARGUE MOST .

en: And thus We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur’ān and have diversified therein the warnings that perhaps they will avoid [sin] or it would cause them remembrance.
gloss: SAME , WE SEND-DOWN QURAN ARABIC , EXPLAIN WARN MANY WAY , MAYBE FEAR-GOD , OR REMEMBER .

en: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself [i.e., sinner].
gloss: WE BLESS IX , ISHAQ . THEIR CHILD+ , SOME DO GOOD , SOME WRONG SELF CLEAR .

en: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.
gloss: NUH PEOPLE BEFORE , THEY MORE WRONG , EXCEED ,

en: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muḥammad], the Qur’ān progressively.
gloss: [aff: ALLAH SEND-DOWN QURAN TO YOU , STAGE+] .

en: But this is an honored Qur’ān
gloss: [aff: THIS QURAN GLORY] ,

en: And [mention] Noah, when he called [to Allāh] before [that time], so We responded to him and saved him and his family from the great affliction [i.e., the flood].
gloss: NUH , BEFORE CALL . WE ANSWER , SAVE IX , FAMILY FROM DISASTER GREAT .

en: And if We had made it a foreign [i.e., non-Arabic] Qur’ān, they would have said, "Why are its verses not explained in detail [in our language]? Is it a foreign [recitation] and an Arab [messenger]?" Say, "It is, for those who believe, a guidance and cure." And those who do not believe - in their ears is deafness, and it is upon them blindness. Those are being called from a distant place.
gloss: [cond: IF ALLAH MAKE QURAN NOT ARABIC] , [rs-b: THEY SAY , WHY NOT EXPLAIN CLEAR ? NOT ARABIC , ARABIC PEOPLE] ? SAY , [aff: FOR BELIEVER , GUIDE , HEAL . DISBELIEVER , EAR DEAF , BLIND , SAME CALL FROM FAR] .

en: Allāh will not impose blame upon you for what is meaningless in your oaths, but He will impose blame upon you for [breaking] what you intended of oaths. So its expiation is the feeding of ten needy people from the average of that which you feed your [own] families or clothing them or the freeing of a slave. But whoever cannot find [or afford it] - then a fast of three days [is required]. That is the expiation for oaths when you have sworn. But guard your oaths. Thus does Allāh make clear to you His verses [i.e., revealed law] that you may be grateful.
gloss: ALLAH [neg: NOT BLAME OATH EMPTY] , BLAME OATH INTEND . FORGIVE , FEED TEN POOR , MIDDLE FOOD FAMILY , OR CLOTHES , OR FREE SLAVE . PERSON NOT FIND , FAST THREE DAY . THAT FORGIVE OATH . PROTECT OATH . SAME , ALLAH EXPLAIN VERSE , MAYBE THANK .

en: And recite to them the news of Noah, when he said to his people, "O my people, if my residence and my reminding of the signs of Allāh has become burdensome upon you - then I have relied upon Allāh. So resolve upon your plan and [call upon] your associates. Then let not your plan be obscure to you. Then carry it out upon me and do not give me respite.
gloss: RECITE THEM NUH NEWS . IX SAY PEOPLE , [rs-a: MY PEOPLE , [cond: IF MY STAY , REMIND ALLAH SIGN-PROOF HEAVY FOR YOU] , ME TRUST ALLAH . DECIDE PLAN , YOUR PARTNER , NOT HIDE . THEN DO ON ME , NOT DELAY] .

en: And [it is] a Qur’ān which We have separated [by intervals] that you might recite it to the people over a prolonged period. And We have sent it down progressively.
gloss: QURAN WE SEPARATE , YOU RECITE PEOPLE SLOW . WE SEND-DOWN PIECE+ .

en: Zakāh expenditures are only for the poor and for the needy and for those employed for it and for bringing hearts together [for Islām] and for freeing captives [or slaves] and for those in debt and for the cause of Allāh and for the [stranded] traveler - an obligation [imposed] by Allāh. And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
gloss: ZAKAT ONLY FOR POOR , NEED , PERSON WORK COLLECT , HEART JOIN , FREE SLAVE , DEBT , ALLAH PATH , TRAVELER . OBLIGATION FROM ALLAH . ALLAH KNOW , WISE .

en: And the camels and cattle We have appointed for you as among the symbols [i.e., rites] of Allāh; for you therein is good. So mention the name of Allāh upon them when lined up [for sacrifice]; and when they are [lifeless] on their sides, then eat from them and feed the needy [who does not seek aid] and the beggar. Thus have We subjected them to you that you may be grateful.
gloss: CAMEL , COW , WE MAKE ALLAH SIGN , GOOD FOR YOU . MENTION ALLAH NAME , STAND LINE . [top: FALL SIDE] , EAT , FEED POOR NOT ASK , POOR ASK . SAME , WE CONTROL FOR YOU , MAYBE THANK .

en: Say, "Have you considered: if it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is from Allāh and you disbelieved in it, who would be more astray than one who is in extreme dissension?"
gloss: SAY , [rhq: YOU SEE , IF QURAN FROM ALLAH , YOU DENY , WHO MORE ASTRAY THAN PERSON OPPOSE FAR] ?

en: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.
gloss: [rs-b: QURAN GUIDE TO RIGHT , WE BELIEVE . WE NEVER WORSHIP OTHER GOD WITH LORD] .

en: And test the orphans [in their abilities] until they reach marriageable age. Then if you perceive in them sound judgement, release their property to them. And do not consume it excessively and quickly, [anticipating] that they will grow up. And whoever, [when acting as guardian], is self-sufficient should refrain [from taking a fee]; and whoever is poor - let him take according to what is acceptable. Then when you release their property to them, bring witnesses upon them. And sufficient is Allāh as Accountant.
gloss: TEST ORPHAN UNTIL MARRY AGE . [cond: IF SEE WISE] , GIVE MONEY . [neg: NOT EAT TOO-MUCH , HURRY BEFORE GROW] . RICH GUARDIAN , NOT TAKE . POOR GUARDIAN , TAKE FAIR . [top: GIVE MONEY] , BRING WITNESS . ALLAH ENOUGH COUNT .

en: Here you are - those invited to spend in the cause of Allāh - but among you are those who withhold [out of greed]. And whoever withholds only withholds [benefit] from himself; and Allāh is the Free of need, while you are the needy. And if you turn away [i.e., refuse], He will replace you with another people; then they will not be the likes of you.
gloss: YOU-ALL CALL SPEND FOR ALLAH PATH . SOME STINGY . PERSON STINGY , STINGY AGAINST SELF . ALLAH RICH , YOU-ALL POOR . [cond: IF TURN-AWAY] , ALLAH CHANGE PEOPLE OTHER , [neg: NOT SAME YOU] .

en: Then do they not reflect upon the Qur’ān? If it had been from [any] other than Allāh, they would have found within it much contradiction.
gloss: [rhq: THEY NOT THINK ABOUT QURAN] ? [cond: IF FROM OTHER THAN ALLAH] , FIND INSIDE DISAGREE MUCH .

en: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.
gloss: ALSO NUH PEOPLE BEFORE . THEY DISOBEY .

en: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person."
gloss: [rs-b: TODAY , NOT LET POOR ENTER] .

en: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."
gloss: AFTER , CHAIN LONG SEVENTY ARM , BIND .

en: There is no blame upon you if you divorce women you have not touched nor specified for them an obligation. But give them [a gift of] compensation - the wealthy according to his capability and the poor according to his capability - a provision according to what is acceptable, a duty upon the doers of good.
gloss: [neg: BLAME NONE] DIVORCE WOMAN NOT TOUCH , NOT DECIDE DOWRY . GIVE GIFT , RICH ABILITY , POOR ABILITY , FAIR . OBLIGATION GOOD PEOPLE .

en: Prohibited to you are dead animals, blood, the flesh of swine, and that which has been dedicated to other than Allāh, and [those animals] killed by strangling or by a violent blow or by a head-long fall or by the goring of horns, and those from which a wild animal has eaten, except what you [are able to] slaughter [before its death], and those which are sacrificed on stone altars, and [prohibited is] that you seek decision through divining arrows. That is grave disobedience. This day those who disbelieve have despaired of [defeating] your religion; so fear them not, but fear Me. This day I have perfected for you your religion and completed My favor upon you and have approved for you Islām as religion. But whoever is forced by severe hunger with no inclination to sin - then indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
gloss: FORBID YOU , DEAD ANIMAL , BLOOD , fs:PIG MEAT , DEDICATE OTHER THAN ALLAH , CHOKE , HIT , FALL , HORN , WILD ANIMAL EAT , EXCEPT YOU SACRIFICE , SACRIFICE ON STONE , DECIDE WITH LUCK . THAT DISOBEY . TODAY DISBELIEVER DESPAIR YOUR RELIGION . [neg: NOT FEAR THEM] , FEAR ME . [awe: TODAY ME COMPLETE YOUR RELIGION , COMPLETE MY FAVOR ON YOU , PLEASED ISLAM YOUR RELIGION] . PERSON FORCE HUNGRY , NOT WANT SIN , ALLAH FORGIVE , MERCIFUL .

en: If you disclose your charitable expenditures, they are good; but if you conceal them and give them to the poor, it is better for you, and He will remove from you some of your misdeeds [thereby]. And Allāh, of what you do, is [fully] Aware.
gloss: [cond: IF SHOW CHARITY] , GOOD . [cond: IF HIDE , GIVE POOR] , BETTER FOR YOU , REMOVE SOME SIN . ALLAH AWARE YOUR DO .

en: Indeed, [O Muḥammad], He who imposed upon you the Qur’ān will take you back to a place of return. Say, "My Lord is most knowing of who brings guidance and who is in clear error."
gloss: IX GIVE YOU QURAN , SURE RETURN YOU PLACE RETURN . SAY , [rs-a: MY LORD KNOW BEST WHO BRING GUIDE , WHO ASTRAY CLEAR] .

en: They said, "O Noah, you have disputed [i.e., opposed] us and been frequent in dispute of us. So bring us what you threaten us, if you should be of the truthful."
gloss: [rs-b: THEY SAY , NUH , YOU ARGUE US MUCH . BRING THING YOU PROMISE , IF YOU TRUE] .

en: We relate to you, [O Muḥammad], the best of stories in what We have revealed to you of this Qur’ān although you were, before it, among the unaware.
gloss: WE TELL YOU STORY BEST , REVEAL THIS QURAN . BEFORE , YOU UNAWARE .

en: And We have certainly given you, [O Muḥammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur’ān.
gloss: WE GIVE YOU SEVEN REPEAT , QURAN GREAT .

en: The people of Noah denied before them and the [disbelieving] factions after them, and every nation intended [a plot] for their messenger to seize him, and they disputed by [using] falsehood to [attempt to] invalidate thereby the truth. So I seized them, and how [terrible] was My penalty.
gloss: BEFORE , NUH PEOPLE DENY , AFTER GROUP+ DENY . EACH NATION PLAN CATCH THEIR MESSENGER , ARGUE WITH FALSE , WANT DESTROY TRUE . [awe: ME CATCH THEM . MY PUNISH HOW TERRIBLE] .

en: And those who disbelieve say, "Do not listen to this Qur’ān and speak noisily during [the recitation of] it that perhaps you will overcome."
gloss: [rs-b: DISBELIEVER SAY , NOT LISTEN QURAN , MAKE NOISE , MAYBE YOU WIN] .

en: Said the eminent ones who were arrogant among his people to those who were oppressed - to those who believed among them, "Do you [actually] know that Ṣāliḥ is sent from his Lord?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which he was sent, are believers."
gloss: [rs-b: LEADER+ ARROGANT SAY TO WEAK BELIEVER , [yn: YOU KNOW SALIH SEND FROM LORD]] ? [rs-c: SAY , WE BELIEVE IX MESSAGE] .

en: And We sent to no city a prophet [who was denied] except that We seized its people with poverty and hardship that they might humble themselves [to Allāh].
gloss: WE SEND PROPHET TO CITY , ALWAYS CATCH PEOPLE POOR , HARD , MAYBE HUMBLE .

en: For the poor emigrants who were expelled from their homes and their properties, seeking bounty from Allāh and [His] approval and supporting [the cause of] Allāh and His Messenger, [there is also a share]. Those are the truthful.
gloss: FOR POOR EMIGRATE , PUSH-AWAY FROM HOME , MONEY , SEEK ALLAH BLESS , PLEASED , HELP ALLAH , MESSENGER . THOSE TRUE .

en: Thus does Allāh make clear to you His verses [i.e., laws] that you might use reason.
gloss: SAME , ALLAH EXPLAIN VERSE , MAYBE UNDERSTAND .

en: They have been put under humiliation [by Allāh] wherever they are overtaken, except for a rope [i.e., covenant] from Allāh and a rope [i.e., treaty] from the people [i.e., the Muslims]. And they have drawn upon themselves anger from Allāh and have been put under destitution. That is because they disbelieved in [i.e., rejected] the verses of Allāh and killed the prophets without right. That is because they disobeyed and [habitually] transgressed.
gloss: SHAME ON THEM WHERE FIND , EXCEPT ROPE FROM ALLAH , ROPE FROM PEOPLE . GET ALLAH ANGRY , POOR ON THEM . BECAUSE DENY ALLAH VERSE , KILL PROPHET+ WITHOUT RIGHT , DISOBEY , TRANSGRESS .

en: Similar situations [as yours] have passed on before you, so proceed throughout the earth and observe how was the end of those who denied.
gloss: BEFORE YOU , WAY+ PASS . TRAVEL EARTH , LOOK DENIER END HOW .

en: So do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are [true] believers.
gloss: [neg: NOT WEAK , NOT SAD] . YOU HIGHEST , IF BELIEVER .

en: And how many a prophet [fought in battle and] with him fought many religious scholars. But they never lost assurance due to what afflicted them in the cause of Allāh, nor did they weaken or submit. And Allāh loves the steadfast.
gloss: [rhq: HOW-MANY PROPHET , MANY SCHOLAR FIGHT WITH] ? [neg: NOT WEAK , NOT GIVE UP] FROM HARM ALLAH PATH . ALLAH LOVE PATIENT .

en: And how could you take it while you have gone in unto each other and they have taken from you a solemn covenant?
gloss: [rhq: HOW TAKE , YOU TOGETHER , THEY TAKE PROMISE STRONG] ?

en: For every news [i.e., happening] is a finality; and you are going to know.
gloss: EVERY NEWS HAVE TIME . [warn: LATER YOU KNOW] .

en: And for all are degrees [i.e., positions resulting] from what they have done. And your Lord is not unaware of what they do.
gloss: EACH LEVEL FOR DO . YOUR LORD NOT UNAWARE THEIR DO .

en: Indeed, what you are promised is coming, and you will not cause failure [to Allāh].
gloss: THING PROMISE COME . YOU CANNOT ESCAPE .

en: Said the eminent among his people, "Indeed, we see you in clear error."
gloss: [rs-b: LEADER+ SAY , WE SEE YOU ASTRAY CLEAR] .

en: And they [i.e., the false deities] are unable to [give] them help, nor can they help themselves.
gloss: [neg: CANNOT HELP THEM , CANNOT HELP SELF] .

en: And [commanded], 'Direct your face [i.e., self] toward the religion, inclining to truth, and never be of those who associate others with Allāh;
gloss: [rs-a: FACE RELIGION STRAIGHT , NEVER BECOME POLYTHEIST] ,

en: [The angels said], "O Abraham, give up this [plea]. Indeed, the command of your Lord has come, and indeed, there will reach them a punishment that cannot be repelled."
gloss: [rs-c: IBRAHIM , LEAVE THIS . YOUR LORD COMMAND COME . PUNISH COME , NOT STOP] .

en: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Grand, the Exalted.
gloss: KNOW UNSEEN , SEEN , GREAT , HIGHEST .

en: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.
gloss: [neg: NATION NOT EARLY TERM , NOT DELAY] .

en: They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic."
gloss: [rs-b: THEY SAY , OUR EYE CONFUSED . NO , MAGIC HIT US] .

en: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them [i.e., mankind] on earth, and I will mislead them all
gloss: [rs-b: IX SAY , MY LORD , BECAUSE YOU MISLEAD ME , ME MAKE EVIL LOOK BEAUTIFUL ON EARTH , MISLEAD ALL] ,

en: [Lot] said, "These are my daughters - if you would be doers [of lawful marriage]."
gloss: [rs-a: IX SAY , THESE MY DAUGHTER , IF YOU WANT MARRY] .

en: And when it is said to them, "What has your Lord sent down?" they say, "Legends of the former peoples,"
gloss: [top: ASK THEM , YOUR LORD SEND-DOWN WHAT] , [rs-b: SAY , STORY OLD] ,

en: Do not make [as equal] with Allāh another deity and [thereby] become censured and forsaken.
gloss: [neg: NOT MAKE OTHER GOD WITH ALLAH] , YOU BLAME , ALONE .

en: Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence.
gloss: THEN FROM EVERY GROUP WE TAKE OUT PERSON MOST DISOBEY GRACIOUS .

en: No! We will record what he says and extend [i.e., increase] for him from the punishment extensively.
gloss: [neg: NO] ! WE WRITE IX SAY , EXTEND PUNISH LONG .

en: So be not impatient over them. We only count out [i.e., allow] to them a [limited] number.
gloss: [neg: NOT HURRY AGAINST THEM] . WE ONLY COUNT THEIR TIME .

en: So they disputed over their affair among themselves and concealed their private conversation.
gloss: THEY ARGUE AMONG , WHISPER SECRET .

en: He said, "They are close upon my tracks, and I hastened to You, my Lord, that You be pleased."
gloss: [rs-a: IX SAY , THEY FOLLOW BEHIND ME . ME HURRY TO YOU , MY LORD , YOU PLEASED] .

en: They will murmur among themselves, "You remained not but ten [days in the world]."
gloss: WHISPER AMONG , [rs-b: YOU STAY ONLY TEN] .

en: He [i.e., Allāh] knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, but they do not encompass it [i.e., what He knows] in knowledge.
gloss: IX KNOW FRONT , BEHIND . THEY NOT KNOW ALL .

en: And when they [i.e., its inhabitants] perceived Our punishment, at once they fled from it.
gloss: [top: THEY FEEL OUR PUNISH] , IMMEDIATELY RUN AWAY .

en: They cannot precede Him in word, and they act by His command.
gloss: [neg: NOT TALK BEFORE IX] , DO IX COMMAND .

en: And this [Qur’ān] is a blessed message which We have sent down. Then are you with it unacquainted?
gloss: THIS REMINDER BLESS WE SEND-DOWN . [rhq: YOU DENY] ?

en: Indeed, those for whom the best [reward] has preceded from Us - they are from it far removed.
gloss: PEOPLE BEST BEFORE FROM US , FAR FROM HELL .

en: It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein.
gloss: THEY HURRY GOOD DO , FIRST .

en: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples."
gloss: [rs-b: PROMISE US THIS , FATHER BEFORE . THIS ONLY STORY OLD] .

en: The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles.
gloss: FIRE BURN FACE , LIP PULL BACK .

en: And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate
gloss: [top: SPEND] , [neg: NOT TOO-MUCH , NOT STINGY] , MIDDLE .

en: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.
gloss: PULL-OUT HAND , WHITE FOR PEOPLE LOOK .

en: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.
gloss: [rs-a: MEASURE FULL , NOT CHEAT] .

en: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before. This is not but legends of the former peoples."
gloss: [rs-b: PROMISE US THIS , FATHER BEFORE . THIS ONLY STORY OLD] .

en: And the decree will befall them for the wrong they did, and they will not [be able to] speak.
gloss: WORD TRUE ON THEM BECAUSE WRONG , [neg: THEY NOT TALK] .

en: Their sides part [i.e., they arise] from [their] beds; they supplicate their Lord in fear and aspiration, and from what We have provided them, they spend.
gloss: THEY LEAVE BED , CALL LORD FEAR , HOPE . FROM WE PROVIDE , THEY SPEND .

en: Accursed wherever they are found, [being] seized and massacred completely.
gloss: CURSE , WHEREVER FIND , CATCH , KILL .

en: Those who were arrogant will say to those who were oppressed, "Did we avert you from guidance after it had come to you? Rather, you were criminals."
gloss: [rs-a: ARROGANT SAY TO WEAK , [rhq: WE BLOCK YOU FROM GUIDE AFTER COME] ? NO , YOU SINNER] .

en: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.
gloss: [neg: THEY CAN NOT ADVISE , NOT RETURN FAMILY] .

en: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.
gloss: IX RUN TO SHIP FULL ,

en: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.
gloss: THESE WAIT ONLY ONE BLOW , [neg: NOT DELAY] .

en: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
gloss: WE FORGIVE IX . IX CLOSE TO US , RETURN GOOD .

en: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks.
gloss: [rs-a: BRING BACK] . IX TOUCH LEG , NECK .

en: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.
gloss: LEAN THERE , ASK FRUIT MANY , DRINK .

en: And lost from them will be those they were invoking before, and they will be certain that they have no place of escape.
gloss: THING THEY CALL BEFORE , LOST . THEY KNOW , NOT ESCAPE .

en: And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline
gloss: DOOR , COUCH SIT ,

en: But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word.
gloss: [top: WHEN ALLAH REMOVE PUNISH] , THEY BREAK PROMISE .

en: And the evil consequences of what they did will appear to them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
gloss: THEIR EVIL DO SHOW THEM . THING THEY MOCK SURROUND THEM .

en: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
gloss: [top: DAY SKY SHAKE+] ,

en: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."
gloss: [rs-c: BURN . PATIENT OR NOT PATIENT , SAME . ONLY PAY YOUR DO] .

en: Or do you, [O Muḥammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
gloss: [rhq: YOU ASK PAY , THEY HEAVY DEBT] ?

en: The sight [of the Prophet (ﷺ)] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].
gloss: [neg: EYE NOT TURN-AWAY , NOT EXCEED] .

en: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.
gloss: SIT COUCH , INSIDE SILK THICK . FRUIT GARDEN NEAR .

en: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day."
gloss: ALL GATHER , DAY KNOW .

en: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder,
gloss: [cond: IF ALLAH WANT] , MAKE DRY , YOU-ALL SHOCK ,

en: And will provide for him from where he does not expect. And whoever relies upon Allāh - then He is sufficient for him. Indeed, Allāh will accomplish His purpose. Allāh has already set for everything a [decreed] extent.
gloss: GIVE FOOD FROM WHERE NOT EXPECT . PERSON TRUST ALLAH , ALLAH ENOUGH . ALLAH FINISH HIS COMMAND . ALLAH MEASURE EVERYTHING .

en: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit."
gloss: [rs-b: GO EARLY YOUR CROP , IF WANT HARVEST] .

en: So leave Me, [O Muḥammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies this statement [i.e., the Qur’ān]. We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know.
gloss: LEAVE ME , PERSON DENY THIS WORD . ALLAH LEAD THEM LITTLE LITTLE , THEY NOT KNOW .

en: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen
gloss: PERSON ASK PUNISH COME ,

en: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
gloss: [rs-a: IX SEND RAIN MANY] ,

en: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allāh would never send anyone [as a messenger].
gloss: [rs-b: THEY THINK SAME YOU-ALL , ALLAH NEVER RESURRECT] .

en: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allāh, so do not invoke with Allāh anyone.
gloss: [aff: MOSQUE FOR ALLAH] , [neg: NOT CALL OTHER WITH ALLAH] .

en: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."
gloss: SAY , [neg: ME NOT CONTROL HARM FOR YOU-ALL , NOT CONTROL GUIDE] .

en: Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about.
gloss: EACH PERSON WANT GET PAGE OPEN .

en: And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection].
gloss: SWEAR SOUL BLAME SELF .

en: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],
gloss: [top: DAY] , EARTH SHAKE+ .

en: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.
gloss: [top: DISBELIEVER] , YOU WAIT , GIVE THEM TIME LITTLE .

en: And those who believed after [the initial emigration] and emigrated and fought with you - they are of you. But those of [blood] relationship are more entitled [to inheritance] in the decree of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing of all things.
gloss: PEOPLE BELIEVE AFTER , EMIGRATE , STRIVE WITH YOU , FROM YOU . RELATIVE MORE RIGHT EACH-OTHER IN ALLAH BOOK . ALLAH KNOW ALL THING .

en: And if We hold back from them the punishment for a limited time, they will surely say, "What detains it?" Unquestionably, on the Day it comes to them, it will not be averted from them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
gloss: [cond: IF WE DELAY PUNISH TIME] , [rs-b: SAY , [wh: WHAT STOP]] ? [aff: DAY COME , NOT AVOID] , THING THEY MOCK SURROUND THEM .

en: The ones who prefer the worldly life over the Hereafter and avert [people] from the way of Allāh, seeking to make it [seem] deviant. Those are in extreme error.
gloss: PREFER WORLD-LIFE OVER HEREAFTER , BLOCK ALLAH PATH , WANT CROOKED . THEY ASTRAY FAR .

en: And do not be like she who untwisted her spun thread after it was strong [by] taking your oaths as [means of] deceit between you because one community is more plentiful [in number or wealth] than another community. Allāh only tries you thereby. And He will surely make clear to you on the Day of Resurrection that over which you used to differ.
gloss: [neg: NOT SAME WOMAN BREAK ROPE AFTER STRONG] , TAKE OATH DECEIVE , BECAUSE ONE GROUP MORE THAN OTHER . ALLAH ONLY TEST YOU . JUDGMENT-DAY IX SHOW THING YOU DISAGREE .

en: Then, indeed your Lord, to those who emigrated after they had been compelled [to say words of disbelief] and thereafter fought [for the cause of Allāh] and were patient - indeed, your Lord, after that, is Forgiving and Merciful
gloss: THEN YOUR LORD , PEOPLE EMIGRATE AFTER TEST , THEN STRIVE , PATIENT , YOUR LORD AFTER FORGIVE , MERCIFUL .

en: [Saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you and do not transgress [or oppress others] therein, lest My anger should descend upon you. And he upon whom My anger descends has certainly fallen [i.e., perished]."
gloss: [rs-c: EAT GOOD WE PROVIDE , NOT TRANSGRESS , MY ANGRY COME ON YOU . PERSON MY ANGRY COME , FALL] .

en: But We produced [many] generations [after Moses], and prolonged was their duration. And you were not a resident among the people of Madyan, reciting to them Our verses, but We were senders [of this message].
gloss: BUT WE CREATE GENERATION+ , TIME LONG . YOU NOT LIVE WITH fs:MADYAN PEOPLE , RECITE OUR VERSE . BUT WE SEND .

en: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison [i.e., a daughter], his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.
gloss: [top: WHEN GOOD NEWS GIRL , THING THEY SAY GRACIOUS HAVE] , FACE DARK , ANGRY .

en: There has certainly been for you in them an excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in Allāh and the Last Day. And whoever turns away - then indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
gloss: [aff: THEM , EXAMPLE GOOD FOR PERSON HOPE ALLAH , HEREAFTER] . PERSON TURN-AWAY , ALLAH RICH , PRAISE .

en: [Charity is] for the poor who have been restricted for the cause of Allāh, unable to move about in the land. An ignorant [person] would think them self-sufficient because of their restraint, but you will know them by their [characteristic] sign. They do not ask people persistently [or at all]. And whatever you spend of good - indeed, Allāh is Knowing of it.
gloss: FOR POOR , HOLD ALLAH PATH , CANNOT TRAVEL LAND . IGNORANT THINK RICH BECAUSE NOT ASK . YOU KNOW BY MARK . [neg: NOT ASK PEOPLE PUSH] . GOOD YOU SPEND , ALLAH KNOW .

en: O you who have believed, do not kill game while you are in the state of iḥrām. And whoever of you kills it intentionally - the penalty is an equivalent from sacrificial animals to what he killed, as judged by two just men among you as an offering [to Allāh] delivered to the Kaʿbah, or an expiation: the feeding of needy people or the equivalent of that in fasting, that he may taste the consequence of his matter [i.e., deed]. Allāh has pardoned what is past; but whoever returns [to violation], then Allāh will take retribution from him. And Allāh is Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution.
gloss: BELIEVER , [neg: NOT KILL HUNT ANIMAL DURING fs:IHRAM] . PERSON KILL INTEND , PAY SAME ANIMAL , TWO FAIR MAN JUDGE , SACRIFICE AT KAABA , OR FEED POOR , OR FAST SAME , TASTE RESULT . ALLAH PARDON BEFORE . PERSON RETURN , ALLAH PUNISH . ALLAH MIGHTY , OWN RETRIBUTION .

en: And We have already sent [messengers] to nations before you, [O Muḥammad]; then We seized them with poverty and hardship that perhaps they might humble themselves [to Us].
gloss: BEFORE YOU , WE SEND NATION+ , CATCH POOR , HARD , MAYBE HUMBLE .

en: And, [O Muḥammad], you are not [engaged] in any matter and do not recite any of the Qur’ān and you [people] do not do any deed except that We are witness over you when you are involved in it. And not absent from your Lord is any [part] of an atom's weight within the earth or within the heaven or [anything] smaller than that or greater but that it is in a clear register.
gloss: YOU DO ANY MATTER , RECITE QURAN , YOU DO ANY WORK , WE WITNESS . [neg: NOTHING HIDDEN FROM YOUR LORD , ATOM WEIGH EARTH , SKY , SMALL , BIG] , EXCEPT IN BOOK CLEAR .

en: And [Noah] said, "Embark therein; in the name of Allāh [are] its course and its anchorage. Indeed, my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful."
gloss: [rs-a: NUH SAY , RIDE . BISMILLAH , SAIL , STOP . MY LORD FORGIVE , MERCIFUL] .

en: O descendants of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah. Indeed, he was a grateful servant.
gloss: CHILD+ PEOPLE WE CARRY WITH NUH . IX SERVANT THANK .

en: And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign,
gloss: [rs-c: PUT HAND UNDER ARM , COME OUT WHITE , NOT SICK , OTHER SIGN-PROOF] ,

en: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."
gloss: [rs-b: THEY SAY , [cond: IF YOU NOT STOP] , NUH , WE THROW STONE YOU] .

en: And the devils have not brought it [i.e., the revelation] down.
gloss: DEVIL [neg: NOT BRING DOWN QURAN] .

en: Qāf. By the honored Qur’ān...
gloss: fs:Q . SWEAR QURAN GLORY .

en: The people of Noah denied before them, and the companions of the well and Thamūd
gloss: BEFORE , NUH PEOPLE DENY , PEOPLE fs:RASS , fs:THAMUD ,

en: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant. But remind by the Qur’ān whoever fears My threat.
gloss: ALLAH KNOW THEIR SAY . [neg: YOU NOT FORCE THEM] . REMIND WITH QURAN , PERSON AFRAID MY WARN .

en: Deluded away from it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is he who is deluded.
gloss: PERSON TURN-AWAY , TURN-AWAY FROM QURAN .

en: And what Allāh restored to His Messenger from the people of the towns - it is for Allāh and for the Messenger and for [his] near relatives and orphans and the needy and the [stranded] traveler - so that it will not be a perpetual distribution among the rich from among you. And whatever the Messenger has given you - take; and what he has forbidden you - refrain from. And fear Allāh; indeed, Allāh is severe in penalty.
gloss: [top: THING ALLAH GIVE MESSENGER FROM CITY PEOPLE] , FOR ALLAH , MESSENGER , FAMILY , ORPHAN , POOR , TRAVELER , [neg: NOT ONLY RICH SHARE] . [top: MESSENGER GIVE] , TAKE . [top: MESSENGER FORBID] , STOP . FEAR-GOD ALLAH . ALLAH PUNISH STRONG .

en: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.
gloss: [neg: NOT ENCOURAGE FEED POOR] .

en: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.
gloss: [aff: QURAN REGRET FOR DISBELIEVER] .

en: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muḥammad], to hasten with it [i.e., recitation of the Qur’ān].
gloss: [neg: NOT MOVE YOUR TONGUE HURRY QURAN] .

en: Then in what statement after it [i.e., the Qur’ān] will they believe?
gloss: [rhq: AFTER QURAN , THEY BELIEVE WHAT WORD] ?

en: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger [i.e., Gabriel]
gloss: QURAN WORD MESSENGER HONOR ,

en: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
gloss: [neg: NOT ENCOURAGE FEED POOR] .

en: He said, "He says, 'It is a cow neither trained to plow the earth nor to irrigate the field, one free from fault with no spot upon her.'" They said, "Now you have come with the truth." So they slaughtered her, but they could hardly do it.
gloss: [rs-a: SAY , COW NOT WORK EARTH , NOT WATER CROP , PERFECT , MARK NONE] . [rs-b: SAY , NOW YOU BRING TRUE] . SACRIFICE , ALMOST NOT DO .

en: This is what We recite to you, [O Muḥammad], of [Our] verses and the precise [and wise] message [i.e., the Qur’ān].
gloss: THIS WE RECITE YOU , VERSE , REMINDER WISE .

en: [Remember] when you [fled and] climbed [the mountain] without looking aside at anyone while the Messenger was calling you from behind. So Allāh repaid you with distress upon distress so you would not grieve for that which had escaped you [of victory and spoils of war] or [for] that which had befallen you [of injury and death]. And Allāh is [fully] Aware of what you do.
gloss: YOU CLIMB , NOT LOOK ANYONE , MESSENGER CALL BEHIND . ALLAH GIVE DISTRESS ON DISTRESS , NOT SAD THING LOSE , THING HIT . ALLAH AWARE YOUR DO .

en: Not equal are those believers remaining [at home] - other than the disabled - and the mujāhideen, [who strive and fight] in the cause of Allāh with their wealth and their lives. Allāh has preferred the mujāhideen through their wealth and their lives over those who remain [behind], by degrees. And to all [i.e., both] Allāh has promised the best [reward]. But Allāh has preferred the mujāhideen over those who remain [behind] with a great reward -
gloss: BELIEVER SIT , NOT SICK , PEOPLE STRIVE ALLAH PATH MONEY , LIFE , [neg: NOT EQUAL] . ALLAH FAVOR STRIVE OVER SIT , LEVEL . ALL ALLAH PROMISE GOOD . ALLAH FAVOR STRIVE OVER SIT , REWARD GREAT ,

en: But if they separate [by divorce], Allāh will enrich each [of them] from His abundance. And ever is Allāh Encompassing and Wise.
gloss: [cond: IF SEPARATE] , ALLAH MAKE EACH RICH FROM FAVOR . ALLAH WIDE , WISE .

en: Say, "With Allāh is the far-reaching [i.e., conclusive] argument. If He had willed, He would have guided you all."
gloss: SAY , [rs-a: ALLAH PROOF FINAL . [cond: IF IX WANT] , GUIDE YOU ALL] .

en: They do not observe toward a believer any pact of kinship or covenant of protection. And it is they who are the transgressors.
gloss: [neg: NOT RESPECT BELIEVER RELATIVE , PROMISE] . THEY TRANSGRESS .

en: Say, "If Allāh had willed, I would not have recited it to you, nor would He have made it known to you, for I had remained among you a lifetime before it. Then will you not reason?"
gloss: SAY , [rs-a: [cond: IF ALLAH WANT] , ME NOT RECITE YOU , IX NOT TELL YOU . ME LIVE WITH YOU LIFE BEFORE . [rhq: YOU NOT UNDERSTAND]] ?

en: Say, "Have you considered: if His punishment should come to you by night or by day - for which [aspect] of it would the criminals be impatient?"
gloss: SAY , [rs-a: [rhq: IF IX PUNISH COME NIGHT OR DAY , SINNER HURRY WHAT]] ?

en: And the brothers of Joseph came [seeking food], and they entered upon him; and he recognized them, but he was to them unknown.
gloss: YUSUF BROTHER+ COME , ENTER . IX KNOW THEM , THEY NOT KNOW IX .

en: It has seven gates; for every gate is of them [i.e., Satan's followers] a portion designated."
gloss: [rs-c: SEVEN DOOR , EACH DOOR GROUP DECIDE] .

en: And We conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning.
gloss: WE DECREE MATTER , THOSE CUT-OFF MORNING .

en: And when We intend to destroy a city, We command its affluent but they defiantly disobey therein; so the word [i.e., deserved decree] comes into effect upon it, and We destroy it with [complete] destruction.
gloss: [top: WE WANT DESTROY CITY] , WE COMMAND RICH PEOPLE , THEY DISOBEY . WORD TRUE , WE DESTROY ALL .

en: So Pharaoh went away, put together his plan, and then came [to Moses].
gloss: PHARAOH GO , GATHER PLAN , COME .

en: When it [i.e., the Hellfire] sees them from a distant place, they will hear its fury and roaring.
gloss: [top: FIRE SEE THEM FROM FAR] , THEY HEAR ANGRY , LOUD .

en: They said, "We are men of strength and of great military might, but the command is yours, so see what you will command."
gloss: [rs-c: THEY SAY , WE STRONG , FIGHT POWER . BUT COMMAND YOUR . YOU DECIDE] .

en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Proceed [i.e., travel] through the land and observe how was the end of the criminals."
gloss: SAY , [rs-a: TRAVEL LAND , LOOK SINNER END HOW] .

en: And prevention will be placed between them and what they desire, as was done with their kind before. Indeed, they were in disquieting doubt [i.e., denial].
gloss: BARRIER BETWEEN THEM , THEIR DESIRE , SAME BEFORE THEIR KIND . THEY DOUBT , WORRY .

en: And they have made [i.e., claimed] between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought [to punishment].
gloss: THEY MAKE ALLAH , JINN RELATIVE . BUT JINN KNOW , THEY BRING PUNISH .

en: Or have they taken other than Allāh as intercessors? Say, "Even though they do not possess [power over] anything, nor do they reason?"
gloss: [rhq: THEY TAKE INTERCEDE BESIDES ALLAH] ? SAY , [rhq: EVEN THEY OWN NOTHING , NOT UNDERSTAND] ?

en: Other than Allāh?" They will say, "They have departed from us; rather, we did not used to invoke previously anything." Thus does Allāh put astray the disbelievers.
gloss: [rs-c: BESIDES ALLAH] ? [rs-b: THEY SAY , LOST FROM US . BEFORE WE NOT CALL ANYTHING] . SAME , ALLAH LET DISBELIEVER ASTRAY .

en: So [even] if they are patient, the Fire is a residence for them; and if they ask to appease [Allāh], they will not be of those who are allowed to appease.
gloss: [cond: IF PATIENT] , FIRE HOME . [cond: IF ASK FORGIVE] , [neg: NOT ACCEPT] .

en: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their companions [i.e., predecessors], so let them not impatiently urge Me.
gloss: [warn: WRONGDOER SHARE , SAME FRIEND BEFORE . NOT HURRY ME] .

en: Do you feel secure that He who is above would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?
gloss: [rhq: YOU-ALL SAFE , ALLAH ABOVE NOT MAKE EARTH SWALLOW YOU , EARTH SHAKE] ?

en: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].
gloss: DISOBEY MESSENGER THEIR LORD , SO LORD PUNISH STRONG .

en: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]
gloss: FIRE CALL PERSON TURN-AWAY , AVOID ,

en: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son
gloss: [rs-b: OUR LORD GREAT HIGH , NOT TAKE WIFE , NOT CHILD] .

en: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allāh upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.
gloss: [rs-b: WE KNOW , WE CAN NOT ESCAPE ALLAH ON EARTH , NOT FLEE] .

en: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,
gloss: [top: PERSON AFRAID STAND BEFORE LORD , STOP SOUL WANT BAD] ,

en: And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure for them, and their father had been righteous. So your Lord intended that they reach maturity and extract their treasure, as a mercy from your Lord. And I did it not of my own accord. That is the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience."
gloss: [rs-b: WALL , BELONG TWO ORPHAN IN CITY . UNDER , TREASURE FOR THEM . FATHER RIGHTEOUS . YOUR LORD WANT THEY GROW MATURITY , TAKE TREASURE , MERCY FROM LORD . ME NOT DO MYSELF . THAT EXPLAIN THING YOU NOT PATIENT] .

en: Insert your hand into the opening of your garment; it will come out white, without disease. And draw in your arm close to you [as prevention] from fear, for those are two proofs from your Lord to Pharaoh and his establishment. Indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient."
gloss: [rs-c: PUT HAND INSIDE CLOTHES , COME OUT WHITE , NOT SICK . HOLD ARM CLOSE , NOT FEAR . THOSE TWO PROOF FROM LORD TO PHARAOH , LEADER+ . THEY DISOBEY PEOPLE] .

en: Wavering between them, [belonging] neither to these [i.e., the believers] nor to those [i.e., the disbelievers]. And whoever Allāh sends astray - never will you find for him a way.
gloss: CONFUSED BETWEEN , NOT WITH THESE , NOT WITH THOSE . PERSON ALLAH LET ASTRAY , [neg: NEVER FIND PATH] .

en: And [it is] so the hearts of those who disbelieve in the Hereafter will incline toward it [i.e., deceptive speech] and that they will be satisfied with it and that they will commit that which they are committing.
gloss: HEART PEOPLE NOT BELIEVE HEREAFTER INCLINE , PLEASED , DO THEIR DO .

en: And leave [i.e., desist from] what is apparent of sin and what is concealed thereof. Indeed, those who earn [blame for] sin will be recompensed for that which they used to commit.
gloss: LEAVE SIN OPEN , HIDDEN . PEOPLE EARN SIN , PAY FOR DO .

en: And you are going to know who will get a punishment that will disgrace him [on earth] and upon whom will descend an enduring punishment [in the Hereafter]."
gloss: [rs-a: LATER YOU KNOW WHO GET PUNISH SHAME , WHO GET PUNISH FOREVER] .

en: And when Our messengers, [the angels], came to Lot, he was anguished for them and felt for them great discomfort and said, "This is a trying day."
gloss: [top: OUR MESSENGER+ COME LUT] , IX WORRY , DISTRESS , [rs-a: SAY , THIS DAY HARD] .

en: So remain on a right course as you have been commanded, [you] and those who have turned back with you [to Allāh], and do not transgress. Indeed, He is Seeing of what you do.
gloss: STRAIGHT , SAME COMMAND , YOU , PEOPLE RETURN WITH YOU . [neg: NOT TRANSGRESS] . IX SEE YOUR DO .

en: Then We revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], to follow the religion of Abraham, inclining toward truth; and he was not of those who associate with Allāh.
gloss: THEN WE REVEAL YOU , FOLLOW IBRAHIM RELIGION , STRAIGHT , [neg: NOT POLYTHEIST] .

en: As for the ship, it belonged to poor people working at sea. So I intended to cause defect in it as there was after them a king who seized every [good] ship by force.
gloss: [rs-b: SHIP , BELONG POOR PEOPLE WORK SEA . ME WANT DAMAGE , BECAUSE KING BEHIND TAKE EVERY SHIP FORCE] .

en: So, [O Muḥammad], We have only made it [i.e., the Qur’ān] easy in your tongue [i.e., the Arabic language] that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people.
gloss: WE MAKE QURAN EASY IN YOUR TONGUE , YOU GIVE GOOD NEWS FEAR-GOD , WARN PEOPLE STUBBORN .

en: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they cannot intercede except on behalf of one whom He approves. And they, from fear of Him, are apprehensive.
gloss: IX KNOW FRONT THEM , BEHIND . [neg: NOT INTERCEDE] EXCEPT FOR PERSON IX PLEASED . THEY FEAR IX .

en: Man was created of haste [i.e., impatience]. I will show you My signs [i.e., vengeance], so do not impatiently urge Me.
gloss: PERSON CREATE HURRY . [rs-c: ME SHOW YOU MY SIGN-PROOF , NOT HURRY ME] .

en: And they rejected them, while their [inner] selves were convinced thereof, out of injustice and haughtiness. So see how was the end of the corrupters.
gloss: THEY DENY , INSIDE KNOW TRUE , UNJUST , PROUD . LOOK CORRUPT END HOW .

en: Those upon whom the word will have come into effect will say, "Our Lord, these are the ones we led to error. We led them to error just as we were in error. We declare our disassociation [from them] to You. They did not used to worship [i.e., obey] us."
gloss: [rs-b: PEOPLE WORD TRUE ON SAY , OUR LORD , THESE WE MISLEAD . WE MISLEAD SAME WE ASTRAY . WE DISASSOCIATE , TO YOU . THEY NOT WORSHIP US] .

en: And they urge you to hasten the punishment. And if not for [the decree of] a specified term, punishment would have reached them. But it will surely come to them suddenly while they perceive not.
gloss: THEY ASK YOU HURRY PUNISH . [cond: IF NOT TERM DECIDE] , PUNISH ALREADY COME . SURE COME SUDDENLY , THEY NOT AWARE .

en: And the evil consequences of what they earned struck them. And those who have wronged of these [people] will be struck [i.e., afflicted] by the evil consequences of what they earned; and they will not cause failure.
gloss: THEIR EVIL EARN HIT THEM . THESE WRONGDOER ALSO , EVIL EARN HIT THEM , [neg: CANNOT ESCAPE] .

en: And they say, "Our hearts are within coverings [i.e., screened] from that to which you invite us, and in our ears is deafness, and between us and you is a partition, so work; indeed, we are working."
gloss: [rs-b: THEY SAY , OUR HEART COVER FROM YOUR CALL , EAR DEAF , BETWEEN US , YOU , WALL . YOU DO , WE DO] .

en: And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth -
gloss: IX SEND-DOWN WATER MEASURE , GIVE LIFE LAND DEAD . SAME , YOU EXIT .

en: Then We put you, [O Muḥammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.
gloss: AFTER , ALLAH PUT YOU ON PATH LAW . FOLLOW , [neg: NOT FOLLOW DESIRE PEOPLE NOT KNOW] .

en: [Theirs is] like the example of those shortly before them: they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment.
gloss: SAME PEOPLE BEFORE , RECENT , TASTE RESULT . PUNISH PAIN .

en: If not that a favor [i.e., mercy] from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured.
gloss: [cond: IF BLESS FROM LORD NOT REACH IX] , THROW ON SHORE , BLAME .

en: They said, "Call upon your Lord to make clear to us what it is." [Moses] said, "[Allāh] says, 'It is a cow which is neither old nor virgin, but median between that,' so do what you are commanded."
gloss: [rs-b: SAY , ASK LORD EXPLAIN WHAT] . [rs-a: SAY , IX SAY , COW NOT OLD , NOT YOUNG , MIDDLE . DO COMMAND] .

en: At that, Zechariah called upon his Lord, saying, "My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication."
gloss: THERE ZAKARIYYA CALL LORD , [rs-a: MY LORD , GIVE ME FROM YOU CHILD GOOD . YOU HEAR DUA] .

en: He said, "O my people, have you considered: if I should be upon clear evidence from my Lord while He has given me mercy from Himself but it has been made unapparent to you, should we force it upon you while you are averse to it?
gloss: [rs-a: NUH SAY , MY PEOPLE , [rhq: IF ME ON PROOF FROM LORD , IX GIVE MERCY , HIDDEN FROM YOU , WE FORCE YOU , YOU HATE]] ?

en: They said, "O Ṣāliḥ, you were among us a man of promise before this. Do you forbid us to worship what our fathers worshipped? And indeed we are, about that to which you invite us, in disquieting doubt."
gloss: [rs-b: THEY SAY , SALIH , BEFORE WE HOPE YOU . [rhq: YOU FORBID US WORSHIP FATHER WORSHIP] ? WE DOUBT , WORRY ABOUT YOUR INVITE] .

en: And when the caravan departed [from Egypt], their father said, "Indeed, I find the smell of Joseph [and would say that he was alive] if you did not think me weakened in mind."
gloss: [top: CAMEL GROUP LEAVE] , [rs-b: FATHER SAY , ME SMELL YUSUF , IF YOU NOT THINK ME CRAZY] .

en: Say, "Invoke those you have claimed [as gods] besides Him, for they do not possess the [ability for] removal of adversity from you or [for its] transfer [to someone else]."
gloss: SAY , [rs-a: CALL THING YOU CLAIM BESIDES IX . THEY NOT OWN POWER REMOVE HARM , NOT CHANGE] .

en: And [mention] the one who guarded her chastity [i.e., Mary], so We blew into her [garment] through Our angel [i.e., Gabriel], and We made her and her son a sign for the worlds.
gloss: WOMAN PROTECT CHASTITY , WE BLOW IN HER OUR SPIRIT , MAKE HER , SON SIGN-PROOF FOR WORLD .

en: O you who have believed, let those whom your right hands possess and those who have not [yet] reached puberty among you ask permission of you [before entering] at three times: before the dawn prayer and when you put aside your clothing [for rest] at noon and after the night prayer. [These are] three times of privacy for you. There is no blame upon you nor upon them beyond these [periods], for they continually circulate among you - some of you, among others. Thus does Allāh make clear to you the verses [i.e., His ordinances]; and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
gloss: BELIEVER , SLAVE , CHILD NOT MATURITY , ASK PERMISSION THREE TIME , BEFORE DAWN PRAY , MIDDLE DAY REMOVE CLOTHES , AFTER NIGHT PRAY . THREE TIME PRIVATE . AFTER , [neg: BLAME NONE] , THEY GO AROUND . SAME , ALLAH EXPLAIN VERSE . ALLAH KNOW , WISE .

en: And the heart of Moses' mother became empty [of all else]. She was about to disclose [the matter concerning] him had We not bound fast her heart that she would be of the believers.
gloss: MUSA MOTHER HEART EMPTY . ALMOST SHOW SECRET , [cond: IF WE NOT STRENGTHEN HEART] , SO SHE BELIEVER .

en: And whoever submits his face [i.e., self] to Allāh while he is a doer of good - then he has grasped the most trustworthy handhold. And to Allāh will be the outcome of [all] matters.
gloss: PERSON SUBMIT FACE TO ALLAH , DO GOOD , HOLD ROPE STRONG MOST . ALL MATTER END WITH ALLAH .

en: And when We bestow favor upon man, he turns away and distances himself; but when evil touches him, then he is full of extensive supplication.
gloss: [top: WHEN ALLAH BLESS PERSON] , TURN-AWAY , GO FAR . [top: WHEN EVIL TOUCH] , PRAY LONG .

en: [Battle in] the sacred month is for [aggression committed in] the sacred month, and for [all] violations is legal retribution. So whoever has assaulted you, then assault him in the same way that he has assaulted you. And fear Allāh and know that Allāh is with those who fear Him.
gloss: MONTH HOLY FOR MONTH HOLY , HOLY THING RETRIBUTION . PERSON ATTACK YOU , ATTACK SAME . FEAR-GOD ALLAH , KNOW ALLAH WITH FEAR-GOD .

en: And do not give the weak-minded your property, which Allāh has made a means of sustenance for you, but provide for them with it and clothe them and speak to them words of appropriate kindness.
gloss: [neg: NOT GIVE FOOL YOUR MONEY] ALLAH MAKE LIFE SUPPORT . FEED THEM , CLOTHES , TALK KIND .

en: Worship Allāh and associate nothing with Him, and to parents do good, and to relatives, orphans, the needy, the near neighbor, the neighbor farther away, the companion at your side, the traveler, and those whom your right hands possess. Indeed, Allāh does not like those who are self-deluding and boastful,
gloss: WORSHIP ALLAH , [neg: NOT ASSOCIATE NOTHING] . GOOD TO PARENTS , RELATIVE , ORPHAN , POOR , NEIGHBOR NEAR , NEIGHBOR FAR , COMPANION SIDE , TRAVELER , SLAVE . ALLAH NOT LIKE ARROGANT , BOAST ,

en: O you who have believed, when you rise to [perform] prayer, wash your faces and your forearms to the elbows and wipe over your heads and wash your feet to the ankles. And if you are in a state of janābah, then purify yourselves. But if you are ill or on a journey or one of you comes from the place of relieving himself or you have contacted women and do not find water, then seek clean earth and wipe over your faces and hands with it. Allāh does not intend to make difficulty for you, but He intends to purify you and complete His favor upon you that you may be grateful.
gloss: BELIEVER , [top: STAND SALAH] , WASH FACE , ARM UNTIL ELBOW , WIPE HEAD , WASH FOOT . [cond: IF fs:JANABAH] , WASH ALL . [cond: IF SICK , TRAVEL , BATHROOM , TOUCH WOMAN , NOT FIND WATER] , SEEK EARTH CLEAN , WIPE FACE , HAND . ALLAH NOT WANT HARD FOR YOU , WANT MAKE YOU PURE , COMPLETE FAVOR , MAYBE THANK .

en: Say to those who have disbelieved [that] if they cease, what has previously occurred will be forgiven for them. But if they return [to hostility] - then the precedent of the former [rebellious] peoples has already taken place.
gloss: SAY DISBELIEVER , [cond: IF STOP] , FORGIVE BEFORE . [cond: IF RETURN] , WAY PEOPLE BEFORE ALREADY HAPPEN .

en: Indeed, Allāh has purchased from the believers their lives and their properties [in exchange] for that they will have Paradise. They fight in the cause of Allāh, so they kill and are killed. [It is] a true promise [binding] upon Him in the Torah and the Gospel and the Qur’ān. And who is truer to his covenant than Allāh? So rejoice in your transaction which you have contracted. And it is that which is the great attainment.
gloss: ALLAH BUY FROM BELIEVER LIFE , MONEY , FOR PARADISE . FIGHT ALLAH PATH , KILL , KILLED . PROMISE TRUE ON IX , fs:TAWRAT , fs:INJIL , QURAN . [rhq: WHO MORE TRUE PROMISE THAN ALLAH] ? [happy: HAPPY YOUR TRADE] . THAT ATTAINMENT GREAT .

en: Say, "I possess not for myself any harm or benefit except what Allāh should will. For every nation is a [specified] term. When their time has come, then they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it]."
gloss: SAY , [rs-a: ME NOT OWN HARM , BENEFIT FOR MYSELF , EXCEPT ALLAH WANT . EVERY NATION TERM . [top: TERM COME] , NOT DELAY HOUR , NOT EARLY] .

en: Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of them [i.e., the disbelievers], and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to the believers.
gloss: [neg: NOT LOOK THING WE GIVE THEM ENJOY , NOT SAD FOR THEM] . LOWER WING FOR BELIEVER .

en: Say, "If mankind and the jinn gathered in order to produce the like of this Qur’ān, they could not produce the like of it, even if they were to each other assistants."
gloss: SAY , [rs-a: [cond: IF PEOPLE , JINN GATHER , MAKE SAME THIS QURAN] , [neg: CANNOT MAKE SAME] , EVEN HELP EACH-OTHER] .

en: So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allāh, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each [of them] We made a prophet.
gloss: [top: IX LEAVE THEM , THEIR GOD+] , WE GIVE IX ISHAQ , YAQUB , EACH PROPHET .

en: And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad] - so, before them, did the people of Noah and ʿAad and Thamūd deny [their prophets],
gloss: [cond: IF THEY DENY YOU] , BEFORE , NUH PEOPLE , fs:AAD , fs:THAMUD DENY ,

en: A Book whose verses have been detailed, an Arabic Qur’ān for a people who know,
gloss: BOOK , SIGN-PROOF EXPLAIN CLEAR , QURAN ARABIC , FOR PEOPLE KNOW ,

en: Say, "Have you considered: if it [i.e., the Qur’ān] was from Allāh, and you disbelieved in it while a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to something similar and believed while you were arrogant...?" Indeed, Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people.
gloss: SAY , [rhq: YOU SEE , IF QURAN FROM ALLAH , YOU-ALL DENY , WITNESS FROM ISRAIL CHILD TESTIFY , BELIEVE , YOU-ALL PROUD] ? ALLAH NOT GUIDE WRONGDOER .

en: And We had certainly established them in such as We have not established you, and We made for them hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]. But their hearing and vision and hearts availed them not from anything [of the punishment] when they were [continually] rejecting the signs of Allāh; and they were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
gloss: ALLAH GIVE THEM POWER , MORE THAN YOU . GIVE HEAR , SEE , HEART . [neg: HEAR , SEE , HEART NOT HELP] , BECAUSE DENY ALLAH SIGN-PROOF . THING THEY MOCK SURROUND THEM .

en: And he who does not find [a slave] - then a fast for two months consecutively before they touch one another; and he who is unable - then the feeding of sixty poor persons. That is for you to believe [completely] in Allāh and His Messenger; and those are the limits [set by] Allāh. And for the disbelievers is a painful punishment.
gloss: [top: PERSON NOT FIND] , FAST TWO MONTH CONTINUE , BEFORE TOUCH . [top: PERSON CAN NOT] , FEED SIXTY POOR . FOR YOU-ALL BELIEVE ALLAH , MESSENGER . THAT ALLAH LIMIT . DISBELIEVER , PUNISH PAIN .

en: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,
gloss: THEY FEED FOOD , [top: EVEN THEY LOVE FOOD] , POOR , ORPHAN , PRISONER .

en: And if only they had upheld [the law of] the Torah, the Gospel, and what has been revealed to them from their Lord [i.e., the Qur’ān], they would have consumed [provision] from above them and from beneath their feet. Among them are a moderate [i.e., acceptable] community, but many of them - evil is that which they do.
gloss: [cond: IF ESTABLISH fs:TAWRAT , fs:INJIL , THING REVEAL FROM LORD] , EAT FROM ABOVE , UNDER FOOT . SOME GROUP MIDDLE , MANY DO EVIL .

en: Then We exchanged in place of the bad [condition], good, until they increased [and prospered] and said, "Our fathers [also] were touched with hardship and ease." So We seized them suddenly while they did not perceive.
gloss: THEN CHANGE BAD TO GOOD , UNTIL GROW MANY , [rs-b: SAY , OUR FATHER ALSO HARD , EASY] . WE CATCH THEM SUDDENLY , NOT AWARE .

en: And know that anything you obtain of war booty - then indeed, for Allāh is one fifth of it and for the Messenger and for [his] near relatives and the orphans, the needy, and the [stranded] traveler, if you have believed in Allāh and in that which We sent down to Our Servant on the day of criterion [i.e., decisive encounter] - the day when the two armies met [at Badr]. And Allāh, over all things, is competent.
gloss: KNOW , SPOILS YOU GET , FIVE PIECE ONE FOR ALLAH , MESSENGER , RELATIVE , ORPHAN , POOR , TRAVELER , IF YOU BELIEVE ALLAH , THING WE SEND-DOWN OUR SERVANT DAY fs:FURQAN , DAY TWO ARMY MEET . ALLAH POWER OVER ALL THING .

en: [Mention, O Muḥammad], the Day We will call forth every people with their record [of deeds]. Then whoever is given his record in his right hand - those will read their records, and injustice will not be done to them, [even] as much as a thread [inside the date seed].
gloss: DAY WE CALL EVERY PEOPLE WITH LEADER . PERSON GET BOOK RIGHT HAND , READ BOOK , [neg: NOT UNFAIR , EVEN FIBER] .

en: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when We designated for Abraham the site of the House, [saying], "Do not associate anything with Me and purify My House for those who perform ṭawāf and those who stand [in prayer] and those who bow and prostrate.
gloss: WE SHOW IBRAHIM PLACE HOUSE , [rs-c: NOT ASSOCIATE ME . MAKE MY HOUSE PURE FOR PEOPLE WALK AROUND , STAND , BOW , PROSTRATE] .

en: And they did not become divided until after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord [postponing the penalty] until a specified time, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, those who were granted inheritance of the Scripture after them are, concerning it, in disquieting doubt.
gloss: [neg: THEY NOT DIVIDE , ONLY AFTER KNOWLEDGE COME , JEALOUS EACH-OTHER] . [cond: IF NOT WORD FROM LORD BEFORE , TIME DECIDE] , JUDGE . PEOPLE INHERIT BOOK AFTER , DOUBT .

en: [Moses] said, "My Lord, indeed I do not possess [i.e., control] except myself and my brother, so part us from the defiantly disobedient people."
gloss: [rs-a: MUSA SAY , MY LORD , ME CONTROL ONLY MYSELF , BROTHER . SEPARATE US FROM DISOBEY PEOPLE] .

en: O you who have believed, do not ask about things which, if they are shown to you, will distress you. But if you ask about them while the Qur’ān is being revealed, they will be shown to you. Allāh has pardoned it [i.e., that which is past]; and Allāh is Forgiving and Forbearing.
gloss: BELIEVER , [neg: NOT ASK THING , IF SHOW , MAKE YOU SAD] . [cond: IF ASK WHILE QURAN REVEAL] , SHOW . ALLAH PARDON . ALLAH FORGIVE , PATIENT .

en: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allāh that you might succeed."
gloss: [rs-a: [rhq: YOU SURPRISE REMINDER COME , MAN FROM YOU , WARN] ? REMEMBER IX MAKE YOU SUCCESSOR AFTER NUH PEOPLE , ADD BODY BIG . REMEMBER ALLAH FAVOR , MAYBE WIN] .

en: It was said, "O Noah, disembark in security from Us and blessings upon you and upon nations [descending] from those with you. But other nations [of them] We will grant enjoyment; then there will touch them from Us a painful punishment."
gloss: [rs-c: NUH , GO DOWN , PEACE FROM US , BLESS ON YOU , NATION WITH YOU . OTHER NATION WE GIVE ENJOY , THEN PUNISH PAIN TOUCH] .

en: And O my people, let not [your] dissension from me cause you to be struck by that similar to what struck the people of Noah or the people of Hūd or the people of Ṣāliḥ. And the people of Lot are not from you far away.
gloss: [rs-a: MY PEOPLE , YOUR ARGUE ME , NOT MAKE YOU HIT SAME NUH PEOPLE , HUD PEOPLE , SALIH PEOPLE . LUT PEOPLE NOT FAR] .

en: And I do not acquit myself. Indeed, the soul is a persistent enjoiner of evil, except those upon which my Lord has mercy. Indeed, my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful."
gloss: [rs-b: ME NOT SAY MYSELF CLEAN . SOUL COMMAND EVIL , EXCEPT MY LORD MERCY . MY LORD FORGIVE , MERCIFUL] .

en: And We have certainly presented to the people in this Qur’ān from every [kind of] example. But, [O Muḥammad], if you should bring them a sign, the disbelievers will surely say, "You [believers] are but falsifiers."
gloss: WE GIVE PEOPLE IN QURAN EVERY KIND EXAMPLE . [cond: IF YOU BRING SIGN-PROOF] , [rs-b: DISBELIEVER SAY , YOU ONLY FALSE] .

en: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muḥammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allāh determines [the extent of] the night and the day.
