He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur’ān. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allāh and others fighting for the cause of Allāh. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakāh and loan Allāh a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allāh. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
gloss: [aff: YOUR LORD KNOW , YOU STAND PRAY NIGHT , ALMOST TWO THIRD , HALF , ONE THIRD , ALSO GROUP WITH YOU] . ALLAH MEASURE NIGHT , DAY . KNOW YOU-ALL CAN NOT COUNT , SO FORGIVE YOU-ALL . RECITE QURAN , EASY FOR YOU . KNOW SOME SICK , SOME TRAVEL SEEK ALLAH BLESS , SOME FIGHT FOR ALLAH . SO RECITE EASY , PRAY , GIVE CHARITY , GIVE ALLAH LOAN GOOD . GOOD YOU SEND BEFORE , FIND WITH ALLAH , BETTER , REWARD BIG . ASK ALLAH FORGIVE . ALLAH FORGIVE , MERCIFUL .

en: And when it is said to them, "Do not cause corruption on the earth," they say, "We are but reformers."
gloss: [top: TELL THEM , NOT CORRUPT EARTH] , [rs-b: SAY , WE ONLY FIX] .

en: Deaf, dumb and blind - so they will not return [to the right path].
gloss: DEAF , NOT TALK , BLIND , [neg: NOT RETURN] .

en: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I will make upon the earth a successive authority." They said, "Will You place upon it one who causes corruption therein and sheds blood, while we exalt You with praise and declare Your perfection?" He [Allāh] said, "Indeed, I know that which you do not know."
gloss: YOUR LORD SAY ANGEL , [rs-c: ME PUT ON EARTH SUCCESSOR] . [rs-b: ANGEL SAY , [rhq: YOU PUT PERSON CORRUPT , BLOOD POUR , WE PRAISE GLORY YOU , HOLY]] ? [rs-c: IX SAY , ME KNOW THING YOU NOT KNOW] .

en: And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we can never endure one [kind of] food. So call upon your Lord to bring forth for us from the earth its green herbs and its cucumbers and its garlic and its lentils and its onions." [Moses] said, "Would you exchange what is better for what is less? Go into [any] settlement and indeed, you will have what you have asked." And they were covered with humiliation and poverty and returned with anger from Allāh [upon them]. That was because they [repeatedly] disbelieved in the signs of Allāh and killed the prophets without right. That was because they disobeyed and were [habitually] transgressing.
gloss: [rs-b: YOU SAY , MUSA , WE CANNOT PATIENT ONE FOOD . ASK LORD BRING FROM EARTH PLANT , VEGETABLE , fs:GARLIC , fs:LENTIL , fs:ONION] . [rs-a: MUSA SAY , [rhq: YOU EXCHANGE BETTER FOR LESS] ? GO CITY , YOU GET THING ASK] . SHAME , POOR COVER THEM , RETURN ALLAH ANGRY . BECAUSE DENY ALLAH SIGN-PROOF , KILL PROPHET+ WITHOUT RIGHT , DISOBEY , TRANSGRESS .

en: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised."
gloss: YOU KNOW PEOPLE TRANSGRESS fs:SABBATH . [rs-c: WE SAY , BECOME fs:APE , HUMILIATE] .

en: For each [religious following] is a [prayer] direction toward which it faces. So race to [all that is] good. Wherever you may be, Allāh will bring you forth [for judgement] all together. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.
gloss: EACH HAVE WAY FACE . RACE GOOD . WHEREVER YOU , ALLAH BRING YOU ALL . ALLAH POWER OVER ALL THING .

en: And do not consume one another's wealth unjustly or send it [in bribery] to the rulers in order that [they might aid] you [to] consume a portion of the wealth of the people in sin, while you know [it is unlawful].
gloss: [neg: NOT EAT EACH-OTHER MONEY UNFAIR , NOT GIVE JUDGE , EAT PEOPLE MONEY SIN] , YOU KNOW .

en: Maintain with care the [obligatory] prayers and [in particular] the middle [i.e., ʿaṣr] prayer and stand before Allāh, devoutly obedient.
gloss: PROTECT SALAH , SALAH MIDDLE . STAND FRONT ALLAH , OBEY .

en: And the example of those who spend their wealth seeking means to the approval of Allāh and assuring [reward for] themselves is like a garden on high ground which is hit by a downpour - so it yields its fruits in double. And [even] if it is not hit by a downpour, then a drizzle [is sufficient]. And Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.
gloss: PEOPLE SPEND , WANT ALLAH PLEASED , STRENGTHEN SELF , EXAMPLE GARDEN HIGH , RAIN HIT , FRUIT DOUBLE . [cond: IF NOT RAIN] , LITTLE RAIN ENOUGH . ALLAH SEE YOUR DO .

en: Allāh destroys interest and gives increase for charities. And Allāh does not like every sinning disbeliever.
gloss: ALLAH DESTROY fs:RIBA , GROW CHARITY . ALLAH NOT LIKE SINNER UNGRATEFUL .

en: Not for you, [O Muḥammad, but for Allāh], is the decision whether He should [cut them down] or forgive them or punish them, for indeed, they are wrongdoers.
gloss: [neg: NOT YOUR DECIDE] , IX FORGIVE OR PUNISH . THEY WRONGDOER .

en: This [Qur’ān] is a clear statement to [all] the people and a guidance and instruction for those conscious of Allāh.
gloss: THIS EXPLAIN FOR PEOPLE , GUIDE , TEACH FOR FEAR-GOD .

en: Be not deceived by the [uninhibited] movement of the disbelievers throughout the land.
gloss: [neg: NOT DECEIVE DISBELIEVER TRAVEL LAND] .

en: They used not to prevent one another from wrongdoing that they did. How wretched was that which they were doing.
gloss: [neg: NOT FORBID EACH-OTHER EVIL DO] . [warn: THEIR DO WRETCHED] .

en: And they prevent [others] from him and are [themselves] remote from him. And they do not destroy except themselves, but they perceive [it] not.
gloss: THEY BLOCK PEOPLE , GO FAR SELF . DESTROY ONLY SELF , NOT AWARE .

en: There has come to you enlightenment from your Lord. So whoever will see does so for [the benefit of] his soul, and whoever is blind [does harm] against it. And [say], "I am not a guardian over you."
gloss: SEE CLEAR COME FROM YOUR LORD . PERSON SEE , FOR SELF . PERSON BLIND , AGAINST SELF . [rs-a: ME NOT GUARDIAN OVER YOU] .

en: Whoever comes [on the Day of Judgement] with a good deed will have ten times the like thereof [to his credit], and whoever comes with an evil deed will not be recompensed except the like thereof; and they will not be wronged.
gloss: PERSON COME WITH GOOD , GET TEN TIME SAME . PERSON COME WITH EVIL , PAY ONLY SAME . [neg: NOT UNFAIR] .

en: [Allāh] said, "Descend from it [i.e., Paradise], for it is not for you to be arrogant therein. So get out; indeed, you are of the debased."
gloss: [rs-c: ALLAH SAY , GO DOWN . NOT FITTING YOU ARROGANT THERE . GO OUT , YOU HUMBLE LOW] .

en: [Allāh] said, "Indeed, you are of those reprieved."
gloss: [rs-c: ALLAH SAY , YOU DELAY] .

en: And he swore [by Allāh] to them, "Indeed, I am to you from among the sincere advisors."
gloss: [rs-b: SWEAR , ME ADVISE YOU SINCERE] .

en: And for every nation is a [specified] term. So when their time has come, they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it].
gloss: EVERY NATION TERM . [top: TERM COME] , NOT DELAY HOUR , NOT EARLY .

en: And the companions of the Elevations will call to men [within Hell] whom they recognize by their mark, saying, "Of no avail to you was your gathering and [the fact] that you were arrogant."
gloss: HIGH PLACE COMPANION CALL MAN+ KNOW BY MARK , [rs-a: YOUR GATHER , YOUR ARROGANT NOT HELP] .

en: So the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone.
gloss: EARTH SHAKE CATCH THEM , MORNING FALLEN IN HOME .

en: So the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone.
gloss: EARTH SHAKE CATCH THEM , MORNING FALLEN IN HOME .

en: So when they were insolent about that which they had been forbidden, We said to them, "Be apes, despised."
gloss: [top: PROUD AGAINST FORBID] , [rs-c: WE SAY , BECOME fs:APE , HUMILIATE] .

en: And remember your Lord within yourself in humility and in fear without being apparent in speech - in the mornings and the evenings. And do not be among the heedless.
gloss: REMEMBER YOUR LORD INSIDE SELF , HUMBLE , FEAR , NOT LOUD , MORNING , EVENING . [neg: NOT BECOME UNAWARE] .

en: [Remember] when He overwhelmed you with drowsiness [giving] security from Him and sent down upon you from the sky, rain by which to purify you and remove from you the evil [suggestions] of Satan and to make steadfast your hearts and plant firmly thereby your feet.
gloss: IX COVER YOU SLEEP , SAFE FROM IX . SEND-DOWN RAIN , MAKE YOU PURE , REMOVE DEVIL DIRTY , STRENGTHEN HEART , FOOT FIRM .

en: And let not those who disbelieve think they will escape. Indeed, they will not cause failure [to Allāh].
gloss: [neg: DISBELIEVER NOT THINK ESCAPE] . [neg: CANNOT ESCAPE] .

en: O you who have believed, indeed the polytheists are unclean, so let them not approach al-Masjid al-Ḥarām after this, their [final] year. And if you fear privation, Allāh will enrich you from His bounty if He wills. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
gloss: BELIEVER , POLYTHEIST DIRTY , [neg: NOT COME NEAR MASJID-HARAM] AFTER THIS YEAR . [cond: IF YOU FEAR POOR] , ALLAH MAKE YOU RICH FROM FAVOR , IF IX WANT . ALLAH KNOW , WISE .

en: Allāh has pardoned you, [O Muḥammad, but] why did you give them permission [to remain behind]? [You should not have] until it was evident to you who were truthful and you knew [who were] the liars.
gloss: ALLAH PARDON YOU . [wh: WHY YOU ALLOW THEM , BEFORE CLEAR WHO TRUE , WHO LIAR] ?

en: And among them are some who criticize you concerning the [distribution of] charities. If they are given from them, they approve; but if they are not given from them, at once they become angry.
gloss: SOME BLAME YOU ABOUT CHARITY . [cond: IF GET] , PLEASED . [cond: IF NOT GET] , IMMEDIATELY ANGRY .

en: And mankind was not but one community [united in religion], but [then] they differed. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it would have been judged between them [immediately] concerning that over which they differ.
gloss: PEOPLE BEFORE ONE NATION , THEN DISAGREE . [cond: IF NOT WORD BEFORE FROM LORD] , JUDGE BETWEEN NOW .

en: And it was not [possible] for this Qur’ān to be produced by other than Allāh, but [it is] a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of the [former] Scripture, about which there is no doubt, from the Lord of the worlds.
gloss: THIS QURAN [neg: NOT INVENT BESIDES ALLAH] . CONFIRM BEFORE , EXPLAIN-DETAIL BOOK , [neg: DOUBT NONE] , FROM LORD ALL WORLD .

en: And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad], then say, "For me are my deeds, and for you are your deeds. You are disassociated from what I do, and I am disassociated from what you do."
gloss: [cond: IF THEY DENY YOU] , SAY , [rs-a: MY DO FOR ME , YOUR DO FOR YOU . YOU FREE FROM MY DO , ME FREE FROM YOUR DO] .

en: And among them are those who listen to you. But can you cause the deaf to hear [i.e., benefit from this hearing], although they will not use reason?
gloss: SOME LISTEN YOU . [rhq: YOU MAKE DEAF HEAR , NOT UNDERSTAND] ?

en: Then is it that when it has [actually] occurred you will believe in it? Now? And you were [once] for it impatient.
gloss: [rhq: AFTER HAPPEN , YOU BELIEVE] ? [rs-c: NOW ? BEFORE YOU HURRY] .

en: And they ask information of you, [O Muḥammad], "Is it true?" Say, "Yes, by my Lord. Indeed, it is truth; and you will not cause failure [to Allāh]."
gloss: THEY ASK YOU , [rs-b: [yn: TRUE]] ? SAY , [rs-a: YES , SWEAR MY LORD , TRUE . YOU CANNOT ESCAPE] .

en: [So it was], until when Our command came and the oven overflowed, We said, "Load upon it [i.e., the ship] of each [creature] two mates and your family, except those about whom the word [i.e., decree] has preceded, and [include] whoever has believed." But none had believed with him, except a few.
gloss: UNTIL OUR COMMAND COME , WATER BURST , [rs-c: WE SAY , PUT IN EACH ANIMAL PAIR , FAMILY , EXCEPT WORD DECIDE , BELIEVER] . FEW BELIEVE WITH IX .

en: O my people, I do not ask you for it [i.e., my advice] any reward. My reward is only from the one who created me. Then will you not reason?
gloss: [rs-a: MY PEOPLE , ME NOT ASK PAYMENT . MY PAYMENT ONLY FROM IX CREATE ME . [rhq: YOU NOT UNDERSTAND]] ?

en: Other than Him. So plot against me all together; then do not give me respite.
gloss: [rs-a: BESIDES IX . PLAN AGAINST ME ALL , NOT DELAY] .

en: Indeed, Abraham was forbearing, grieving and [frequently] returning [to Allāh].
gloss: IBRAHIM PATIENT , SAD , RETURN .

en: They said, "You have already known that we have not concerning your daughters [i.e., women] any claim [i.e., desire], and indeed, you know what we want."
gloss: [rs-b: THEY SAY , YOU KNOW WE NOT WANT YOUR DAUGHTER . YOU KNOW WE WANT WHAT] .

en: And thus is the seizure of your Lord when He seizes the cities while they are committing wrong. Indeed, His seizure is painful and severe.
gloss: SAME , YOUR LORD CATCH CITY WRONGDOER . IX CATCH PAIN , STRONG .

en: And as for those who were [destined to be] prosperous, they will be in Paradise, abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Lord should will - a bestowal uninterrupted.
gloss: HAPPY , IN PARADISE , STAY WHILE SKY , EARTH LAST , EXCEPT YOUR LORD WANT . GIFT NEVER STOP .

en: She said, "That is the one about whom you blamed me. And I certainly sought to seduce him, but he firmly refused; and if he will not do what I order him, he will surely be imprisoned and will be of those debased."
gloss: [rs-b: SHE SAY , THIS PERSON YOU BLAME ME . ME TRY SEDUCE , IX REFUSE . [cond: IF IX NOT DO ME COMMAND] , PRISONER , HUMILIATE] .

en: Then it appeared to them after they had seen the signs that he [i.e., al-ʿAzeez] should surely imprison him for a time.
gloss: AFTER SEE SIGN-PROOF , THEY DECIDE PUT IX PRISON TIME .

en: They said while approaching them, "What is it you are missing?"
gloss: [rs-c: THEY SAY , COME CLOSE , [wh: WHAT YOU LOSE]] ?

en: They said, "We are missing the measure of the king. And for he who produces it is [the reward of] a camel's load, and I am responsible for it."
gloss: [rs-b: SAY , WE LOSE KING CUP . PERSON BRING , GET CAMEL LOAD . ME RESPONSIBLE] .

en: They said, "By Allāh, you have certainly known that we did not come to cause corruption in the land, and we have not been thieves."
gloss: [rs-c: THEY SAY , SWEAR ALLAH , YOU KNOW WE NOT COME CORRUPT LAND , WE NOT STEAL] .

en: And most of the people, although you strive [for it], are not believers.
gloss: MOST PEOPLE , EVEN YOU WANT , [neg: NOT BELIEVER] .

en: It is the same [to Him] concerning you whether one conceals [his] speech or publicizes it and whether one is hidden by night or conspicuous [among others] by day.
gloss: SAME FOR IX , PERSON HIDE TALK OR SHOW , HIDE NIGHT OR WALK DAY .

en: And the example of a bad word is like a bad tree, uprooted from the surface of the earth, not having any stability.
gloss: WORD BAD SAME TREE BAD , PULL-OUT FROM EARTH , [neg: FIRM NONE] .

en: Racing ahead, their heads raised up, their glance does not come back to them, and their hearts are void.
gloss: RUSH , HEAD UP , EYE NOT BLINK , HEART EMPTY .

en: [It will be] on the Day the earth will be replaced by another earth, and the heavens [as well], and they [i.e., all creatures] will come out before Allāh, the One, the Prevailing,
gloss: DAY EARTH CHANGE OTHER EARTH , SKY ALSO . ALL COME FRONT ALLAH , ONE , MIGHTY .

en: And you will see the criminals that Day bound together in irons,
gloss: YOU SEE SINNER THAT DAY CHAIN TOGETHER .

en: Indeed, it is We who sent down the message [i.e., the Qur’ān], and indeed, We will be its guardian.
gloss: [aff: WE SEND-DOWN REMINDER , WE PROTECT IT] .

en: Thus do We insert it [i.e., denial] into the hearts of the criminals.
gloss: SAME , WE PUT DENY IN SINNER HEART .

en: [Allāh] said, "O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"
gloss: [rs-c: ALLAH SAY , fs:IBLIS , [wh: WHY YOU NOT PROSTRATE]] ?

en: [Allāh] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
gloss: [rs-c: ALLAH SAY , YOU DELAY] ,

en: He said, "Indeed, you are people unknown."
gloss: [rs-a: IX SAY , YOU PEOPLE NOT-KNOW] .

en: And We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay.
gloss: WE TURN CITY UP DOWN , RAIN STONE CLAY .

en: Indeed in that are signs for those who discern.
gloss: SIGN-PROOF FOR PEOPLE SEE .

en: And indeed, they [i.e., those cities] are [situated] on an established road.
gloss: CITY ON ROAD STAY .

en: But the shriek seized them at early morning,
gloss: SHOUT CATCH THEM MORNING ,

en: So nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn.
gloss: THEIR EARN [neg: NOT HELP] .

en: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers
gloss: WE ENOUGH FOR YOU AGAINST MOCK PEOPLE ,

en: Indeed, Our word to a thing when We intend it is but that We say to it, "Be," and it is.
gloss: [top: WE WANT THING] , OUR WORD ONLY SAY , fs:KUN , HAPPEN .

en: But if they turn away, [O Muḥammad] - then only upon you is [responsibility for] clear notification.
gloss: [cond: IF TURN-AWAY] , YOU ONLY CONVEY CLEAR .

en: Whatever you have will end, but what Allāh has is lasting. And We will surely give those who were patient their reward according to the best of what they used to do.
gloss: YOUR THING FINISH . ALLAH THING STAY . WE REWARD PATIENT BEST THEIR DO .

en: Indeed, Abraham was a [comprehensive] leader, devoutly obedient to Allāh, inclining toward truth, and he was not of those who associate others with Allāh.
gloss: IBRAHIM LEADER , OBEY ALLAH , STRAIGHT , [neg: NOT POLYTHEIST] .

en: [Then Allāh said], "It is expected, [if you repent], that your Lord will have mercy upon you. But if you return [to sin], We will return [to punishment]. And We have made Hell, for the disbelievers, a prison-bed."
gloss: [rs-c: MAYBE YOUR LORD MERCY YOU . [cond: IF YOU RETURN] , WE RETURN . WE MAKE HELL PRISONER PLACE FOR DISBELIEVER] .

en: But whoever desires the Hereafter and exerts the effort due to it while he is a believer - it is those whose effort is ever appreciated [by Allāh].
gloss: PERSON WANT HEREAFTER , STRIVE , BELIEVER , THEIR STRIVE THANK .

en: And do not walk upon the earth exultantly. Indeed, you will never tear the earth [apart], and you will never reach the mountains in height.
gloss: [neg: NOT WALK EARTH PROUD] . YOU [neg: CANNOT BREAK EARTH , CANNOT REACH MOUNTAIN HIGH] .

en: And indeed, they were about to tempt you away from that which We revealed to you in order to [make] you invent about Us something else; and then they would have taken you as a friend.
gloss: THEY ALMOST MISLEAD YOU FROM THING WE REVEAL , YOU INVENT OTHER . THEN THEY TAKE YOU FRIEND .

en: And from [part of] the night, pray with it [i.e., recitation of the Qur’ān] as additional [worship] for you; it is expected that your Lord will resurrect you to a praised station.
gloss: NIGHT , PRAY ADD FOR YOU . MAYBE YOUR LORD RAISE YOU PLACE PRAISE .

en: And indeed, We will make that which is upon it [into] a barren ground.
gloss: WE MAKE EARTH DRY , EMPTY .

en: He said, "Did you see when we retired to the rock? Indeed, I forgot [there] the fish. And none made me forget it except Satan - that I should mention it. And it took its course into the sea amazingly."
gloss: [rs-b: SERVANT SAY , [yn: YOU REMEMBER WE REST ROCK] ? ME FORGET FISH . DEVIL MAKE ME FORGET TELL . FISH GO SEA , WONDER] .

en: He said, "Indeed, with me you will never be able to have patience.
gloss: [rs-b: IX SAY , YOU NEVER PATIENT WITH ME] .

en: [Al-Khiḍr] said, "Did I not tell you that with me you would never be able to have patience?"
gloss: [rs-b: IX SAY , [rhq: ME NOT TELL YOU , YOU NEVER PATIENT]] ?

en: Thus. And We had encompassed [all] that he had in knowledge.
gloss: SAME . WE KNOW ALL IX HAVE .

en: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength [i.e., manpower]; I will make between you and them a dam.
gloss: [rs-a: IX SAY , MY LORD GIVE ME BETTER . HELP ME STRONG , ME BUILD WALL BETWEEN] .

en: So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [Allāh] in the morning and afternoon.
gloss: IX COME OUT FROM PRAY ROOM , SIGN TO PEOPLE , [rs-a: PRAISE GLORY MORNING , EVENING] .

en: And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allāh
gloss: LOVE FROM US , PURE . IX FEAR-GOD ,

en: And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant.
gloss: GOOD TO PARENTS , [neg: NOT DISOBEY , NOT CRUEL] .

en: And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant.
gloss: [rs-a: GOOD TO MY MOTHER . IX NOT MAKE ME CRUEL , WRETCHED] .

en: And man [i.e., the disbeliever] says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive?"
gloss: [rs-b: PERSON SAY , [rhq: ME DIE , ME BRING OUT ALIVE]] ?

en: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance?
gloss: [rhq: HOW-MANY GENERATION WE DESTROY BEFORE , THING MORE , LOOK BETTER] ?

en: No! They [i.e., those "gods"] will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement].
gloss: [neg: NO] ! GOD+ DENY THEIR WORSHIP , BECOME ENEMY .

en: He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting.
gloss: IX COUNT THEM , COUNT EXACT .

en: And ease for me my task
gloss: [rs-a: MAKE MY MATTER EASY] ,

en: And appoint for me a minister [i.e., assistant] from my family -
gloss: [rs-a: GIVE ME HELPER FROM MY FAMILY] ,

en: And let him share my task
gloss: [rs-a: SHARE MY MATTER] ,

en: And I produced you for Myself.
gloss: [rs-c: ME CHOOSE YOU FOR ME] .

en: [Pharaoh] said, "Then what is the case of the former generations?"
gloss: [rs-b: PHARAOH SAY , [wh: GENERATION BEFORE , WHAT]] ?

en: [It is He] who has made for you the earth as a bed [spread out] and inserted therein for you roadways and sent down from the sky, rain and produced thereby categories of various plants.
gloss: IX MAKE EARTH BED , ROAD+ , SEND-DOWN RAIN , GROW PLANT DIFFERENT KIND .

en: [Allāh said], "And what made you hasten from your people, O Moses?"
gloss: [rs-c: [wh: WHY YOU HURRY FROM PEOPLE , MUSA]] ?

en: Then Satan whispered to him; he said, "O Adam, shall I direct you to the tree of eternity and possession that will not deteriorate?"
gloss: DEVIL WHISPER , [rs-b: ADAM , [yn: ME SHOW YOU TREE FOREVER , KINGDOM NEVER END]] ?

en: And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it [i.e., punishment] would have been an obligation [due immediately], and [if not for] a specified term [decreed].
gloss: [cond: IF NOT WORD BEFORE FROM LORD , TERM DECIDE] , PUNISH COME NOW .

en: [Some angels said], "Do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned."
gloss: [rs-c: NOT RUN . RETURN YOUR RICH LIFE , HOME , MAYBE ASK YOU] .

en: And We did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die - would they be eternal?
gloss: WE NOT GIVE PERSON BEFORE YOU LIVE FOREVER . [rhq: IF YOU DIE , THEY LIVE FOREVER] ?

en: And We had certainly given Abraham his sound judgement before, and We were of him well-Knowing
gloss: BEFORE , WE GIVE IBRAHIM WISDOM . WE KNOW IX .

en: They said, "Have you come to us with truth, or are you of those who jest?"
gloss: [rs-b: THEY SAY , [yn: YOU BRING TRUE , OR YOU PLAY]] ?

en: He said, "Rather, this - the largest of them - did it, so ask them, if they should [be able to] speak."
gloss: [rs-a: IX SAY , NO , THIS BIG ONE DO . ASK THEM , IF THEY TALK] .

en: He invokes instead of Allāh that which neither harms him nor benefits him. That is what is the extreme error.
gloss: CALL BESIDES ALLAH THING [neg: NOT HARM , NOT BENEFIT] . THAT ASTRAY FAR .

en: That they may witness [i.e., attend] benefits for themselves and mention the name of Allāh on known [i.e., specific] days over what He has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals. So eat of them and feed the miserable and poor.
gloss: [rs-c: WITNESS BENEFIT , MENTION ALLAH NAME DAY KNOWN OVER ANIMAL IX PROVIDE . EAT , FEED POOR] .

en: That [is so]. And whoever honors the symbols [i.e., rites] of Allāh - indeed, it is from the piety of hearts.
gloss: THAT . PERSON RESPECT ALLAH SIGN , FROM HEART FEAR-GOD .

en: And the inhabitants of Madyan. And Moses was denied, so I prolonged enjoyment for the disbelievers; then I seized them, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
gloss: fs:MADYAN PEOPLE . MUSA DENY . ME DELAY DISBELIEVER , THEN CATCH . [awe: MY PUNISH HOW TERRIBLE] .

en: And they who are observant of zakāh
gloss: GIVE ZAKAT ,

en: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they will not be blamed -
gloss: EXCEPT WIFE , SLAVE . [neg: BLAME NONE] .

en: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay.
gloss: WE CREATE PERSON FROM CLAY PURE .

en: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb].
gloss: THEN PUT SPERM IN PLACE SAFE .

en: Then We produced after them other generations.
gloss: THEN AFTER , WE CREATE GENERATION+ OTHER .

en: Then have they not reflected over the word [i.e., the Qur’ān], or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers?
gloss: [rhq: THEY NOT THINK ABOUT WORD ? OR COME THING NOT COME FATHER BEFORE] ?

en: Or do they say, "In him is madness"? Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse.
gloss: [rhq: OR SAY , IX CRAZY] ? NO , IX BRING TRUE . MOST HATE TRUE .

en: And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.
gloss: IX SPREAD YOU ON EARTH . TO IX YOU GATHER .

en: Rather, they say like what the former peoples said.
gloss: NO , THEY SAY SAME PEOPLE BEFORE .

en: But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.
gloss: [rs-c: YOU MOCK THEM , UNTIL YOU FORGET REMEMBER ME , YOU LAUGH THEM] .

en: [Allāh] will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years?"
gloss: [rs-c: IX SAY , YOU STAY EARTH HOW-MANY YEAR] ?

en: And marry the unmarried among you and the righteous among your male slaves and female slaves. If they should be poor, Allāh will enrich them from His bounty, and Allāh is all-Encompassing and Knowing.
gloss: MARRY SINGLE AMONG YOU , RIGHTEOUS SLAVE MAN , WOMAN . [cond: IF POOR] , ALLAH MAKE RICH FROM FAVOR . ALLAH WIDE , KNOW .

en: But if the right is theirs, they come to him in prompt obedience.
gloss: [cond: IF RIGHT FOR THEM] , COME QUICK OBEY .

en: And those who disbelieve say, "Why was the Qur’ān not revealed to him all at once?" Thus [it is] that We may strengthen thereby your heart. And We have spaced it distinctly.
gloss: [rs-b: DISBELIEVER SAY , [wh: WHY QURAN NOT SEND-DOWN ALL ONE TIME]] ? SAME , WE STRENGTHEN YOUR HEART . WE RECITE PIECE+ SLOW .

en: And for each We presented examples [as warnings], and each We destroyed with [total] destruction.
gloss: EACH WE GIVE EXAMPLE , EACH WE DESTROY ALL .

en: Those will be awarded the Chamber for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace,
gloss: THEY GET ROOM HIGH BECAUSE PATIENT , WELCOME , [happy: SALAM] ,

en: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"
gloss: [rs-c: LET ISRAIL CHILD GO WITH US] .

en: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate.
gloss: [rs-c: TELL PEOPLE , [yn: YOU GATHER]] ,

en: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."
gloss: [rs-b: PHARAOH SAY , YES , YOU CLOSE TO ME] .

en: And indeed, we are a cautious society..."
gloss: [rs-b: WE GROUP CAREFUL] .

en: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?
gloss: [rs-a: IX SAY , [yn: THEY HEAR YOU CALL]] ?

en: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life
gloss: [rs-a: IX MAKE ME DIE , THEN GIVE LIFE] ,

en: And not a devoted friend.
gloss: [rs-b: FRIEND CLOSE NONE] .

en: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
gloss: BROTHER NUH SAY , [rs-a: [rhq: YOU NOT FEAR-GOD]] ?

en: When their brother Hūd said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
gloss: BROTHER HUD SAY , [rs-a: [rhq: YOU NOT FEAR-GOD]] ?

en: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.
gloss: [rs-a: [top: YOU HIT] , HIT CRUEL] .

en: Provided you with grazing livestock and children
gloss: [rs-a: GIVE YOU ANIMAL , CHILD] ,

en: When their brother Ṣāliḥ said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
gloss: BROTHER SALIH SAY , [rs-a: [rhq: YOU NOT FEAR-GOD]] ?

en: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
gloss: [rs-b: THEY SAY , YOU ONLY MAGIC HIT] .

en: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.
gloss: THEY CUT CAMEL , THEN REGRET .

en: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
gloss: [rs-b: THEY SAY , YOU ONLY MAGIC HIT] .

en: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners
gloss: [cond: IF WE REVEAL TO PERSON NOT ARABIC] ,

en: Thus have We inserted it [i.e., disbelief] into the hearts of the criminals.
gloss: SAME , WE PUT DISBELIEVE IN SINNER HEART .

en: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.
gloss: COME SUDDENLY , THEY NOT AWARE .

en: So for Our punishment are they impatient?
gloss: [rhq: THEY HURRY OUR PUNISH] ?

en: And warn, [O Muḥammad], your closest kindred.
gloss: WARN YOUR RELATIVE CLOSE .

en: Who sees you when you arise
gloss: IX SEE YOU WHEN STAND ,

en: And your movement among those who prostrate.
gloss: YOUR MOVE AMONG PEOPLE PROSTRATE .

en: But when there came to them Our visible signs, they said, "This is obvious magic."
gloss: [top: OUR SIGN-PROOF CLEAR COME THEM] , [rs-b: SAY , THIS MAGIC CLEAR] .

en: I will surely punish him with a severe punishment or slaughter him unless he brings me clear authorization."
gloss: [rs-a: ME PUNISH IX STRONG , OR KILL , UNLESS IX BRING REASON CLEAR] .

en: But he [i.e., the hoopoe] stayed not long and said, "I have encompassed [in knowledge] that which you have not encompassed, and I have come to you from Sheba with certain news.
gloss: NOT LONG , BIRD COME , [rs-b: SAY , ME KNOW THING YOU NOT KNOW . ME COME FROM fs:SABA , NEWS SURE] .

en: She said, "O eminent ones, indeed, to me has been delivered a noble letter.
gloss: [rs-b: SHE SAY , LEADER+ , ME GET LETTERS HONOR] .

en: He said, "Disguise for her her throne; we will see whether she will be guided [to truth] or will be of those who is not guided."
gloss: [rs-a: CHANGE HER THRONE . WE SEE SHE GUIDE OR NOT] .

en: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?"
gloss: BEFORE , WE PREVENT IX NURSE OTHER . [rs-b: SISTER SAY , [yn: ME SHOW YOU FAMILY CARE IX FOR YOU , SINCERE]] ?

en: And when he came to the water [i.e., well] of Madyan, he found there a crowd of people watering [their flocks], and he found aside from them two women holding back [their flocks]. He said, "What is your circumstance?" They said, "We do not water until the shepherds dispatch [their flocks]; and our father is an old man."
gloss: [top: ARRIVE fs:MADYAN WATER] , FIND CROWD GIVE ANIMAL WATER . BESIDES THEM , TWO WOMAN WAIT . [rs-a: ASK , [wh: WHAT MATTER]] ? [rs-b: SAY , WE NOT GIVE WATER UNTIL OTHER FINISH . OUR FATHER OLD] .

en: And you, [O Muḥammad], were not on the western side [of the mount] when We revealed to Moses the command, and you were not among the witnesses [to that].
gloss: YOU NOT THERE WEST SIDE , WHEN WE GIVE MUSA COMMAND . YOU NOT WITNESS .

en: The Byzantines have been defeated
gloss: fs:ROME DEFEAT ,

en: And to Him is [due all] praise throughout the heavens and the earth. And [exalted is He] at night and when you are at noon.
gloss: PRAISE BELONG IX , SKY , EARTH , NIGHT , MIDDLE DAY .

en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Travel through the land and observe how was the end of those before. Most of them were associators [of others with Allāh].
gloss: SAY , [rs-a: TRAVEL LAND , LOOK PEOPLE BEFORE , END HOW . MOST POLYTHEIST] .

en: And do not turn your cheek [in contempt] toward people and do not walk through the earth exultantly. Indeed, Allāh does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful.
gloss: [rs-a: [neg: NOT TURN FACE FROM PEOPLE PROUD , NOT WALK EARTH PROUD] . ALLAH NOT LIKE ARROGANT , BOAST] .

en: And they say, "When will be this conquest, if you should be truthful?"
gloss: [rs-b: THEY SAY , [wh: WIN WHEN] , IF TRUE] ?

en: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when We took from the prophets their covenant and from you and from Noah and Abraham and Moses and Jesus, the son of Mary; and We took from them a solemn covenant
gloss: WE TAKE PROMISE FROM PROPHET+ , FROM YOU , NUH , IBRAHIM , MUSA , ISA SON MARYAM . WE TAKE PROMISE STRONG ,

en: But those who disbelieve say, "Shall we direct you to a man who will inform you [that] when you have disintegrated in complete disintegration, you will [then] be [recreated] in a new creation?
gloss: [rs-b: DISBELIEVER SAY , [yn: WE SHOW YOU MAN , IX TELL YOU , YOU BREAK PIECE+ , LATER CREATE NEW]] ?

en: [Commanding him], "Make full coats of mail and calculate [precisely] the links, and work [all of you] righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Seeing."
gloss: [rs-c: MAKE CLOTHES IRON FULL , MEASURE EXACT . DO RIGHTEOUS . ME SEE YOUR DO] .

en: Say, "You will not be asked about what we committed, and we will not be asked about what you do."
gloss: SAY , [rs-a: YOU NOT ASK ABOUT OUR SIN , WE NOT ASK ABOUT YOUR DO] .

en: Say, "For you is the appointment of a Day [when] you will not remain thereafter an hour, nor will you precede [it]."
gloss: SAY , [rs-a: YOUR DAY APPOINT , NOT DELAY HOUR , NOT EARLY] .

en: And if you could see when they are terrified but there is no escape, and they will be seized from a place nearby.
gloss: [cond: IF YOU SEE THEM AFRAID] , ESCAPE NONE , CATCH FROM PLACE NEAR .

en: You, [O Muḥammad], are not but a warner.
gloss: YOU ONLY WARNER .

en: Then I seized the ones who disbelieved, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
gloss: THEN ME CATCH DISBELIEVER . [awe: MY PUNISH HOW TERRIBLE] .

en: Indeed you, [O Muḥammad], are from among the messengers,
gloss: [aff: YOU MESSENGER] ,

en: Already the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.
gloss: [aff: WORD TRUE ON MOST THEM] , THEY NOT BELIEVE .

en: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.
gloss: [rs-c: THEN ME ASTRAY CLEAR] .

en: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved
gloss: [cond: IF ALLAH WANT] , DROWN THEM , [neg: HELP NONE , SAVE NONE] ,

en: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.
gloss: ONLY ONE SHOUT , ALL GATHER BEFORE ALLAH .

en: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.
gloss: [aff: IX COMMAND , WHEN IX WANT THING , SAY , fs:KUN (be) , THING HAPPEN] .

en: And those who recite the message,
gloss: [aff: ANGEL RECITE REMINDER] ,

en: But you wonder, while they mock,
gloss: BUT YOU SURPRISE , THEY MOCK .

en: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.
gloss: [rs-b: SAY , THIS ONLY MAGIC CLEAR] .

en: And our forefathers [as well]?"
gloss: [rs-b: [rhq: OUR FATHER BEFORE ALSO]] ?

en: They [i.e., the oppressors] will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,
gloss: [rs-a: LEADER SAY , NO , YOU NOT BELIEVER] ,

en: So the word [i.e., decree] of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].
gloss: [rs-a: OUR LORD WORD TRUE ON US , WE TASTE] .

en: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,
gloss: YOU TASTE PUNISH PAIN ,

en: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -
gloss: PAY ONLY YOUR DO ,

en: Those will have a provision determined -
gloss: THEY FOOD KNOWN ,

en: On thrones facing one another.
gloss: ON COUCH , FACE EACH-OTHER .

en: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.
gloss: SAME EGG PROTECT .

en: He will say, "Would you [care to] look?"
gloss: [rs-a: SAY , [yn: YOU LOOK]] ?

en: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.
gloss: WE MAKE TREE TEST FOR WRONGDOER .

en: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,
gloss: FROM IX FOLLOWER , IBRAHIM ,

en: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.
gloss: IX HIT THEM RIGHT HAND .

en: And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the most debased.
gloss: THEY PLAN HARM IX , WE MAKE THEM LOWEST .

en: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.
gloss: WE HELP THEM , THEY WIN .

en: And We gave them the explicit Scripture [i.e., the Torah],
gloss: WE GIVE THEM BOOK CLEAR ,

en: And at night. Then will you not use reason?
gloss: NIGHT . [rhq: YOU NOT UNDERSTAND] ?

en: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,
gloss: YOU , THING YOU WORSHIP ,

en: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him
gloss: [neg: CANNOT MISLEAD AWAY FROM IX] ,

en: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].
gloss: [rs-c: WE STAND LINE+] .

en: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allāh."
gloss: [rs-c: WE PRAISE GLORY] .

en: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory
gloss: THEY WIN ,

en: Then for Our punishment are they impatient?
gloss: [rhq: THEY HURRY OUR PUNISH] ?

en: And see, for they are going to see.
gloss: WATCH , LATER THEY SEE .

en: Ṣād. By the Qur’ān containing reminder...
gloss: fs:S . [aff: SWEAR QURAN , REMINDER] .

en: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account."
gloss: [rs-b: THEY SAY , OUR LORD , HURRY GIVE OUR SHARE BEFORE JUDGMENT-DAY] .

en: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,
gloss: WE CONTROL WIND FOR IX , BLOW SOFT , IX COMMAND , WHEREVER IX WANT .

en: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver.
gloss: DEVIL , EVERY BUILD , SWIM DEEP ,

en: And others bound together in irons.
gloss: OTHER CHAIN TOGETHER .

en: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
gloss: IX CLOSE TO US , RETURN GOOD .

en: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.
gloss: THEY WITH US CHOSEN , BEST .

en: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account.
gloss: THIS YOUR PROMISE JUDGMENT-DAY .

en: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion.
gloss: THIS OUR PROVIDE , [neg: NEVER FINISH] .

en: [Allāh] said, "Then get out of it [i.e., Paradise], for indeed, you are expelled.
gloss: [rs-c: ALLAH SAY , GO OUT , YOU EXPEL] .

en: [Allāh] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
gloss: [rs-c: ALLAH SAY , YOU DELAY] ,

en: [Iblees] said, "By Your might, I will surely mislead them all.
gloss: [rs-b: IX SAY , SWEAR YOUR MIGHT , ME MISLEAD THEM ALL] ,

en: Then, is one who has deserved the decree of punishment [to be guided]? Then, can you save one who is in the Fire?
gloss: [rhq: PERSON PUNISH WORD TRUE ON , YOU SAVE PERSON IN FIRE] ?

en: Those before them had already said it, but they were not availed by what they used to earn.
gloss: BEFORE PEOPLE SAY SAME , THEIR EARN [neg: NOT HELP] .

en: And that was your assumption which you assumed about your Lord. It has brought you to ruin, and you have become among the losers."
gloss: [rs-c: THAT YOUR THINK ABOUT LORD DESTROY YOU , NOW YOU LOSER] .

en: Man is not weary of supplication for good [things], but if evil touches him, he is hopeless and despairing.
gloss: [neg: PERSON NOT TIRED ASK GOOD] . [top: WHEN EVIL TOUCH] , LOSE HOPE .

en: And in anything over which you disagree - its ruling is [to be referred] to Allāh. [Say], "That is Allāh, my Lord; upon Him I have relied, and to Him I turn back."
gloss: THING YOU DISAGREE , JUDGE WITH ALLAH . [rs-c: THAT ALLAH MY LORD , ME TRUST IX , RETURN TO IX] .

en: If He willed, He could still the wind, and they would remain motionless on its surface. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.
gloss: [cond: IF ALLAH WANT] , STOP WIND , SHIP STOP ON WATER . SIGN-PROOF FOR PERSON PATIENT , THANK .

en: And We destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.
gloss: ALLAH DESTROY PEOPLE STRONGER . EXAMPLE PEOPLE BEFORE PASS .

en: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say, "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.
gloss: SIT ON BACK , REMEMBER LORD BLESS , SAY , [rs-a awe: SUBHANALLAH , IX MAKE THIS OBEY US , WE NOT CAN ALONE] ,

en: Or have We given them a book before it [i.e., the Qur’ān] to which they are adhering?
gloss: [rhq: ALLAH GIVE THEM BOOK BEFORE , THEY HOLD] ?

en: And indeed, it is a remembrance for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned.
gloss: [aff: QURAN REMINDER FOR YOU , YOUR PEOPLE] . FUTURE ASK .

en: But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them.
gloss: [top: WHEN COME WITH SIGN-PROOF] , THEY LAUGH .

en: And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided."
gloss: [rs-b: SAY , MAGICIAN , ASK YOUR LORD FOR US , WE GUIDE] .

en: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allāh].
gloss: IX MAKE PEOPLE LIGHT-WEIGHT , THEY OBEY . THEY PEOPLE DISOBEY .

en: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all.
gloss: [top: WHEN THEY MAKE US ANGRY] , ALLAH PUNISH , DROWN ALL ,

en: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples.
gloss: MAKE THEM EXAMPLE , LESSON FOR LATER .

en: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds, delighted."
gloss: [rs-c happy: ENTER GARDEN , YOU , YOUR WIFE , HAPPY] .

en: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do.
gloss: THAT GARDEN YOU INHERIT , BECAUSE YOUR DO .

en: Therein [i.e., on that night] is made distinct every precise matter -
gloss: THAT NIGHT , EVERY MATTER WISE DECIDE ,

en: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]
gloss: COMMAND FROM US . ALLAH SEND MESSENGER ,

en: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.
gloss: BUT THEY DOUBT , PLAY .

en: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.
gloss: [top: DAY ALLAH STRIKE STRIKE BIG] , ALLAH PUNISH .

en: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
gloss: [neg: SKY , EARTH NOT CRY FOR THEM , NOT DELAY] .

en: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,
gloss: THESE PEOPLE SAY ,

en: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -
gloss: [top: DAY] , [neg: FRIEND NOT HELP FRIEND , NOT GET HELP] ,

en: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.
gloss: BLESS FROM YOUR LORD . THAT WIN GREAT .

en: And who is more astray than he who invokes besides Allāh those who will not respond to him until the Day of Resurrection [i.e., never], and they, of their invocation, are unaware.
gloss: [rhq: WHO MORE ASTRAY THAN PERSON CALL THING NOT ANSWER UNTIL JUDGMENT-DAY , THEY NOT AWARE THEIR CALL] ?

en: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allāh," and then remained on a right course - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
gloss: [top: PEOPLE SAY , OUR LORD ALLAH , AFTER STRAIGHT] , [neg: NOT AFRAID , NOT SAD] .

en: But those who disbelieve - for them is misery, and He will waste their deeds.
gloss: DISBELIEVER , DESTROY , THEIR DO LOST .

en: Then do they not reflect upon the Qur’ān, or are there locks upon [their] hearts?
gloss: [rhq: THEY NOT THINK QURAN , OR HEART LOCK] ?

en: So do not weaken and call for peace while you are superior; and Allāh is with you and will never deprive you of [the reward of] your deeds.
gloss: [neg: NOT WEAK , NOT CALL PEACE WHEN YOU WIN] . ALLAH WITH YOU , [neg: NOT LESS YOUR DO] .

en: Indeed, We have given you, [O Muḥammad], a clear conquest
gloss: [aff: ALLAH GIVE YOU WIN CLEAR] ,

en: Indeed, those who pledge allegiance to you, [O Muḥammad] - they are actually pledging allegiance to Allāh. The hand of Allāh is over their hands. So he who breaks his word only breaks it to the detriment of himself. And he who fulfills that which he has promised Allāh - He will give him a great reward.
gloss: PEOPLE PROMISE YOU , PROMISE ALLAH . ALLAH HAND OVER THEIR HAND . PERSON BREAK PROMISE , BREAK AGAINST SELF . PERSON KEEP PROMISE ALLAH , ALLAH GIVE REWARD BIG .

en: And it is He who withheld their hands from you and your hands from them within [the area of] Makkah after He caused you to overcome them. And ever is Allāh, of what you do, Seeing.
gloss: IX STOP THEIR HAND FROM YOU , YOUR HAND FROM THEM IN fs:MAKKAH , AFTER YOU WIN . ALLAH SEE YOUR DO .

en: We know what the earth diminishes [i.e., consumes] of them, and with Us is a retaining record.
gloss: ALLAH KNOW EARTH TAKE FROM THEM . WITH ALLAH , BOOK KEEP .

en: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."
gloss: HIS COMPANION SAY , [rs-a: THIS READY WITH ME] .

en: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?
gloss: [rhq: ALLAH DESTROY MANY GENERATION STRONGER , SEARCH LAND , FIND ESCAPE] ?

en: Destroyed are the misinformers
gloss: [warn: DESTROY LIAR] ,

en: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."
gloss: [rs-c: TASTE YOUR PUNISH . THIS YOU-ALL ASK HURRY] .

en: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace; [you are] a people unknown."
gloss: [top: WHEN THEY ENTER] , SAY , PEACE . IX SAY , PEACE , [rs-a: PEOPLE NOT KNOW] .

en: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."
gloss: [rs-b: MARK FROM LORD FOR PEOPLE EXCEED] .

en: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.
gloss: EARTH , ALLAH SPREAD . [awe: ALLAH SPREAD BEST] .

en: Or do you think that you will enter Paradise while such [trial] has not yet come to you as came to those who passed on before you? They were touched by poverty and hardship and were shaken until [even their] messenger and those who believed with him said, "When is the help of Allāh?" Unquestionably, the help of Allāh is near.
gloss: [rhq: YOU THINK ENTER PARADISE , NOT YET COME SAME PEOPLE BEFORE] ? POOR , HARD TOUCH , SHAKE , UNTIL MESSENGER , BELIEVER SAY , [rs-b: [wh: ALLAH HELP WHEN]] ? [aff: ALLAH HELP NEAR] .

en: Say, "We have believed in Allāh and in what was revealed to us and what was revealed to Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob, and the Descendants [al-Asbāṭ], and in what was given to Moses and Jesus and to the prophets from their Lord. We make no distinction between any of them, and we are Muslims [submitting] to Him."
gloss: SAY , [rs-a: WE BELIEVE ALLAH , REVEAL US , REVEAL IBRAHIM , ISMAIL , ISHAQ , YAQUB , TRIBE+ , GIVE MUSA , ISA , PROPHET+ FROM LORD . WE NOT SEPARATE ANY . WE SUBMIT IX] .

en: He has ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah and that which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and what We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus - to establish the religion and not be divided therein. Difficult for those who associate others with Allāh is that to which you invite them. Allāh chooses for Himself whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him].
gloss: ALLAH ORDAIN RELIGION FOR YOU , SAME COMMAND NUH , REVEAL YOU , COMMAND IBRAHIM , MUSA , ISA , [rs-c: ESTABLISH RELIGION , NOT DIVIDE] . HARD FOR POLYTHEIST . ALLAH CHOOSE WHO IX WANT , GUIDE PERSON RETURN .

en: [Fasting for] a limited number of days. So whoever among you is ill or on a journey [during them] - then an equal number of other days [are to be made up]. And upon those who are able [to fast, but with hardship] - a ransom [as substitute] of feeding a poor person [each day]. And whoever volunteers good [i.e., excess] - it is better for him. But to fast is best for you, if you only knew.
gloss: DAY+ COUNT . PERSON SICK OR TRAVEL , OTHER DAY SAME NUMBER . PEOPLE ABLE HARD , RANSOM , FEED POOR . PERSON DO GOOD MORE , BETTER . FAST BEST FOR YOU , [cond: IF YOU KNOW] .

en: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh provides for whom He wills without account."
gloss: LORD ACCEPT HER GOOD , GROW GOOD , ZAKARIYYA CARE . EVERY TIME ZAKARIYYA ENTER PRAY ROOM , FIND FOOD WITH HER . [rs-a: SAY , MARYAM , [wh: FROM WHERE]] ? [rs-b: SHE SAY , FROM ALLAH . ALLAH PROVIDE WHO IX WANT WITHOUT COUNT] .

en: So high [above all] is Allāh, the Sovereign, the Truth. And, [O Muḥammad], do not hasten with [recitation of] the Qur’ān before its revelation is completed to you, and say, "My Lord, increase me in knowledge."
gloss: [awe: HIGH ALLAH , KING , TRUE] . [neg: NOT HURRY QURAN BEFORE REVEAL FINISH] . SAY , [rs-a: MY LORD , ADD ME KNOWLEDGE] .

en: So We responded to him, and We gave to him John, and amended for him his wife. Indeed, they used to hasten to good deeds and supplicate Us in hope and fear, and they were to Us humbly submissive.
gloss: WE ANSWER , GIVE IX YAHYA , FIX WIFE . THEY HURRY GOOD DO , CALL US HOPE , FEAR , HUMBLE .

en: And those who disbelieve say, "We will never believe in this Qur’ān nor in that before it." But if you could see when the wrongdoers are made to stand before their Lord, refuting each others' words... Those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, "If not for you, we would have been believers."
gloss: [rs-b: DISBELIEVER SAY , WE NEVER BELIEVE THIS QURAN , NOT BOOK BEFORE] . [cond: IF YOU SEE WRONGDOER STAND FRONT LORD , BLAME EACH-OTHER] . [rs-b: WEAK SAY TO ARROGANT , IF NOT YOU , WE BELIEVER] .

en: So when you meet those who disbelieve [in battle], strike [their] necks until, when you have inflicted slaughter upon them, then secure [their] bonds, and either [confer] favor afterwards or ransom [them] until the war lays down its burdens. That [is the command]. And if Allāh had willed, He could have taken vengeance upon them [Himself], but [He ordered armed struggle] to test some of you by means of others. And those who are killed in the cause of Allāh - never will He waste their deeds.
gloss: [top: WHEN MEET DISBELIEVER IN WAR] , STRIKE NECK . [top: WHEN DEFEAT] , BIND STRONG . AFTER , FREE FAVOR OR RANSOM , UNTIL WAR FINISH . [cond: IF ALLAH WANT] , IX DEFEAT THEM , BUT TEST SOME WITH OTHER . PEOPLE KILL IN ALLAH PATH , ALLAH NOT MAKE THEIR DO LOST .

en: Say, [O believers], "We have believed in Allāh and what has been revealed to us and what has been revealed to Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac and Jacob and the Descendants [al-Asbāṭ] and what was given to Moses and Jesus and what was given to the prophets from their Lord. We make no distinction between any of them, and we are Muslims [in submission] to Him."
gloss: SAY , [rs-a: WE BELIEVE ALLAH , REVEAL US , REVEAL IBRAHIM , ISMAIL , ISHAQ , YAQUB , TRIBE+ , GIVE MUSA , ISA , GIVE PROPHET+ FROM LORD . WE NOT SEPARATE ANY . WE SUBMIT IX] .

en: And if you divorce them before you have touched them and you have already specified for them an obligation, then [give] half of what you specified - unless they forego the right or the one in whose hand is the marriage contract foregoes it. And to forego it is nearer to righteousness. And do not forget graciousness between you. Indeed Allāh, of whatever you do, is Seeing.
gloss: [cond: IF DIVORCE BEFORE TOUCH , DOWRY DECIDE] , HALF , EXCEPT WOMAN PARDON , OR HUSBAND PARDON . PARDON CLOSER FEAR-GOD . [neg: NOT FORGET KIND BETWEEN] . ALLAH SEE YOUR DO .

en: Have you not seen those who were given a portion of the Scripture, who believe in jibt [superstition] and ṭāghūt [false objects of worship] and say about the disbelievers, "These are better guided than the believers as to the way"?
gloss: [rhq: YOU NOT SEE PEOPLE GET PART BOOK , BELIEVE MAGIC , FALSE-GOD , SAY ABOUT DISBELIEVER , THESE MORE GUIDE THAN BELIEVER] ?

en: And they say, "[We pledge] obedience." But when they leave you, a group of them spend the night determining to do other than what you say. But Allāh records what they plan by night. So leave them alone and rely upon Allāh. And sufficient is Allāh as Disposer of affairs.
gloss: [rs-b: THEY SAY , OBEY] . [top: LEAVE YOU] , GROUP NIGHT PLAN OTHER THAN YOUR SAY . ALLAH WRITE THEIR PLAN . LEAVE THEM , TRUST ALLAH . ALLAH ENOUGH GUARDIAN .

en: No good is there in much of their private conversation, except for those who enjoin charity or that which is right or conciliation between people. And whoever does that seeking means to the approval of Allāh - then We are going to give him a great reward.
gloss: [neg: GOOD NONE] IN MOST THEIR WHISPER , EXCEPT COMMAND CHARITY , GOOD , PEACE BETWEEN PEOPLE . PERSON DO , WANT ALLAH PLEASED , WE GIVE REWARD GREAT .

en: Indeed, We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], as We revealed to Noah and the prophets after him. And We revealed to Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob, the Descendants, Jesus, Job, Jonah, Aaron, and Solomon, and to David We gave the book [of Psalms].
gloss: WE REVEAL YOU SAME REVEAL NUH , PROPHET+ AFTER . REVEAL IBRAHIM , ISMAIL , ISHAQ , YAQUB , TRIBE+ , ISA , AYYUB , YUNUS , HARUN , SULAYMAN . DAWUD WE GIVE fs:ZABUR .

en: O you who have believed, testimony [should be taken] among you when death approaches one of you at the time of bequest - [that of] two just men from among you or two others from outside if you are traveling through the land and the disaster of death should strike you. Detain them after the prayer and let them both swear by Allāh if you doubt [their testimony, saying], "We will not exchange it [i.e., our oath] for a price [i.e., worldly gain], even if he should be a near relative, and we will not withhold the testimony of [i.e., ordained by] Allāh. Indeed, we would then be of the sinful."
gloss: BELIEVER , [top: DEATH NEAR , WRITE BEQUEST] , TWO FAIR MAN WITNESS , OR TWO OTHER IF TRAVEL , DEATH HIT . [cond: IF DOUBT] , HOLD AFTER SALAH , SWEAR ALLAH , [rs-b: WE NOT SELL OATH , EVEN RELATIVE , NOT HIDE ALLAH TESTIFY . THEN WE SINNER] .

en: That is more likely that they will give testimony according to its [true] objective, or [at least] they would fear that [other] oaths might be taken after their oaths. And fear Allāh and listen [i.e., obey Him]; and Allāh does not guide the defiantly disobedient people.
gloss: THAT BETTER , TESTIFY TRUE , OR FEAR OTHER OATH AFTER . FEAR-GOD ALLAH , LISTEN . ALLAH NOT GUIDE DISOBEY PEOPLE .

en: So they hamstrung the she-camel and were insolent toward the command of their Lord and said, "O Ṣāliḥ, bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the messengers."
gloss: CUT CAMEL , DISOBEY LORD COMMAND , [rs-b: SAY , SALIH , BRING PROMISE , IF YOU MESSENGER] .

en: Allāh has already given you victory in many regions and [even] on the day of Ḥunayn, when your great number pleased you, but it did not avail you at all, and the earth was confining for you with [i.e., in spite of] its vastness; then you turned back, fleeing.
gloss: ALLAH HELP YOU WIN MANY PLACE . DAY fs:HUNAYN , YOUR MANY PEOPLE PLEASE YOU , [neg: NOT HELP NOTHING] . EARTH WIDE BECOME NARROW , YOU TURN FLEE .

en: And it is not for the believers to go forth [to battle] all at once. For there should separate from every division of them a group [remaining] to obtain understanding in the religion and warn [i.e., advise] their people when they return to them that they might be cautious.
gloss: [neg: NOT FITTING BELIEVER ALL GO] . FROM EACH GROUP , SOME STAY LEARN RELIGION , WARN PEOPLE WHEN RETURN , MAYBE CAREFUL .

en: And it sailed with them through waves like mountains, and Noah called to his son who was apart [from them], "O my son, come aboard with us and be not with the disbelievers."
gloss: SHIP SAIL , WAVE SAME MOUNTAIN . NUH CALL SON , SEPARATE , [rs-a: MY SON , COME WITH US , NOT WITH DISBELIEVER] .

en: And if Allāh were to impose blame on the people for their wrongdoing, He would not have left upon it [i.e., the earth] any creature, but He defers them for a specified term. And when their term has come, they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it].
gloss: [cond: IF ALLAH PUNISH PEOPLE FOR WRONG] , [neg: NOT LEAVE ANY ANIMAL ON EARTH] . BUT IX DELAY UNTIL TERM . [top: TERM COME] , [neg: NOT DELAY HOUR , NOT EARLY] .

en: And do not take your oaths as [means of] deceit between you, lest a foot slip after it was [once] firm, and you would taste evil [in this world] for what [people] you diverted from the way of Allāh, and you would have [in the Hereafter] a great punishment.
gloss: [neg: NOT TAKE OATH DECEIVE] , FOOT FALL AFTER FIRM , TASTE EVIL BECAUSE BLOCK ALLAH PATH . PUNISH GREAT .

en: So when you recite the Qur’ān, [first] seek refuge in Allāh from Satan, the expelled [from His mercy].
gloss: [top: YOU RECITE QURAN] , SEEK-REFUGE ALLAH FROM DEVIL EXPEL .

en: [He was told], "O Zechariah, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be John. We have not assigned to any before [this] name."
gloss: [rs-c: ZAKARIYYA , WE GIVE YOU GOOD NEWS , BOY , NAME YAHYA . BEFORE , NOBODY NAME SAME] .

en: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast.
gloss: [rs-a: MUSA SAY , GO . LIFE YOU SAY , NOT TOUCH . YOU HAVE APPOINT , NOT MISS . LOOK YOUR GOD YOU DEVOTE , WE BURN , SCATTER IN SEA] .

en: And [mention] Zechariah, when he called to his Lord, "My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while You are the best of inheritors."
gloss: ZAKARIYYA CALL LORD , [rs-a: MY LORD , NOT LEAVE ME ALONE . YOU BEST INHERIT] .

en: And women of post-menstrual age who have no desire for marriage - there is no blame upon them for putting aside their outer garments [but] not displaying adornment. But to modestly refrain [from that] is better for them. And Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.
gloss: WOMAN OLD , NOT EXPECT MARRY , [neg: BLAME NONE] REMOVE OUTSIDE CLOTHES , NOT SHOW ADORNMENT . BUT KEEP , BETTER . ALLAH HEAR , KNOW .

en: Like the custom of the people of Noah and of ʿAad and Thamūd and those after them. And Allāh wants no injustice for [His] servants.
gloss: [rs-c: SAME NUH PEOPLE , fs:AAD , fs:THAMUD , AFTER THEM . ALLAH NOT WANT UNFAIR FOR SERVANT] .

en: It is He who has sent among the unlettered [Arabs] a Messenger from themselves reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] and wisdom [i.e., the sunnah] - although they were before in clear error -
gloss: IX SEND TO PEOPLE NOT READ , MESSENGER FROM THEM , RECITE IX SIGN-PROOF , CLEAN THEM , TEACH BOOK , WISDOM . BEFORE , THEY ASTRAY CLEAR .

en: Lodge them [in a section] of where you dwell out of your means and do not harm them in order to oppress them. And if they should be pregnant, then spend on them until they give birth. And if they breastfeed for you, then give them their payment and confer among yourselves in the acceptable way; but if you are in discord, then there may breastfeed for him [i.e., the father] another woman.
gloss: LET THEM LIVE WHERE YOU LIVE , YOUR ABILITY . [neg: NOT HARM THEM , MAKE HARD] . [top: IF PREGNANT] , SPEND UNTIL BORN . [top: IF NURSE BABY FOR YOU] , PAY THEM , DISCUSS FAIR . [top: IF HARD] , OTHER WOMAN NURSE .

en: The month of Ramaḍān [is that] in which was revealed the Qur’ān, a guidance for the people and clear proofs of guidance and criterion. So whoever sights [the crescent of] the month, let him fast it; and whoever is ill or on a journey - then an equal number of other days. Allāh intends for you ease and does not intend for you hardship and [wants] for you to complete the period and to glorify Allāh for that [to] which He has guided you; and perhaps you will be grateful.
gloss: [awe: MONTH RAMADAN , QURAN SEND-DOWN] , GUIDE FOR PEOPLE , PROOF CLEAR GUIDE , fs:FURQAN . PERSON SEE MONTH , FAST . PERSON SICK OR TRAVEL , OTHER DAY SAME NUMBER . ALLAH WANT EASY FOR YOU , NOT WANT HARD , COMPLETE NUMBER , PRAISE ALLAH FOR GUIDE , MAYBE THANK .

en: Allāh has certainly heard the statement of those [Jews] who said, "Indeed, Allāh is poor, while we are rich." We will record what they said and their killing of the prophets without right and will say, "Taste the punishment of the Burning Fire.
gloss: ALLAH HEAR PEOPLE SAY , [rs-b: ALLAH POOR , WE RICH] . WE WRITE THEIR SAY , KILL PROPHET+ WITHOUT RIGHT , SAY , [rs-c: TASTE FIRE PUNISH] .

en: They conceal [their evil intentions and deeds] from the people, but they cannot conceal [them] from Allāh, and He is with them [in His knowledge] when they spend the night in such as He does not accept of speech. And ever is Allāh, of what they do, encompassing.
gloss: HIDE FROM PEOPLE , [neg: CANNOT HIDE FROM ALLAH] . IX WITH THEM NIGHT PLAN WORD IX NOT PLEASED . ALLAH SURROUND THEIR DO .

en: It [i.e., Paradise] is not [obtained] by your wishful thinking nor by that of the People of the Scripture. Whoever does a wrong will be recompensed for it, and he will not find besides Allāh a protector or a helper.
gloss: [neg: NOT BY YOUR WISH , NOT PEOPLE BOOK WISH] . PERSON DO EVIL , PAY . [neg: NOT FIND PROTECTOR , HELPER BESIDES ALLAH] .

en: And your Lord is the Free of need, the possessor of mercy. If He wills, He can do away with you and give succession after you to whomever He wills, just as He produced you from the descendants of another people.
gloss: YOUR LORD NOT NEED , OWN MERCY . [cond: IF IX WANT] , REMOVE YOU , REPLACE WHO IX WANT , SAME CREATE YOU FROM OTHER PEOPLE CHILD+ .

en: O children of Adam, if there come to you messengers from among you relating to you My verses [i.e., scriptures and laws], then whoever fears Allāh and reforms - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
gloss: ADAM CHILD+ , [top: MESSENGER FROM YOU COME , TELL MY VERSE] , PERSON FEAR-GOD , FIX , [neg: FEAR NONE , NOT SAD] .

en: [Allāh will say], "Are these the ones whom you [inhabitants of Hell] swore that Allāh would never offer them mercy? Enter Paradise, [O people of the Elevations]. No fear will there be concerning you, nor will you grieve."
gloss: [rs-c: [rhq: THESE PEOPLE YOU SWEAR ALLAH NEVER GIVE MERCY] ? ENTER PARADISE , FEAR NONE , NOT SAD] .

en: Say, "I hold not for myself [the power of] benefit or harm, except what Allāh has willed. And if I knew the unseen, I could have acquired much wealth, and no harm would have touched me. I am not except a warner and a bringer of good tidings to a people who believe."
gloss: SAY , [rs-a: ME NOT OWN BENEFIT , HARM FOR MYSELF , EXCEPT ALLAH WANT . [cond: IF ME KNOW UNSEEN] , ME GET MUCH GOOD , HARM NOT TOUCH ME . ME ONLY WARNER , GOOD NEWS FOR PEOPLE BELIEVE] .

en: And they were [therefore] followed in this world with a curse and [as well] on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, ʿAad denied their Lord; then away with ʿAad, the people of Hūd.
gloss: CURSE FOLLOW WORLD , JUDGMENT-DAY . [warn: fs:AAD DENY LORD . AWAY fs:AAD , HUD PEOPLE] .

en: And O my people, give full measure and weight in justice and do not deprive the people of their due and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption.
gloss: [rs-a: MY PEOPLE , MEASURE FULL , WEIGH FAIR , NOT TAKE PEOPLE RIGHT , NOT CORRUPT EARTH] .

en: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when We told you, "Indeed, your Lord has encompassed the people." And We did not make the sight which We showed you except as a trial for the people, as was the accursed tree [mentioned] in the Qur’ān. And We threaten [i.e., warn] them, but it increases them not except in great transgression.
gloss: WE TELL YOU , YOUR LORD SURROUND PEOPLE . VISION WE SHOW YOU ONLY TEST FOR PEOPLE , TREE CURSE IN QURAN ALSO . WE WARN THEM , ADD ONLY TRANSGRESS BIG .

en: And We bound [i.e., made firm] their hearts when they stood up and said, "Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth. Never will we invoke besides Him any deity. We would have certainly spoken, then, an excessive transgression.
gloss: WE STRENGTHEN HEART , THEY STAND , [rs-b: SAY , OUR LORD , LORD SKY , EARTH . WE NEVER CALL GOD BESIDES IX . [cond: IF WE DO] , WE SAY WRONG BIG] .

en: And you would think them awake, while they were asleep. And We turned them to the right and to the left, while their dog stretched his forelegs at the entrance. If you had looked at them, you would have turned from them in flight and been filled by them with terror.
gloss: YOU THINK THEY AWAKE , BUT SLEEP . WE TURN THEM RIGHT , LEFT . THEIR DOG EXTEND ARM AT DOOR . [cond: IF YOU LOOK] , YOU TURN FLEE , FILL FEAR .

en: With their hearts distracted. And those who do wrong conceal their private conversation, [saying], "Is this [Prophet] except a human being like you? So would you approach magic while you are aware [of it]?"
gloss: HEART DISTRACT . WRONGDOER WHISPER SECRET , [rs-b: [rhq: THIS ONLY PERSON SAME YOU ? YOU GO TO MAGIC , YOU SEE]] ?

en: And [mention] the man of the fish [i.e., Jonah], when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. And he called out within the darknesses, "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers."
gloss: YUNUS , FISH PERSON , LEAVE ANGRY , THINK WE NOT DECREE ON IX . CALL IN DARK , [rs-a: [neg: GOD NONE] EXCEPT YOU , GLORY YOU . ME WRONGDOER] .

en: Inclining [only] to Allāh, not associating [anything] with Him. And he who associates with Allāh - it is as though he had fallen from the sky and was snatched by the birds or the wind carried him down into a remote place.
gloss: STRAIGHT FOR ALLAH , NOT ASSOCIATE . PERSON ASSOCIATE ALLAH , SAME FALL FROM SKY , BIRD CATCH , OR WIND THROW PLACE FAR .

en: And [We destroyed] ʿAad and Thamūd, and it has become clear to you from their [ruined] dwellings. And Satan had made pleasing to them their deeds and averted them from the path, and they were endowed with perception.
gloss: fs:AAD , fs:THAMUD , THEIR HOME CLEAR YOU SEE . DEVIL MAKE THEIR DO LOOK BEAUTIFUL , BLOCK FROM PATH , EVEN THEY SEE CLEAR .

en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I am only a man like you to whom it has been revealed that your god is but one God; so take a straight course to Him and seek His forgiveness." And woe to those who associate others with Allāh
gloss: SAY , [rs-c: ME ONLY PERSON SAME YOU . ALLAH REVEAL ME , YOUR GOD ONE GOD . GO STRAIGHT TO IX , ASK FORGIVE] . [warn: WOE POLYTHEIST] ,

en: And We appointed for them companions who made attractive to them what was before them and what was behind them [of sin], and the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect upon them among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they [all] were losers.
gloss: ALLAH LET COMPANION EVIL MAKE BEAUTIFUL BEFORE , BEHIND . WORD TRUE ON THEM , WITH GROUP JINN , PEOPLE BEFORE . THEY LOSER .

en: And We had already given Moses the Scripture, but it came under disagreement. And if not for a word [i.e., decree] that preceded from your Lord, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed they are, concerning it [i.e., the Qur’ān], in disquieting doubt.
gloss: ALLAH GIVE MUSA BOOK , PEOPLE DISAGREE . [cond: IF NOT WORD FROM LORD BEFORE] , JUDGE BETWEEN THEM . THEY DOUBT .

en: If We had sent down this Qur’ān upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled and splitting from fear of Allāh. And these examples We present to the people that perhaps they will give thought.
gloss: [cond: IF ALLAH SEND-DOWN QURAN ON MOUNTAIN] , YOU SEE MOUNTAIN HUMBLE , SPLIT , AFRAID ALLAH . EXAMPLE FOR PEOPLE THINK .

en: Say, "O People of the Scripture, why do you avert from the way of Allāh those who believe, seeking to make it [seem] deviant, while you are witnesses [to the truth]? And Allāh is not unaware of what you do."
gloss: SAY , [rs-a: PEOPLE BOOK , [wh: WHY BLOCK BELIEVER FROM ALLAH PATH , WANT CROOKED , YOU WITNESS] ? ALLAH NOT UNAWARE YOUR DO] .

en: And let not those who disbelieve ever think that [because] We extend their time [of enjoyment] it is better for them. We only extend it for them so that they may increase in sin, and for them is a humiliating punishment.
gloss: [neg: DISBELIEVER NOT THINK DELAY GOOD FOR THEM] . WE DELAY ONLY ADD SIN . PUNISH SHAME .

en: Never would the Messiah disdain to be a servant of Allāh, nor would the angels near [to Him]. And whoever disdains His worship and is arrogant - He will gather them to Himself all together.
gloss: fs:MASIH [neg: NEVER ARROGANT SERVANT ALLAH] , ANGEL CLOSE ALSO . PERSON ARROGANT WORSHIP , IX GATHER ALL .

en: Indeed, I have turned my face [i.e., self] toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allāh."
gloss: [rs-a: ME TURN FACE TO IX CREATE SKY , EARTH , STRAIGHT . ME NOT POLYTHEIST] .

en: Say, "Come, I will recite what your Lord has prohibited to you. [He commands] that you not associate anything with Him, and to parents, good treatment, and do not kill your children out of poverty; We will provide for you and them. And do not approach immoralities - what is apparent of them and what is concealed. And do not kill the soul which Allāh has forbidden [to be killed] except by [legal] right. This has He instructed you that you may use reason."
gloss: SAY , [rs-a: COME , ME RECITE THING LORD FORBID . NOT ASSOCIATE IX ANYTHING . GOOD TO PARENTS . NOT KILL CHILD POOR , WE PROVIDE YOU , THEM . NOT GO NEAR IMMORALITY , OPEN , HIDDEN . NOT KILL SOUL ALLAH FORBID , EXCEPT RIGHT . IX COMMAND YOU , MAYBE UNDERSTAND] .

en: [Hūd] said, "Already have defilement and anger fallen upon you from your Lord. Do you dispute with me concerning [mere] names you have named them, you and your fathers, for which Allāh has not sent down any authority? Then wait; indeed, I am with you among those who wait."
gloss: [rs-a: HUD SAY , DIRTY , ANGRY FROM LORD FALL ON YOU . [rhq: YOU ARGUE ME ABOUT NAME YOU , FATHER GIVE , ALLAH NOT SEND-DOWN AUTHORITY] ? WAIT , ME WAIT WITH YOU] .

en: And if they had intended to go forth, they would have prepared for it [some] preparation. But Allāh disliked their being sent, so He kept them back, and they were told, "Remain [behind] with those who remain."
gloss: [cond: IF WANT GO] , PREPARE . BUT ALLAH DISLIKE THEIR GO , HOLD BACK . [rs-c: STAY WITH PEOPLE STAY] .

en: They had already desired dissension before and had upset matters for you until the truth came and the ordinance [i.e., victory] of Allāh appeared, while they were averse.
gloss: BEFORE THEY WANT FITNAH , MIX MATTER , UNTIL TRUE COME , ALLAH COMMAND APPEAR , THEY DISLIKE .

en: If good befalls you, it distresses them; but if disaster strikes you, they say, "We took our matter [in hand] before," and turn away while they are rejoicing.
gloss: [cond: IF GOOD HAPPEN YOU] , THEY SAD . [cond: IF DISASTER HIT YOU] , [rs-b: SAY , WE PREPARE BEFORE] , TURN-AWAY HAPPY .

en: [But] he said, "I will take refuge on a mountain to protect me from the water." [Noah] said, "There is no protector today from the decree of Allāh, except for whom He gives mercy." And the waves came between them, and he was among the drowned.
gloss: [rs-b: SON SAY , ME GO MOUNTAIN , PROTECT ME FROM WATER] . [rs-a: NUH SAY , TODAY PROTECTOR NONE FROM ALLAH COMMAND , EXCEPT IX MERCY] . WAVE COME BETWEEN , SON DROWN .

en: And to ʿAad [We sent] their brother Hūd. He said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him. You are not but inventors [of falsehood].
gloss: fs:AAD , BROTHER HUD SAY , [rs-a: MY PEOPLE , WORSHIP ALLAH , [neg: GOD NONE] EXCEPT IX . YOU ONLY INVENT] .

en: So do not be in doubt, [O Muḥammad], as to what these [polytheists] are worshipping. They worship not except as their fathers worshipped before. And indeed, We will give them their share undiminished.
gloss: [neg: NOT DOUBT THEIR WORSHIP] . THEY WORSHIP SAME FATHER BEFORE . WE PAY THEIR SHARE FULL .

en: Have they not seen that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? And Allāh decides; there is no adjuster of His decision. And He is swift in account.
gloss: [rhq: THEY NOT SEE , WE COME LAND , MAKE SMALL FROM EDGE] ? ALLAH JUDGE , [neg: NOBODY CHANGE IX JUDGE] . IX QUICK COUNT .

en: Praise to Allāh, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication.
gloss: [rs-a: ALHAMDULILLAH , GIVE ME OLD ISMAIL , ISHAQ . MY LORD HEAR DUA] .

en: [We sent them] with clear proofs and written ordinances. And We revealed to you the message [i.e., the Qur’ān] that you may make clear to the people what was sent down to them and that they might give thought.
gloss: WITH PROOF CLEAR , BOOK . WE SEND-DOWN YOU REMINDER , YOU EXPLAIN PEOPLE THING SEND-DOWN THEM , MAYBE THEY THINK .

en: So when the [time of] promise came for the first of them, We sent against you servants of Ours - those of great military might, and they probed [even] into the homes, and it was a promise fulfilled.
gloss: [top: FIRST PROMISE COME] , WE SEND AGAINST YOU OUR SERVANT , FIGHT STRONG , SEARCH HOUSE+ . PROMISE HAPPEN .

en: And [for] every person We have imposed his fate upon his neck, and We will produce for him on the Day of Resurrection a record which he will encounter spread open.
gloss: EVERY PERSON , WE TIE DESTINY NECK . JUDGMENT-DAY WE BRING BOOK , IX FIND OPEN .

en: Those were the ones upon whom Allāh bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel [i.e., Jacob], and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping.
gloss: THOSE PROPHET ALLAH FAVOR , ADAM CHILD+ , PEOPLE WE CARRY WITH NUH , IBRAHIM , ISRAIL CHILD+ , PEOPLE WE GUIDE , CHOOSE . [top: RECITE THEM GRACIOUS VERSE] , [awe: FALL PROSTRATE , CRY] .

en: And We gave him Isaac and Jacob in addition, and all [of them] We made righteous.
gloss: WE GIVE IX ISHAQ , YAQUB ADD . ALL WE MAKE RIGHTEOUS .

en: And how many a city did We destroy while it was committing wrong - so it is [now] fallen into ruin - and [how many] an abandoned well and [how many] a lofty palace.
gloss: [rhq: HOW-MANY CITY WE DESTROY , WRONGDOER] ? ROOF FALL , WELL EMPTY , PALACE HIGH .

en: [Noah] said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."
gloss: [rs-a: NUH SAY , MY LORD , HELP ME , THEY DENY ME] .

en: And let not those of virtue among you and wealth swear not to give [aid] to their relatives and the needy and the emigrants for the cause of Allāh, and let them pardon and overlook. Would you not like that Allāh should forgive you? And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
gloss: PEOPLE FAVOR , RICH , [neg: NOT SWEAR STOP GIVE RELATIVE , POOR , EMIGRATE FOR ALLAH] . PARDON , OVERLOOK . [rhq: YOU NOT WANT ALLAH FORGIVE YOU] ? ALLAH FORGIVE , MERCIFUL .

en: And indeed, [O Muḥammad], you receive the Qur’ān from one Wise and Knowing.
gloss: YOU RECEIVE QURAN FROM WISE , KNOW .

en: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds."
gloss: [rs-c: ENTER PALACE] . [top: SHE SEE] , THINK WATER DEEP , SHOW SHIN . [rs-a: IX SAY , PALACE FLAT GLASS] . [rs-b: SHE SAY , MY LORD , ME WRONG MYSELF . ME SUBMIT WITH SULAYMAN TO ALLAH , LORD ALL WORLD] .

en: Indeed, this Qur’ān relates to the Children of Israel most of that over which they disagree.
gloss: THIS QURAN TELL ISRAIL CHILD MOST THING THEY DISAGREE .

en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Travel through the land and observe how He began creation. Then Allāh will produce the final creation [i.e., development]. Indeed Allāh, over all things, is competent."
gloss: SAY , [rs-a: TRAVEL LAND , LOOK HOW IX BEGIN CREATION . THEN ALLAH MAKE CREATION LAST . ALLAH POWER OVER ALL THING] .

en: [Remember] when they came at you from above you and from below you, and when eyes shifted [in fear], and hearts reached the throats, and you assumed about Allāh [various] assumptions.
gloss: [top: THEY COME FROM ABOVE , FROM BELOW] , EYE MOVE AFRAID , HEART REACH THROAT , YOU THINK ABOUT ALLAH THOUGHT+ .

en: Whatever Allāh grants to people of mercy - none can withhold it; and whatever He withholds - none can release it thereafter. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
gloss: MERCY ALLAH OPEN FOR PEOPLE , [neg: NOBODY BLOCK] . THING IX BLOCK , [neg: NOBODY OPEN] AFTER . IX MIGHTY , WISE .

en: Is not Allāh sufficient for His Servant [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)]? And [yet], they threaten you with those [they worship] other than Him. And whoever Allāh leaves astray - for him there is no guide.
gloss: [rhq: ALLAH NOT ENOUGH FOR IX SERVANT] ? THEY THREATEN YOU WITH FALSE-GOD . ALLAH LET ASTRAY , GUIDE NONE .

en: Indeed, those who disbelieve in the message [i.e., the Qur’ān] after it has come to them... And indeed, it is a mighty Book.
gloss: PEOPLE DENY REMINDER WHEN COME . QURAN BOOK POWER ,

en: Those who do not believe in it are impatient for it, but those who believe are fearful of it and know that it is the truth. Unquestionably, those who dispute concerning the Hour are in extreme error.
gloss: DISBELIEVER WANT HURRY HOUR . BELIEVER AFRAID , KNOW TRUE . [aff: PEOPLE ARGUE ABOUT HOUR , ASTRAY FAR] .

en: And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.
gloss: [aff: QURAN IN MOTHER BOOK WITH ALLAH , HIGH , WISE] .

en: And they said, "Are our gods better, or is he?" They did not present it [i.e., the comparison] except for [mere] argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute.
gloss: [rs-b: SAY , OUR GOD BETTER OR IX] ? THEY ONLY ARGUE . PEOPLE ARGUE .

en: And We have already sent Noah and Abraham and placed in their descendants prophethood and scripture; and among them is he who is guided, but many of them are defiantly disobedient.
gloss: ALLAH SEND NUH , IBRAHIM , PUT IN CHILD PROPHET , BOOK . SOME GUIDE , MANY DISOBEY .

en: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion, although those who associate others with Allāh dislike it.
gloss: IX SEND MESSENGER WITH GUIDE , RELIGION TRUE , MAKE OVER ALL RELIGION , EVEN POLYTHEIST HATE .

en: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter."
gloss: ALLAH GIVE EXAMPLE FOR DISBELIEVER , WIFE NUH , WIFE LUT . BOTH UNDER TWO SERVANT RIGHTEOUS , BUT BETRAY . [neg: HUSBAND NOT HELP AGAINST ALLAH] . [rs-c: ENTER FIRE WITH PEOPLE ENTER] .

en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Have you considered: whether Allāh should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"
gloss: SAY , [rhq: YOU SEE , IF ALLAH DESTROY ME , PEOPLE WITH ME , OR MERCY US , WHO SAVE DISBELIEVER FROM PUNISH PAIN] ?

en: And when it is said to them, "Follow what Allāh has revealed," they say, "Rather, we will follow that which we found our fathers doing." Even though their fathers understood nothing, nor were they guided?
gloss: [top: TELL THEM , FOLLOW ALLAH REVEAL] , [rs-b: SAY , NO , WE FOLLOW FATHER WAY] . [rhq: EVEN FATHER NOT UNDERSTAND , NOT GUIDE] ?
