en: Who is it that would loan Allāh a goodly loan so He may multiply it for him many times over? And it is Allāh who withholds and grants abundance, and to Him you will be returned.
gloss: [rhq: WHO LOAN ALLAH LOAN GOOD , IX MULTIPLY MANY] ? ALLAH LIMIT , EXPAND . TO IX YOU RETURN .

en: Not upon you, [O Muḥammad], is [responsibility for] their guidance, but Allāh guides whom He wills. And whatever good you [believers] spend is for yourselves, and you do not spend except seeking the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh. And whatever you spend of good - it will be fully repaid to you, and you will not be wronged.
gloss: [neg: THEIR GUIDE NOT ON YOU] , ALLAH GUIDE WHO IX WANT . GOOD YOU SPEND FOR SELF , SPEND ONLY WANT ALLAH FACE . GOOD YOU SPEND , PAY FULL , [neg: NOT UNFAIR] .

en: O People of the Scripture, why do you argue about Abraham while the Torah and the Gospel were not revealed until after him? Then will you not reason?
gloss: PEOPLE BOOK , [wh: WHY ARGUE ABOUT IBRAHIM] , fs:TAWRAT , fs:INJIL SEND-DOWN ONLY AFTER IX ? [rhq: YOU NOT UNDERSTAND] ?

en: And indeed, there is among them a party who alter the Scripture with their tongues so you may think it is from the Scripture, but it is not from the Scripture. And they say, "This is from Allāh," but it is not from Allāh. And they speak untruth about Allāh while they know.
gloss: SOME TWIST TONGUE BOOK , YOU THINK FROM BOOK , NOT FROM BOOK . [rs-b: SAY , FROM ALLAH] , NOT FROM ALLAH . SAY LIE ABOUT ALLAH , THEY KNOW .

en: It is not [attributable] to any prophet that he would act unfaithfully [in regard to war booty]. And whoever betrays, [taking unlawfully], will come with what he took on the Day of Resurrection. Then will every soul be [fully] compensated for what it earned, and they will not be wronged.
gloss: [neg: NOT FITTING PROPHET BETRAY] . PERSON BETRAY , JUDGMENT-DAY BRING THING TAKE . EVERY SOUL PAY FULL EARN , [neg: NOT UNFAIR] .

en: Those who commit immorality [i.e., unlawful sexual intercourse] of your women - bring against them four [witnesses] from among you. And if they testify, confine them [i.e., the guilty women] to houses until death takes them or Allāh ordains for them [another] way.
gloss: YOUR WOMAN DO IMMORALITY , BRING FOUR WITNESS . [cond: IF TESTIFY] , KEEP HOUSE UNTIL DIE , OR ALLAH MAKE WAY .

en: Have you not seen those who were given a portion of the Scripture, purchasing error [in exchange for it] and wishing you would lose the way?
gloss: [rhq: YOU NOT SEE PEOPLE GET PART BOOK , BUY ASTRAY , WANT YOU LOSE PATH] ?

en: But if bounty comes to you from Allāh, he will surely say, as if [i.e., showing that] there had never been between you and him any affection, "Oh, I wish I had been with them so I could have attained a great attainment."
gloss: [top: FAVOR COME FROM ALLAH] , [rs-b: SAY , SAME LOVE NONE BETWEEN , [sad: WISH ME WITH THEM , WIN BIG]] .

en: O you who have believed, when you go forth [to fight] in the cause of Allāh, investigate; and do not say to one who gives you [a greeting of] peace, "You are not a believer," aspiring for the goods of worldly life; for with Allāh are many acquisitions. You [yourselves] were like that before; then Allāh conferred His favor [i.e., guidance] upon you, so investigate. Indeed Allāh is ever, of what you do, Aware.
gloss: BELIEVER , [top: GO ALLAH PATH] , CHECK . [neg: NOT SAY PERSON GREET PEACE , YOU NOT BELIEVER] , WANT WORLD-LIFE THING . WITH ALLAH SPOILS MANY . BEFORE YOU SAME , ALLAH FAVOR YOU . CHECK . ALLAH AWARE YOUR DO .

en: Except for the oppressed among men, women, and children who cannot devise a plan nor are they directed to a way -
gloss: EXCEPT WEAK MAN , WOMAN , CHILD , CANNOT PLAN , NOT FIND WAY .

en: But whoever earns an offense or a sin and then blames it on an innocent [person] has taken upon himself a slander and manifest sin.
gloss: PERSON EARN SIN , BLAME CLEAN PERSON , CARRY LIE , SIN CLEAR .

en: We know that you, [O Muḥammad], are saddened by what they say. And indeed, they do not call you untruthful, but it is the verses of Allāh that the wrongdoers reject.
gloss: WE KNOW THEIR SAY MAKE YOU SAD . THEY NOT DENY YOU , WRONGDOER DENY ALLAH VERSE .

en: And We gave to him [i.e., Abraham] Isaac and Jacob - all [of them] We guided. And Noah, We guided before; and among his descendants, David and Solomon and Job and Joseph and Moses and Aaron. Thus do We reward the doers of good.
gloss: WE GIVE IX ISHAQ , YAQUB , ALL GUIDE . NUH GUIDE BEFORE . IX CHILD+ , DAWUD , SULAYMAN , AYYUB , YUSUF , MUSA , HARUN . SAME , WE REWARD GOOD PEOPLE .

en: Indeed, those who have divided their religion and become sects - you, [O Muḥammad], are not [associated] with them in anything. Their affair is only [left] to Allāh; then He will inform them about what they used to do.
gloss: PEOPLE DIVIDE RELIGION , BECOME GROUP+ , YOU [neg: NOT WITH THEM ANYTHING] . THEIR MATTER ONLY ALLAH , THEN IX TELL THEIR DO .

en: [Satan] said, "Because You have put me in error, I will surely sit in wait for them [i.e., mankind] on Your straight path.
gloss: [rs-b: IX SAY , BECAUSE YOU MISLEAD ME , ME SIT WAIT THEM ON YOUR PATH STRAIGHT] .

en: [It is] just as when your Lord brought you out of your home [for the battle of Badr] in truth, while indeed, a party among the believers were unwilling,
gloss: SAME , YOUR LORD BRING YOU OUT HOME TRUE , SOME BELIEVER NOT WANT ,

en: So if you, [O Muḥammad], gain dominance over them in war, disperse by [means of] them those behind them that perhaps they will be reminded.
gloss: [cond: IF YOU WIN OVER THEM IN WAR] , SCATTER PEOPLE BEHIND , MAYBE REMEMBER .

en: And he constructed the ship, and whenever an assembly of the eminent of his people passed by him, they ridiculed him. He said, "If you ridicule us, then we will ridicule you just as you ridicule.
gloss: IX BUILD SHIP . EVERY TIME LEADER+ PASS , MOCK . [rs-a: SAY , [cond: IF YOU MOCK US] , WE MOCK YOU SAME] .

en: [They will be] abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Lord should will. Indeed, your Lord is an effecter of what He intends.
gloss: STAY WHILE SKY , EARTH LAST , EXCEPT YOUR LORD WANT . YOUR LORD DO WHAT IX WANT .

en: He said, "Should I entrust you with him except [under coercion] as I entrusted you with his brother before? But Allāh is the best guardian, and He is the most merciful of the merciful."
gloss: [rs-b: YAQUB SAY , [rhq: ME TRUST YOU WITH IX SAME ME TRUST YOU WITH BROTHER BEFORE] ? ALLAH BEST PROTECT , MOST MERCIFUL] .

en: Then do they feel secure that there will not come to them an overwhelming [aspect] of the punishment of Allāh or that the Hour will not come upon them suddenly while they do not perceive?
gloss: [rhq: THEY SAFE , ALLAH PUNISH NOT COVER , HOUR NOT COME SUDDENLY , NOT AWARE] ?

en: And they assign to what they do not know [i.e., false deities] a portion of that which We have provided them. By Allāh, you will surely be questioned about what you used to invent.
gloss: THEY GIVE PART WE PROVIDE TO THING THEY NOT KNOW . [warn: SWEAR ALLAH , LATER ASK ABOUT YOUR INVENT] .

en: Look how We have favored [in provision] some of them over others. But the Hereafter is greater in degrees [of difference] and greater in distinction.
gloss: LOOK , WE FAVOR SOME OVER OTHER . HEREAFTER BIGGER LEVEL , BIGGER FAVOR .

en: Then, has your Lord chosen you for [having] sons and taken [i.e., adopted] from among the angels daughters? Indeed, you say a grave saying.
gloss: [rhq: YOUR LORD CHOOSE SON FOR YOU , TAKE ANGEL DAUGHTER] ? [warn: YOU SAY WORD TERRIBLE] .

en: Or [until] you have a garden of palm trees and grapes and make rivers gush forth within them in force [and abundance]
gloss: [rs-b: OR YOU HAVE GARDEN DATE-PALM , GRAPE , RIVER FLOW STRONG] ,

en: But when they reached the junction between them, they forgot their fish, and it took its course into the sea, slipping away.
gloss: [top: REACH MEET] , FORGET FISH . FISH GO SEA , ESCAPE .

en: Say, "If the sea were ink for [writing] the words of my Lord, the sea would be exhausted before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even if We brought the like of it in [continual] supplement."
gloss: SAY , [rs-a: [cond: IF SEA INK FOR MY LORD WORD] , SEA FINISH BEFORE MY LORD WORD FINISH , EVEN BRING SEA SAME ADD] .

en: Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day.
gloss: GROUP+ DISAGREE AMONG . [warn: WOE DISBELIEVER , DAY GREAT WITNESS] .

en: [His father] said, "Have you no desire for my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time."
gloss: [rs-b: FATHER SAY , [rhq: YOU HATE MY GOD+ , IBRAHIM] ? [cond: IF NOT STOP] , ME THROW STONE YOU . LEAVE ME LONG TIME] .

en: Then let them end their untidiness and fulfill their vows and perform ṭawāf around the ancient House."
gloss: [rs-c: THEN CLEAN SELF , FULFILL PROMISE , WALK AROUND HOUSE OLD] .

en: That [is so]. And whoever responds [to injustice] with the equivalent of that with which he was harmed and then is tyrannized - Allāh will surely aid him. Indeed, Allāh is Pardoning and Forgiving.
gloss: THAT . PERSON PAY BACK SAME HARM , THEN OPPRESS AGAIN , ALLAH HELP IX . ALLAH PARDON , FORGIVE .

en: O people, an example is presented, so listen to it. Indeed, those you invoke besides Allāh will never create [as much as] a fly, even if they gathered together for it [i.e., that purpose]. And if the fly should steal from them a [tiny] thing, they could not recover it from him. Weak are the pursuer and pursued.
gloss: PEOPLE , EXAMPLE , LISTEN . THING YOU CALL BESIDES ALLAH [neg: NEVER CREATE INSECT SMALL] , EVEN ALL GATHER . [cond: IF INSECT STEAL THING] , [neg: CANNOT TAKE BACK] . WEAK SEEK , WEAK SEEK .

en: But let them who find not [the means for] marriage abstain [from sexual relations] until Allāh enriches them from His bounty. And those who seek a contract [for eventual emancipation] from among whom your right hands possess - then make a contract with them if you know there is within them goodness and give them from the wealth of Allāh which He has given you. And do not compel your slave girls to prostitution, if they desire chastity, to seek [thereby] the temporary interests of worldly life. And if someone should compel them, then indeed, Allāh is [to them], after their compulsion, Forgiving and Merciful.
gloss: PEOPLE NOT FIND MARRY , KEEP CHASTITY UNTIL ALLAH MAKE RICH . SLAVE WANT CONTRACT FREE , WRITE CONTRACT IF YOU KNOW GOOD INSIDE , GIVE FROM ALLAH MONEY . [neg: NOT FORCE SLAVE WOMAN IMMORALITY] IF SHE WANT CHASTITY , FOR WORLD-LIFE BENEFIT . PERSON FORCE , ALLAH FORGIVE , MERCIFUL TO HER .

en: And when they see you, [O Muḥammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one whom Allāh has sent as a messenger?
gloss: [top: THEY SEE YOU] , MOCK , [rs-b: [rhq: THIS PERSON ALLAH SEND MESSENGER]] ?

en: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh].
gloss: [top: SHE ARRIVE] , [rs-c: ASK , [yn: YOUR THRONE SAME THIS]] ? [rs-b: SHE SAY , SAME] . [rs-a: WE GET KNOWLEDGE BEFORE HER , WE MUSLIM] .

en: And there were in the city nine family heads causing corruption in the land and not amending [its affairs].
gloss: IN CITY NINE MAN , CORRUPT LAND , NOT FIX .

en: And he became inside the city fearful and anticipating [exposure], when suddenly the one who sought his help the previous day cried out to him [once again]. Moses said to him, "Indeed, you are an evident, [persistent] deviator."
gloss: MORNING IN CITY , FEAR , WATCH . SUDDENLY MAN ASK HELP YESTERDAY , CALL AGAIN . [rs-a: MUSA SAY , YOU ASTRAY CLEAR] .

en: And how many a city have We destroyed that was insolent in its [way of] living, and those are their dwellings which have not been inhabited after them except briefly. And it is We who were the inheritors.
gloss: [rhq: HOW-MANY CITY WE DESTROY , PROUD LIFE] ? THEIR HOME EMPTY AFTER , ONLY LITTLE . WE INHERIT .

en: And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Then [i.e., otherwise] the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt.
gloss: BEFORE , YOU NOT READ BOOK , NOT WRITE RIGHT HAND . [cond: IF YOU DO] , FALSE PEOPLE DOUBT .

en: And of His signs is that He created you from dust; then, suddenly you were human beings dispersing [throughout the earth].
gloss: IX SIGN-PROOF , CREATE YOU FROM DUST , THEN SUDDENLY YOU HUMAN SPREAD .

en: But those who strive against Our verses [seeking] to cause failure - for them will be a painful punishment of foul nature.
gloss: PEOPLE STRIVE AGAINST OUR VERSE , WANT FAIL , PUNISH PAIN WORST .

en: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees.
gloss: BUT THEY TURN-AWAY . WE SEND FLOOD , BREAK WALL . WE CHANGE TWO GARDEN TO GARDEN FRUIT BITTER , TREE+ , FEW TREE .

en: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me?
gloss: [rs-c rhq: ME TAKE OTHER GOD] ? [cond: IF GRACIOUS WANT HARM ME] , [neg: THEIR INTERCEDE NOT HELP , NOT SAVE ME] .

en: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.
gloss: MOON , ALLAH DECIDE STAGE+ , UNTIL RETURN LIKE PALM BRANCH OLD .

en: If Allāh had intended to take a son, He could have chosen from what He creates whatever He willed. Exalted is He; He is Allāh, the One, the Prevailing.
gloss: [cond: IF ALLAH WANT SON] , IX CHOOSE FROM IX CREATE , IX WANT . [awe: GLORY IX] . IX ALLAH , ONE , MIGHTY .

en: And you were not covering [i.e., protecting] yourselves, lest your hearing testify against you or your sight or your skins, but you assumed that Allāh does not know much of what you do.
gloss: [rs-c: YOU NOT HIDE FROM YOUR EAR , EYE , SKIN WITNESS . YOU THINK ALLAH NOT KNOW MUCH YOU DO] .

en: You will see the wrongdoers fearful of what they have earned, and it will [certainly] befall them. And those who have believed and done righteous deeds will be in lush regions of the gardens [in Paradise] having whatever they will in the presence of their Lord. That is what is the great bounty.
gloss: YOU SEE WRONGDOER AFRAID THEIR EARN , HAPPEN ON THEM . BELIEVER , DO GOOD , IN GARDEN , GET WHAT WANT WITH LORD . THAT BLESS GREAT .

en: Or He makes them [both] males and females, and He renders whom He wills barren. Indeed, He is Knowing and Competent.
gloss: OR BOTH , SON , DAUGHTER , MAKE BARREN WHO IX WANT . IX KNOW , CAN .

en: [Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."
gloss: [rs-a: IX SAY , IF ME BRING BETTER GUIDE THAN YOUR FATHER] ? [rs-b: THEY SAY , WE DENY YOUR MESSAGE] .

en: Before them is Hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides Allāh as allies. And they will have a great punishment.
gloss: BEHIND THEM , HELL . [neg: THEIR EARN NOT HELP , PROTECTOR NOT HELP] . PUNISH BIG .

en: This [Qur’ān] is guidance. And those who have disbelieved in the verses of their Lord will have a painful punishment of foul nature.
gloss: THIS GUIDE . PEOPLE DENY LORD SIGN-PROOF , PUNISH PAIN .

en: And We have enjoined upon man, to his parents, good treatment. His mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with hardship, and his gestation and weaning [period] is thirty months. [He grows] until, when he reaches maturity and reaches [the age of] forty years, he says, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims."
gloss: ALLAH COMMAND PERSON GOOD TO PARENTS . MOTHER CARRY HARD , BORN HARD . CARRY , NURSE , THIRTY MONTH . [top: WHEN GROW STRONG , FORTY YEAR] , [rs-a awe: SAY , MY LORD , HELP ME THANK YOUR BLESS ON ME , MY PARENTS , DO GOOD YOU PLEASED , MAKE MY CHILD GOOD . ME REPENT , ME MUSLIM] .

en: But one who says to his parents, "Uff to you; do you promise me that I will be brought forth [from the earth] when generations before me have already passed on [into oblivion]?" while they call to Allāh for help [and to their son], "Woe to you! Believe! Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth." But he says, "This is not but legends of the former peoples" -
gloss: [top: PERSON SAY TO PARENTS] , [rs-b: UGH YOU , YOU PROMISE ME RESURRECT , GENERATION BEFORE ALREADY PASS] ? PARENTS ASK ALLAH HELP , [rs-a: WOE YOU , BELIEVE , ALLAH PROMISE TRUE] . [rs-b: IX SAY , THIS ONLY STORY OLD] .

en: He said, "Knowledge [of its time] is only with Allāh, and I convey to you that with which I was sent; but I see you [to be] a people behaving ignorantly."
gloss: [rs-a: IX SAY , KNOWLEDGE ONLY WITH ALLAH . ME TELL MESSAGE . BUT ME SEE YOU-ALL PEOPLE IGNORANT] .

en: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people.
gloss: DESTROY EVERYTHING , LORD COMMAND . MORNING , ONLY THEIR HOUSE SEE . SAME PAY SINNER .

en: And We have already destroyed what surrounds you of [those] cities, and We have diversified the signs [or verses] that perhaps they might return [from disbelief].
gloss: ALLAH DESTROY CITY AROUND YOU , SHOW SIGN-PROOF , FOR THEY RETURN .

en: So would you perhaps, if you turned away, cause corruption on earth and sever your [ties of] relationship?
gloss: [rhq: IF YOU TURN-AWAY , MAYBE CORRUPT EARTH , CUT FAMILY] ?

en: Indeed, those who reverted back [to disbelief] after guidance had become clear to them - Satan enticed them and prolonged hope for them.
gloss: PEOPLE TURN BACK AFTER GUIDE CLEAR , DEVIL DECEIVE , GIVE HOPE LONG .

en: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.
gloss: PEOPLE FOREST , PEOPLE fs:TUBBA . ALL DENY MESSENGER , MY PROMISE HAPPEN .

en: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
gloss: SIT COUCH LINE . ALLAH MARRY THEM WOMAN EYE BEAUTIFUL .

en: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.
gloss: ALLAH SEND ONE SHOUT , THEY BECOME LIKE DRY STICK .

en: And [recall] when you slew a man and disputed over it, but Allāh was to bring out that which you were concealing.
gloss: YOU KILL PERSON , ARGUE ABOUT , ALLAH BRING OUT THING YOU HIDE .

en: And for divorced women is a provision according to what is acceptable - a duty upon the righteous.
gloss: DIVORCE WOMAN GET GIFT FAIR , OBLIGATION FEAR-GOD .

en: And their prophet said to them, "Indeed, Allāh has sent to you Saul as a king." They said, "How can he have kingship over us while we are more worthy of kingship than him and he has not been given any measure of wealth?" He said, "Indeed, Allāh has chosen him over you and has increased him abundantly in knowledge and stature. And Allāh gives His sovereignty to whom He wills. And Allāh is all-Encompassing [in favor] and Knowing."
gloss: [rs-a: PROPHET SAY , ALLAH SEND fs:TALUT YOUR KING] . [rs-b: SAY , [rhq: HOW IX KING OVER US , WE MORE RIGHT , IX NOT RICH]] ? [rs-a: SAY , ALLAH CHOOSE IX OVER YOU , ADD KNOWLEDGE , BODY . ALLAH GIVE KINGDOM WHO IX WANT . ALLAH WIDE , KNOW] .

en: Satan threatens you with poverty and orders you to immorality, while Allāh promises you forgiveness from Him and bounty. And Allāh is all-Encompassing and Knowing.
gloss: DEVIL WARN YOU POOR , COMMAND IMMORALITY . ALLAH PROMISE FORGIVE , FAVOR . ALLAH WIDE , KNOW .

en: So the angels called him while he was standing in prayer in the chamber, "Indeed, Allāh gives you good tidings of John, confirming a word from Allāh and [who will be] honorable, abstaining [from women], and a prophet from among the righteous."
gloss: ANGEL CALL IX , STAND PRAY ROOM , [rs-c: ALLAH GIVE YOU GOOD NEWS YAHYA , CONFIRM WORD FROM ALLAH , HONOR , CHASTITY , PROPHET RIGHTEOUS] .

en: And a faction of the People of the Scripture say [to each other], "Believe in that which was revealed to the believers at the beginning of the day and reject it at its end that perhaps they will return [i.e., abandon their religion],
gloss: [rs-b: GROUP PEOPLE BOOK SAY , BELIEVE REVEAL BELIEVER MORNING , DENY EVENING , MAYBE THEY RETURN] ,

en: And among the People of the Scripture is he who, if you entrust him with a great amount [of wealth], he will return it to you. And among them is he who, if you entrust him with a [single] coin, he will not return it to you unless you are constantly standing over him [demanding it]. That is because they say, "There is no blame upon us concerning the unlearned." And they speak untruth about Allāh while they know [it].
gloss: SOME PEOPLE BOOK , [cond: IF TRUST MUCH MONEY] , RETURN . SOME , [cond: IF TRUST ONE MONEY] , NOT RETURN UNLESS YOU STAND OVER . BECAUSE SAY , [rs-b: BLAME NONE ABOUT PEOPLE NOT READ] . SAY LIE ABOUT ALLAH , THEY KNOW .

en: That He might cut down a section of the disbelievers or suppress them so that they turn back disappointed.
gloss: CUT-OFF PART DISBELIEVER , OR DEFEAT , RETURN DISAPPOINT .

en: You will surely be tested in your possessions and in yourselves. And you will surely hear from those who were given the Scripture before you and from those who associate others with Allāh much abuse. But if you are patient and fear Allāh - indeed, that is of the matters [worthy] of resolve.
gloss: SURE TEST YOU MONEY , SELF . HEAR FROM PEOPLE BOOK , POLYTHEIST MUCH HURT . [cond: IF PATIENT , FEAR-GOD] , THAT MATTER STRONG .

en: And whoever does that in aggression and injustice - then We will drive him into a Fire. And that, for Allāh, is [always] easy.
gloss: PERSON DO THAT , TRANSGRESS , UNJUST , WE BURN FIRE . FOR ALLAH EASY .

en: Or have they a share of dominion? Then [if that were so], they would not give the people [even as much as] the speck on a date seed.
gloss: [rhq: THEY HAVE SHARE KINGDOM] ? THEN NOT GIVE PEOPLE EVEN SMALL .

en: And indeed, there is among you he who lingers behind; and if disaster strikes you, he says, "Allāh has favored me in that I was not present with them."
gloss: SOME AMONG YOU DELAY . [top: DISASTER HIT YOU] , [rs-b: SAY , ALLAH FAVOR ME , ME NOT THERE] .

en: O you who have believed, be persistently standing firm in justice, witnesses for Allāh, even if it be against yourselves or parents and relatives. Whether one is rich or poor, Allāh is more worthy of both. So follow not [personal] inclination, lest you not be just. And if you distort [your testimony] or refuse [to give it], then indeed Allāh is ever, of what you do, Aware.
gloss: BELIEVER , STAND FIRM FAIR , WITNESS FOR ALLAH , EVEN AGAINST YOURSELF , PARENTS , RELATIVE . RICH OR POOR , ALLAH MORE RIGHT . [neg: NOT FOLLOW DESIRE , NOT FAIR] . [cond: IF TWIST OR REFUSE] , ALLAH AWARE YOUR DO .

en: Indeed, those who disbelieve and avert [people] from the way of Allāh have certainly gone far astray.
gloss: DISBELIEVER , BLOCK ALLAH PATH , ASTRAY FAR .

en: They said, "O Moses, indeed we will not enter it, ever, as long as they are within it; so go, you and your Lord, and fight. Indeed, we are remaining right here."
gloss: [rs-b: THEY SAY , MUSA , WE NEVER ENTER WHILE THEY THERE . GO , YOU , YOUR LORD , FIGHT . WE SIT HERE] .

en: And those who fear Allāh are not held accountable for them [i.e., the disbelievers] at all, but [only for] a reminder - that perhaps they will fear Him.
gloss: FEAR-GOD [neg: NOT RESPONSIBLE THEIR COUNT] , ONLY REMIND , MAYBE FEAR-GOD .

en: And thus We have placed within every city the greatest of its criminals to conspire therein. But they conspire not except against themselves, and they perceive [it] not.
gloss: SAME , EVERY CITY WE PUT SINNER BIG , PLAN . PLAN ONLY AGAINST SELF , NOT AWARE .

en: Then do they not give thought? There is in their companion [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] no madness. He is not but a clear warner.
gloss: [rhq: THEY NOT THINK] ? THEIR COMPANION NOT CRAZY . IX ONLY WARNER CLEAR .

en: And when Our verses are recited to them, they say, "We have heard. If we willed, we could say [something] like this. This is not but legends of the former peoples."
gloss: [top: RECITE THEM OUR VERSE] , [rs-b: SAY , WE HEAR . [cond: IF WE WANT] , SAY SAME . THIS ONLY STORY OLD] .

en: And do not be like those who came forth from their homes insolently and to be seen by people and avert [them] from the way of Allāh. And Allāh is encompassing of what they do.
gloss: [neg: NOT SAME PEOPLE LEAVE HOME PROUD , SHOW-OFF PEOPLE , BLOCK ALLAH PATH] . ALLAH SURROUND THEIR DO .

en: That is for what your hands have put forth [of evil] and because Allāh is not ever unjust to [His] servants."
gloss: [rs-c: THAT FOR YOUR HAND DO . ALLAH NEVER UNJUST SERVANT] .

en: Indeed, the worst of living creatures in the sight of Allāh are those who have disbelieved, and they will not [ever] believe-
gloss: WORST ANIMAL WITH ALLAH , DISBELIEVER , [neg: NOT BELIEVE] ,

en: They swear by Allāh to you [Muslims] to satisfy you. But Allāh and His Messenger are more worthy for them to satisfy, if they were to be believers.
gloss: THEY SWEAR ALLAH , PLEASE YOU . ALLAH , MESSENGER MORE RIGHT PLEASE , IF BELIEVER .

en: Nor [is there blame] upon those who, when they came to you for you to take them along, you said, "I can find nothing upon which to carry you." They turned back while their eyes overflowed with tears out of grief that they could not find something to spend [for the cause of Allāh].
gloss: ALSO PEOPLE COME ASK YOU CARRY , YOU SAY , [rs-a: ME NOT FIND THING CARRY YOU] . TURN BACK , EYE CRY , SAD , NOT FIND SPEND .

en: For that is Allāh, your Lord, the Truth. And what can be beyond truth except error? So how are you averted?
gloss: THAT ALLAH , YOUR LORD TRUE . [rhq: AFTER TRUE , WHAT EXCEPT ASTRAY] ? [rhq: HOW YOU TURN-AWAY] ?

en: Thus the word [i.e., decree] of your Lord has come into effect upon those who defiantly disobeyed - that they will not believe.
gloss: SAME , YOUR LORD WORD TRUE ON DISOBEY , [neg: NOT BELIEVE] .

en: And to Thamūd [We sent] their brother Ṣāliḥ. He said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him. He has produced you from the earth and settled you in it, so ask forgiveness of Him and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is near and responsive."
gloss: fs:THAMUD , BROTHER SALIH SAY , [rs-a: MY PEOPLE , WORSHIP ALLAH , [neg: GOD NONE] EXCEPT IX . IX CREATE YOU FROM EARTH , SETTLED YOU . ASK FORGIVE , REPENT . MY LORD NEAR , ANSWER] .

en: And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone
gloss: SHOUT CATCH WRONGDOER , MORNING FALLEN IN HOME ,

en: And thus will your Lord choose you and teach you the interpretation of narratives [i.e., events or dreams] and complete His favor upon you and upon the family of Jacob, as He completed it upon your fathers before, Abraham and Isaac. Indeed, your Lord is Knowing and Wise."
gloss: [rs-b: SAME , YOUR LORD CHOOSE YOU , TEACH EXPLAIN DREAM , COMPLETE FAVOR ON YOU , YAQUB FAMILY , SAME FATHER BEFORE , IBRAHIM , ISHAQ . YOUR LORD KNOW , WISE] .

en: Then will come after that a year in which the people will be given rain and in which they will press [olives and grapes]."
gloss: [rs-a: AFTER , ONE YEAR PEOPLE GET RAIN , PRESS FRUIT] .

en: [They continued] until, when the messengers despaired and were certain that they had been denied, there came to them Our victory, and whoever We willed was saved. And Our punishment cannot be repelled from the people who are criminals.
gloss: UNTIL MESSENGER DESPAIR , THINK DENY , OUR HELP COME , SAVE WHO WE WANT . OUR PUNISH [neg: CANNOT STOP] FROM SINNER .

en: And you lived among the dwellings of those who wronged themselves, and it had become clear to you how We dealt with them. And We presented for you [many] examples."
gloss: [rs-c: YOU LIVE HOME PEOPLE WRONG SELF , CLEAR HOW WE DO THEM . WE GIVE YOU EXAMPLE MANY] .

en: And they had planned their plan, but with Allāh is [recorded] their plan, even if their plan had been [sufficient] to do away with the mountains.
gloss: THEY PLAN . ALLAH KNOW PLAN , EVEN PLAN STRONG MOVE MOUNTAIN .

en: [It is] so He will make clear to them [the truth of] that wherein they differ and so those who have disbelieved may know that they were liars.
gloss: IX SHOW THEM THING THEY DISAGREE , DISBELIEVER KNOW THEY LIAR .

en: Or that He would not seize them gradually [in a state of dread]? But indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.
gloss: [rhq: OR CATCH SLOW , AFRAID] ? YOUR LORD KIND , MERCIFUL .

en: And if you punish [an enemy, O believers], punish with an equivalent of that with which you were harmed. But if you are patient - it is better for those who are patient.
gloss: [cond: IF YOU PUNISH] , PUNISH SAME HARM YOU . [cond: IF PATIENT] , BETTER FOR PATIENT .

en: And be patient, [O Muḥammad], and your patience is not but through Allāh. And do not grieve over them and do not be in distress over what they conspire.
gloss: PATIENT , YOUR PATIENT ONLY WITH ALLAH . [neg: NOT SAD FOR THEM , NOT WORRY THEIR PLAN] .

en: And they say, "When we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected as a new creation?"
gloss: [rs-b: THEY SAY , [rhq: WE BONE , DUST , WE RESURRECT CREATION NEW]] ?

en: Indeed, over My [believing] servants there is for you no authority. And sufficient is your Lord as Disposer of affairs.
gloss: [rs-c: MY SERVANT , YOU NOT HAVE AUTHORITY] . YOUR LORD ENOUGH GUARDIAN .

en: And if We willed, We could surely do away with that which We revealed to you. Then you would not find for yourself concerning it an advocate against Us.
gloss: [cond: IF WE WANT] , TAKE AWAY THING WE REVEAL YOU . THEN NOT FIND PROTECTOR AGAINST US ,

en: So We cast [a cover of sleep] over their ears within the cave for a number of years.
gloss: WE COVER THEIR EAR IN CAVE , YEAR+ MANY .

en: Moses said to him, "May I follow you on [the condition] that you teach me from what you have been taught of sound judgement?"
gloss: [rs-a: MUSA ASK , [yn: ME FOLLOW YOU , YOU TEACH ME RIGHT KNOWLEDGE]] ?

en: So we intended that their Lord should substitute for them one better than him in purity and nearer to mercy.
gloss: [rs-b: WE WANT LORD GIVE THEM BETTER , PURE , MORE MERCY] .

en: Bring me bars of iron" - until, when he had leveled [them] between the two mountain walls, he said, "Blow [with bellows]," until when he had made it [like] fire, he said, "Bring me, that I may pour over it molten copper."
gloss: [rs-a: BRING IRON PIECE+] . [top: FILL BETWEEN MOUNTAIN] , [rs-a: BLOW] . [top: BECOME FIRE] , [rs-a: BRING METAL MELT , ME POUR] .

en: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir
gloss: [rs-a: ME FEAR RELATIVE AFTER ME . MY WIFE BARREN . GIVE ME FROM YOU CHILD INHERIT] ,

en: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakāh as long as I remain alive
gloss: [rs-a: IX MAKE ME BLESS WHEREVER ME , COMMAND ME SALAH , ZAKAT , WHILE ME ALIVE] .

en: And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakāh and was to his Lord pleasing [i.e., accepted by Him].
gloss: IX COMMAND FAMILY SALAH , ZAKAT . LORD PLEASED IX .

en: And they have taken besides Allāh [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honor.
gloss: THEY TAKE GOD+ BESIDES ALLAH , WANT HONOR .

en: So resolve upon your plan and then come [forward] in line. And he has succeeded today who overcomes."
gloss: [rs-b: DECIDE PLAN , COME LINE . TODAY PERSON WIN SUCCEED] .

en: [Allāh] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Sāmirī has led them astray."
gloss: [rs-c: ALLAH SAY , WE TEST YOUR PEOPLE AFTER YOU . fs:SAMIRI MISLEAD THEM] .

en: Did they not see that it could not return to them any speech [i.e., response] and that it did not possess for them any harm or benefit?
gloss: [rhq: THEY NOT SEE , CALF NOT ANSWER WORD , NOT OWN HARM , BENEFIT] ?

en: We are most knowing of what they say when the best of them in manner [i.e., wisdom or speech] will say, "You remained not but one day."
gloss: WE KNOW BEST THEIR SAY , BEST AMONG SAY , [rs-b: YOU STAY ONLY ONE DAY] .

en: [The time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away.
gloss: PEOPLE JUDGMENT NEAR , BUT THEY UNAWARE , TURN-AWAY .

en: And [I swear] by Allāh, I will surely plan against your idols after you have turned and gone away."
gloss: [rs-a: SWEAR ALLAH , ME PLAN AGAINST YOUR IDOL AFTER YOU LEAVE] .

en: So whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer - no denial will there be for his effort, and indeed We [i.e., Our angels], of it, are recorders.
gloss: PERSON DO RIGHTEOUS , BELIEVER , WORK [neg: NOT DENY] . WE WRITE .

en: Until when [the dam of] Gog and Magog has been opened and they, from every elevation, descend
gloss: UNTIL fs:YAJUJ , fs:MAJUJ OPEN , COME DOWN FROM EVERY HIGH PLACE ,

en: And they had been guided [in worldly life] to good speech, and they were guided to the path of the Praiseworthy.
gloss: GUIDE TO WORD GOOD , GUIDE TO PATH PRAISE .

en: But the ones who strove against Our verses, [seeking] to cause failure - those are the companions of Hellfire.
gloss: PEOPLE STRIVE AGAINST OUR VERSE , WANT FAIL , THEY COMPANION HELL .

en: He will surely cause them to enter an entrance with which they will be pleased, and indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Forbearing.
gloss: IX ENTER THEM PLACE THEY PLEASED . ALLAH KNOW , PATIENT .

en: And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful.
gloss: IX MAKE YOU HEAR , SEE , HEART . YOU THANK LITTLE .

en: Why did they [who slandered] not produce for it four witnesses? And when they do not produce the witnesses, then it is they, in the sight of Allāh, who are the liars.
gloss: [wh: WHY THEY NOT BRING FOUR WITNESS] ? [top: NOT BRING WITNESS] , WITH ALLAH THEY LIAR .

en: And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]
gloss: NIGHT PROSTRATE , STAND FOR LORD .

en: She said, "O eminent ones, advise me in my affair. I would not decide a matter until you witness [for] me."
gloss: [rs-b: SHE SAY , LEADER+ , ADVISE ME . ME NOT DECIDE UNTIL YOU WITNESS] .

en: Return to them, for we will surely come to them with soldiers that they will be powerless to encounter, and we will surely expel them therefrom in humiliation, and they will be debased."
gloss: [rs-a: RETURN TO THEM . WE COME WITH ARMY THEY CANNOT FIGHT , EXPEL THEM SHAME , HUMBLE] .

en: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting.
gloss: WE SEND fs:THAMUD BROTHER SALIH , [rs-a: WORSHIP ALLAH] . IMMEDIATELY TWO GROUP ARGUE .

en: But as for one who had repented, believed, and done righteousness, it is expected [i.e., promised by Allāh] that he will be among the successful.
gloss: PERSON REPENT , BELIEVE , DO RIGHTEOUS , MAYBE WIN .

en: And We certainly sent Noah to his people, and he remained among them a thousand years minus fifty years, and the flood seized them while they were wrongdoers.
gloss: WE SEND NUH TO PEOPLE . IX STAY THOUSAND YEAR LESS FIFTY . FLOOD CATCH THEM , WRONGDOER .

en: And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Indeed, you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you with from among the worlds.
gloss: LUT SAY PEOPLE , [rs-a: YOU DO IMMORALITY , NOBODY IN WORLD DO BEFORE YOU] .

en: But they denied him, so the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone.
gloss: THEY DENY IX . EARTH SHAKE CATCH THEM , MORNING FALLEN IN HOME .

en: And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will swear they had remained but an hour. Thus they were deluded.
gloss: DAY HOUR COME , SINNER SWEAR , [rs-b: WE STAY ONLY ONE HOUR] . SAME , BEFORE THEY TURN-AWAY .

en: And be moderate in your pace and lower your voice; indeed, the most disagreeable of sounds is the voice of donkeys."
gloss: [rs-a: WALK MIDDLE , VOICE LOW . WORST VOICE , DONKEY VOICE] .

en: If you could but see when the criminals are hanging their heads before their Lord, [saying], "Our Lord, we have seen and heard, so return us [to the world]; we will work righteousness. Indeed, we are [now] certain."
gloss: [cond: IF YOU SEE SINNER HEAD DOWN FRONT LORD] , [rs-b: OUR LORD , WE SEE , HEAR . SEND US BACK , WE DO RIGHTEOUS . NOW WE SURE] .

en: And no soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for eyes [i.e., satisfaction] as reward for what they used to do.
gloss: [neg: NOBODY KNOW] HIDDEN FOR THEM , EYE HAPPY , REWARD FOR THEIR DO .

en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "On the Day of Conquest the belief of those who had disbelieved will not benefit them, nor will they be reprieved."
gloss: SAY , [rs-a: DAY WIN , DISBELIEVER FAITH [neg: NOT BENEFIT] , NOT DELAY] .

en: And they will say, "Our Lord, indeed we obeyed our masters and our dignitaries, and they led us astray from the [right] way.
gloss: [rs-b: SAY , OUR LORD , WE OBEY OUR LEADER , BIG PEOPLE , THEY MISLEAD US FROM PATH] .

en: O you who have believed, be not like those who abused Moses; then Allāh cleared him of what they said. And he, in the sight of Allāh, was distinguished.
gloss: BELIEVER , [neg: NOT SAME PEOPLE HURT MUSA] . ALLAH CLEAR IX FROM THEIR SAY . IX HONOR WITH ALLAH .

en: O you who have believed, fear Allāh and speak words of appropriate justice.
gloss: BELIEVER , FEAR-GOD ALLAH , SAY WORD RIGHT .

en: They will say, "Exalted are You! You, [O Allāh], are our benefactor excluding [i.e., not] them. Rather, they used to worship the jinn; most of them were believers in them."
gloss: [rs-c: ANGEL SAY , GLORY YOU . YOU OUR PROTECTOR , NOT THEM . NO , THEY WORSHIP JINN , MOST BELIEVE JINN] .

en: Say, "I only advise you of one [thing] - that you stand for Allāh, [seeking truth] in pairs and individually, and then give thought." There is not in your companion any madness. He is only a warner to you before a severe punishment.
gloss: SAY , [rs-a: ME ADVISE YOU ONE THING , STAND FOR ALLAH , TWO , ONE , THEN THINK . YOUR COMPANION NOT CRAZY . IX ONLY WARNER BEFORE PUNISH STRONG] .

en: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? And they were greater than them in power. But Allāh is not to be caused failure [i.e., prevented] by anything in the heavens or on the earth. Indeed, He is ever Knowing and Competent.
gloss: [rhq: THEY NOT TRAVEL LAND , LOOK PEOPLE BEFORE , END HOW] ? BEFORE STRONGER . [neg: NOTHING IN SKY , EARTH STOP ALLAH] . IX KNOW , POWER .

en: So today [i.e., the Day of Judgement] no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.
gloss: [top: TODAY] , [neg: SOUL NOT OPPRESS] , ONLY PAY YOUR DO .

en: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship
gloss: [rs-c: GATHER WRONGDOER , THEIR KIND , THING THEY WORSHIP] ,

en: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.
gloss: THEY SURPRISE , WARNER COME FROM AMONG THEM . [rs-b: DISBELIEVER SAY , THIS MAGIC , LIAR] .

en: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.
gloss: [rhq: OR KINGDOM SKY , EARTH , BETWEEN BELONG THEM] ? [cond: IF YES] , LET THEM CLIMB UP .

en: Say, "O my people, work according to your position, [for] indeed, I am working; and you are going to know
gloss: SAY , [rs-a: MY PEOPLE , WORK YOUR WAY , ME WORK . LATER YOU KNOW] ,

en: Lest a soul should say, "Oh, [how great is] my regret over what I neglected in regard to Allāh and that I was among the mockers."
gloss: [rs-b: SO SOUL NOT SAY , [sad: REGRET ME NEGLECT ALLAH , ME MOCK]] ,

en: [The angels will say], "That was because you used to exult upon the earth without right and you used to behave insolently.
gloss: [rs-c: BECAUSE YOU HAPPY ON EARTH WITHOUT RIGHT , YOU ARROGANT] .

en: But none is granted it except those who are patient, and none is granted it except one having a great portion [of good].
gloss: [neg: NONE GET THIS , ONLY PATIENT , ONLY PERSON BLESS GREAT] .

en: We will show them Our signs in the horizons and within themselves until it becomes clear to them that it is the truth. But is it not sufficient concerning your Lord that He is, over all things, a Witness?
gloss: FUTURE ALLAH SHOW THEM SIGN-PROOF IN HORIZON , IN SELF , UNTIL CLEAR , QURAN TRUE . [rhq: NOT ENOUGH , YOUR LORD WITNESS EVERYTHING] ?

en: And those who take as allies other than Him - Allāh is [yet] Guardian over them; and you, [O Muḥammad], are not over them a manager.
gloss: PEOPLE TAKE PROTECTOR BESIDES ALLAH , ALLAH WATCH . [neg: YOU NOT RESPONSIBLE THEM] .

en: So to that [religion of Allāh] invite, [O Muḥammad], and remain on a right course as you are commanded and do not follow their inclinations but say, "I have believed in what Allāh has revealed of scripture [i.e., the Qur’ān], and I have been commanded to do justice among you. Allāh is our Lord and your Lord. For us are our deeds, and for you your deeds. There is no [need for] argument between us and you. Allāh will bring us together, and to Him is the [final] destination."
gloss: SO CALL , STRAIGHT SAME COMMAND , [neg: NOT FOLLOW DESIRE] . SAY , [rs-c: ME BELIEVE ALLAH SEND-DOWN BOOK . COMMAND ME FAIR . ALLAH OUR LORD , YOUR LORD . OUR DO FOR US , YOUR DO FOR YOU . NOT ARGUE . ALLAH GATHER US . TO IX DESTINATION] .

en: Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people?
gloss: [rhq: ALLAH TURN-AWAY REMINDER FROM YOU , BECAUSE YOU-ALL PEOPLE EXCEED] ?

en: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship
gloss: [top: WHEN IBRAHIM SAY FATHER , PEOPLE] , [rs-a: ME FREE FROM THING YOU WORSHIP] ,

en: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.
gloss: [rhq: THEY DIVIDE LORD MERCY] ? ALLAH DIVIDE THEIR LIFE IN WORLD-LIFE , RAISE SOME OVER OTHER , FOR SOME SERVE OTHER . LORD MERCY BETTER THAN THING GATHER .

en: And when the people are gathered [that Day], they [who were invoked] will be enemies to them, and they will be deniers of their worship.
gloss: [top: WHEN PEOPLE GATHER] , THOSE BECOME ENEMY , DENY THEIR WORSHIP .

en: And for all there are degrees [of reward and punishment] for what they have done, and [it is] so that He may fully compensate them for their deeds, and they will not be wronged.
gloss: EACH STAGE BECAUSE THEIR DO . ALLAH PAY FULL , [neg: NOT OPPRESS] .

en: That is because they disliked what Allāh revealed, so He rendered worthless their deeds.
gloss: BECAUSE HATE THING ALLAH SEND-DOWN , SO DO LOST .

en: He [i.e., man] utters no word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].
gloss: [neg: PERSON NOT SAY WORD , ONLY GUARD READY WATCH] .

en: So Allāh conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.
gloss: [rs-a: ALLAH BLESS US , SAVE FROM PUNISH WIND HOT] .

en: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn].
gloss: TELL THEM , WATER DIVIDE , EACH DRINK TURN .

en: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.
gloss: DENY ALL OUR SIGN-PROOF . ALLAH TAKE , POWER , MIGHTY .

en: You [believers] are more fearful within their breasts than Allāh. That is because they are a people who do not understand.
gloss: THEY AFRAID YOU MORE THAN ALLAH , BECAUSE PEOPLE NOT UNDERSTAND .

en: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] torment for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
gloss: [rs-a awe: OUR LORD , NOT MAKE US TEST FOR DISBELIEVER . FORGIVE US , OUR LORD . YOU POWER , WISE] .

en: And it tasted the bad consequence of its affair [i.e., rebellion], and the outcome of its affair was loss.
gloss: THEY TASTE RESULT THEIR DO . RESULT , LOSE .

en: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful."
gloss: SAY , ALLAH CREATE YOU , GIVE HEAR , SEE , HEART . YOU-ALL THANK LITTLE .

en: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge?
gloss: [rhq: OR YOU-ALL HAVE PROMISE FROM US , UNTIL JUDGMENT-DAY , YOU GET WHAT JUDGE] ?

en: Which He [i.e., Allāh] imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
gloss: SEVEN NIGHT , EIGHT DAY CONTINUE . YOU SEE PEOPLE FALL DEAD , LIKE DATE-PALM TREE EMPTY FALL .

en: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past."
gloss: [rs-c: EAT , DRINK , ENJOY , BECAUSE YOU-ALL DO GOOD BEFORE , DAY PAST] .

en: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.
gloss: [top: DAY] , EXIT GRAVE QUICK , LIKE RUN TO GOAL ,

en: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.
gloss: [rs-a: GIVE MONEY , SON , GARDEN , RIVER] .

en: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back.
gloss: [top: THAT DAY] , ALLAH TELL PERSON , WHAT SEND BEFORE , WHAT LEAVE BEHIND .

en: So Allāh will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness
gloss: SO ALLAH SAVE THEM FROM THAT DAY EVIL , GIVE BRIGHT , HAPPY .

en: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],
gloss: SERVANT PASS CUP SILVER , GLASS ,

en: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.
gloss: [aff: THOSE PEOPLE LOVE WORLD-LIFE NOW , LEAVE DAY HEAVY BEHIND] .

en: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.
gloss: ALLAH CREATE THEM , MAKE STRONG . [cond: IF ALLAH WANT] , CHANGE , BRING PEOPLE SAME .

en: So Allāh seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression]..
gloss: ALLAH TAKE IX , PUNISH , HEREAFTER , FIRST WORLD-LIFE .

en: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allāh.
gloss: [top: DAY] , [neg: NONE CAN HELP OTHER] . THAT DAY , COMMAND ALLAH ONLY .

en: And the messenger of Allāh [i.e., Ṣāliḥ] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allāh or [prevent her from] her drink."
gloss: MESSENGER ALLAH SAY , [rs-a: CAMEL ALLAH , LET IX DRINK] .

en: And [recall] when We said, "Enter this city [i.e., Jerusalem] and eat from it wherever you will in [ease and] abundance, and enter the gate bowing humbly and say, 'Relieve us of our burdens [i.e., sins].' We will [then] forgive your sins for you, and We will increase the doers of good [in goodness and reward]."
gloss: [rs-c: WE SAY , ENTER THIS CITY , EAT WHEREVER WANT MANY , ENTER DOOR BOW , SAY , REMOVE OUR BURDEN . WE FORGIVE SIN , ADD GOOD PEOPLE] .

en: Do you not consider, [O Muḥammad], those who were given a portion of the Scripture? They are invited to the Scripture of Allāh that it should arbitrate between them; then a party of them turns away, and they are refusing.
gloss: [rhq: YOU NOT SEE PEOPLE GET PART BOOK , INVITE ALLAH BOOK JUDGE BETWEEN , GROUP TURN-AWAY , REFUSE] ?

en: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing."
gloss: fs:IMRAN WIFE SAY , [rs-b: MY LORD , ME PROMISE YOU THING IN MY STOMACH , FREE FOR YOU . ACCEPT FROM ME . YOU HEAR , KNOW] .

en: But if you want to replace one wife with another and you have given one of them a great amount [in gifts], do not take [back] from it anything. Would you take it in injustice and manifest sin?
gloss: [cond: IF WANT CHANGE WIFE , GIVE ONE MUCH] , [neg: NOT TAKE BACK ANYTHING] . [rhq: YOU TAKE UNFAIR , SIN CLEAR] ?

en: Allāh wants to make clear to you [the lawful from the unlawful] and guide you to the [good] practices of those before you and to accept your repentance. And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
gloss: ALLAH WANT EXPLAIN YOU , GUIDE YOU WAY PEOPLE BEFORE , ACCEPT REPENT . ALLAH KNOW , WISE .

en: So fight, [O Muḥammad], in the cause of Allāh; you are not held responsible except for yourself. And encourage the believers [to join you] that perhaps Allāh will restrain the [military] might of those who disbelieve. And Allāh is greater in might and stronger in [exemplary] punishment.
gloss: FIGHT ALLAH PATH , YOU RESPONSIBLE ONLY YOURSELF . ENCOURAGE BELIEVER , MAYBE ALLAH STOP DISBELIEVER POWER . ALLAH POWER STRONGER , PUNISH STRONGER .

en: And never is it for a believer to kill a believer except by mistake. And whoever kills a believer by mistake - then the freeing of a believing slave and a compensation payment [diyah] presented to his [i.e., the deceased's] family [is required], unless they give [up their right as] charity. But if he [i.e., the deceased] was from a people at war with you and he was a believer - then [only] the freeing of a believing slave; and if he was from a people with whom you have a treaty - then a compensation payment presented to his family and the freeing of a believing slave. And whoever does not find [one or cannot afford to buy one] - then [instead], a fast for two months consecutively, [seeking] acceptance of repentance from Allāh. And Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.
gloss: BELIEVER [neg: NOT KILL BELIEVER] EXCEPT MISTAKE . PERSON KILL BELIEVER MISTAKE , FREE SLAVE BELIEVER , PAY FAMILY , EXCEPT FAMILY GIVE CHARITY . [cond: IF FROM ENEMY PEOPLE , BELIEVER] , FREE SLAVE BELIEVER . [cond: IF FROM PEOPLE TREATY] , PAY FAMILY , FREE SLAVE BELIEVER . PERSON NOT FIND , FAST TWO MONTH CONTINUE , REPENT FROM ALLAH . ALLAH KNOW , WISE .

en: And whoever does righteous deeds, whether male or female, while being a believer - those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged, [even as much as] the speck on a date seed.
gloss: PERSON DO RIGHTEOUS , MAN OR WOMAN , BELIEVER , ENTER PARADISE , [neg: NOT UNFAIR , EVEN SMALL] .

en: They request from you a [legal] ruling. Say, "Allāh gives you a ruling concerning one having neither descendants nor ascendants [as heirs]." If a man dies, leaving no child but [only] a sister, she will have half of what he left. And he inherits from her if she [dies and] has no child. But if there are two sisters [or more], they will have two thirds of what he left. If there are both brothers and sisters, the male will have the share of two females. Allāh makes clear to you [His law], lest you go astray. And Allāh is Knowing of all things.
gloss: THEY ASK YOU JUDGE . SAY , [rs-a: ALLAH TELL YOU ABOUT PERSON CHILD NONE , PARENTS NONE . [cond: IF MAN DIE , CHILD NONE , HAVE SISTER] , SISTER GET HALF . [cond: IF SISTER DIE , CHILD NONE] , BROTHER INHERIT . [cond: IF TWO SISTER] , GET TWO THIRD . [cond: IF BROTHER , SISTER] , MAN GET SAME TWO WOMAN . ALLAH EXPLAIN YOU , NOT ASTRAY . ALLAH KNOW ALL THING] .

en: And Ishmael and Elisha and Jonah and Lot - and all [of them] We preferred over the worlds.
gloss: ISMAIL , ALYASA , YUNUS , LUT , ALL WE FAVOR OVER WORLD .

en: And cause not corruption upon the earth after its reformation. And invoke Him in fear and aspiration. Indeed, the mercy of Allāh is near to the doers of good.
gloss: [neg: NOT CORRUPT EARTH AFTER FIX] . CALL IX FEAR , HOPE . ALLAH MERCY NEAR GOOD PEOPLE .

en: [Noah] said, "O my people, there is not error in me, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds.
gloss: [rs-a: NUH SAY , MY PEOPLE , ME NOT ASTRAY . ME MESSENGER FROM LORD ALL WORLD] .

en: And to Allāh belong the best names, so invoke Him by them. And leave [the company of] those who practice deviation concerning His names. They will be recompensed for what they have been doing.
gloss: NAME BEST BELONG ALLAH , CALL IX BY NAME . LEAVE PEOPLE TWIST IX NAME . THEY PAY FOR DO .

en: The Day when it will be heated in the fire of Hell and seared therewith will be their foreheads, their flanks, and their backs, [it will be said], "This is what you hoarded for yourselves, so taste what you used to hoard."
gloss: DAY HEAT IN HELL FIRE , BURN FOREHEAD , SIDE , BACK . [rs-c: THIS YOU KEEP FOR SELF . TASTE YOUR KEEP] .

en: So He penalized them with hypocrisy in their hearts until the Day they will meet Him - because they failed Allāh in what they promised Him and because they [habitually] used to lie.
gloss: IX PUT HYPOCRITE IN HEART UNTIL DAY MEET IX , BECAUSE BREAK PROMISE , LIE .

en: Unquestionably, to Allāh belongs whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth. And those who invoke other than Allāh do not [actually] follow [His] "partners." They follow not except assumption, and they are not but misjudging.
gloss: [aff: EVERYONE SKY , EARTH BELONG ALLAH] . PEOPLE CALL BESIDES ALLAH , [neg: NOT FOLLOW PARTNER TRUE] , FOLLOW ONLY GUESS , ONLY LIE .

en: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Indeed, I am to you a clear warner
gloss: WE SEND NUH TO PEOPLE , [rs-a: ME YOUR WARNER CLEAR] ,

en: And when the fright had left Abraham and the good tidings had reached him, he began to argue [i.e., plead] with Us concerning the people of Lot.
gloss: [top: FEAR GONE , GOOD NEWS COME] , IBRAHIM ARGUE US ABOUT LUT PEOPLE .

en: So when they took him [out] and agreed to put him into the bottom of the well... But We inspired to him, "You will surely inform them [someday] about this affair of theirs while they do not perceive [your identity]."
gloss: [top: TAKE IX , AGREE PUT BOTTOM WELL] , WE INSPIRE IX , [rs-c: LATER YOU TELL THEM THIS , THEY NOT KNOW] .

en: And she certainly determined [to seduce] him, and he would have inclined to her had he not seen the proof [i.e., sign] of his Lord. And thus [it was] that We should avert from him evil and immorality. Indeed, he was of Our chosen servants.
gloss: SHE WANT IX . IX ALMOST WANT , [cond: IF NOT SEE LORD PROOF] . SAME , WE AVOID IX EVIL , IMMORALITY . IX OUR SERVANT CHOSEN .

en: And he said, "O my sons, do not enter from one gate but enter from different gates; and I cannot avail you against [the decree of] Allāh at all. The decision is only for Allāh; upon Him I have relied, and upon Him let those who would rely [indeed] rely."
gloss: [rs-b: SAY , MY SON+ , NOT ENTER ONE DOOR , ENTER DOOR DIFFERENT . ME NOT HELP YOU AGAINST ALLAH . JUDGE ONLY ALLAH . ME TRUST IX . PEOPLE TRUST , TRUST IX] .

en: And We certainly know that they say, "It is only a human being who teaches him [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)]." The tongue of the one they refer to is foreign, and this [recitation, i.e., Qur’ān] is [in] a clear Arabic language.
gloss: WE KNOW THEY SAY , [rs-b: ONLY PERSON TEACH IX] . PERSON THEY MEAN , LANGUAGE NOT ARABIC . THIS ARABIC CLEAR .

en: And We conveyed to the Children of Israel in the Scripture that, "You will surely cause corruption on the earth twice, and you will surely reach [a degree of] great haughtiness."
gloss: WE TELL ISRAIL CHILD IN BOOK , [rs-c: YOU CORRUPT EARTH TWO TIME , PROUD BIG] .

en: Then do you feel secure that [instead] He will not cause a part of the land to swallow you or send against you a storm of stones? Then you would not find for yourselves an advocate.
gloss: [rhq: YOU SAFE , IX NOT MAKE LAND SWALLOW YOU , OR SEND STORM STONE] ? THEN YOU NOT FIND PROTECTOR .

en: Establish prayer at the decline of the sun [from its meridian] until the darkness of the night and [also] the Qur’ān [i.e., recitation] of dawn. Indeed, the recitation of dawn is ever witnessed.
gloss: ESTABLISH SALAH , SUN DOWN UNTIL NIGHT DARK , QURAN DAWN . QURAN DAWN , WITNESS .

en: [The youths said to one another], "And when you have withdrawn from them and that which they worship other than Allāh, retreat to the cave. Your Lord will spread out for you of His mercy and will prepare for you from your affair facility."
gloss: [rs-b: [top: YOU LEAVE THEM , THEIR WORSHIP BESIDES ALLAH] , GO CAVE . YOUR LORD SPREAD MERCY , MAKE YOUR MATTER EASY] .

en: And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
gloss: REMEMBER IN BOOK IDRIS . IX TRUTHFUL , PROPHET .

en: Or have they taken gods besides Him? Say, [O Muḥammad], "Produce your proof. This [Qur’ān] is the message for those with me and the message of those before me." But most of them do not know the truth, so they are turning away.
gloss: [rhq: THEY TAKE GOD+ BESIDES IX] ? SAY , [rs-a: BRING YOUR PROOF . THIS REMINDER PEOPLE WITH ME , REMINDER PEOPLE BEFORE ME] . BUT MOST [neg: NOT KNOW TRUE] , TURN-AWAY .

en: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient.
gloss: ISMAIL , IDRIS , DHULKIFL , ALL PATIENT .

en: And [when] the true promise [i.e., the resurrection] has approached; then suddenly the eyes of those who disbelieved will be staring [in horror, while they say], "O woe to us; we had been unmindful of this; rather, we were wrongdoers."
gloss: PROMISE TRUE NEAR . SUDDENLY DISBELIEVER EYE OPEN WIDE , LOOK , [rs-b: [sad: WOE US , WE UNAWARE THIS . NO , WE WRONGDOER]] .

en: Tell the believing men to reduce [some] of their vision and guard their private parts. That is purer for them. Indeed, Allāh is [fully] Aware of what they do.
gloss: TELL BELIEVER MAN , EYE LOOK-DOWN , PROTECT PRIVATE . THAT MORE PURE . ALLAH AWARE THEIR DO .

en: And the Messenger has said, "O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur’ān as [a thing] abandoned."
gloss: [rs-a: MESSENGER SAY , MY LORD , MY PEOPLE LEAVE THIS QURAN] .

en: And when the word [i.e., decree] befalls them, We will bring forth for them a creature from the earth speaking to them, [saying] that the people were, of Our verses, not certain [in faith].
gloss: [top: WORD TRUE ON THEM] , WE BRING OUT ANIMAL FROM EARTH , TALK THEM , PEOPLE NOT SURE OUR VERSE .

en: And to recite the Qur’ān." And whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] himself; and whoever strays - say, "I am only [one] of the warners."
gloss: [rs-a: RECITE QURAN] . PERSON GUIDE , FOR SELF . PERSON ASTRAY , SAY , [rs-a: ME ONLY WARNER] .

en: So give the relative his right, as well as the needy and the traveler. That is best for those who desire the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh, and it is they who will be the successful.
gloss: GIVE RELATIVE RIGHT , POOR , TRAVELER . THAT BEST FOR PEOPLE WANT ALLAH FACE . THEY WIN .

en: O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you. Indeed, [all] that is of the matters [requiring] resolve.
gloss: [rs-a: MY SON , ESTABLISH SALAH , COMMAND GOOD , FORBID BAD , PATIENT WHAT HAPPEN YOU . THAT MATTER STRONG] .

en: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward.
gloss: YOU ONLY WARN PERSON FOLLOW REMINDER , AFRAID GRACIOUS , NOT SEE . [happy: TELL IX , FORGIVE , REWARD HONOR] .

en: And We have certainly presented for the people in this Qur’ān from every [kind of] example - that they might remember.
gloss: WE GIVE PEOPLE IN QURAN EVERY KIND EXAMPLE , MAYBE THEY REMEMBER .

en: Indeed, We sent down to you the Book for the people in truth. So whoever is guided - it is for [the benefit of] his soul; and whoever goes astray only goes astray to its detriment. And you are not a manager [i.e., authority] over them.
gloss: WE SEND-DOWN BOOK TO YOU FOR PEOPLE , TRUE . PERSON GUIDE , FOR SELF . PERSON ASTRAY , HARM SELF . YOU NOT GUARDIAN OVER THEM .

en: And not equal are the good deed and the bad. Repel [evil] by that [deed] which is better; and thereupon, the one whom between you and him is enmity [will become] as though he was a devoted friend.
gloss: [neg: GOOD , EVIL , NOT EQUAL] . PUSH-AWAY EVIL WITH BETTER . THEN ENEMY BECOME FRIEND CLOSE .

en: That is because you took the verses of Allāh in ridicule, and worldly life deluded you." So that Day they will not be removed from it, nor will they be asked to appease [Allāh].
gloss: [rs-c: BECAUSE YOU MOCK ALLAH SIGN-PROOF , WORLD-LIFE DECEIVE YOU] . TODAY NOT EXIT , NOT ACCEPT EXCUSE .

en: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.
gloss: BEFORE , NUH PEOPLE DENY . DENY OUR SERVANT , [rs-b: SAY , CRAZY] , PUSH-AWAY .

en: Allāh does not forbid you from those who do not fight you because of religion and do not expel you from your homes - from being righteous toward them and acting justly toward them. Indeed, Allāh loves those who act justly.
gloss: [neg: ALLAH NOT FORBID YOU , KIND , FAIR TO PEOPLE NOT FIGHT YOU FOR RELIGION , NOT PUSH-AWAY YOU FROM HOME] . ALLAH LOVE PEOPLE FAIR .

en: And if you have lost any of your wives to the disbelievers and you subsequently obtain [something], then give those whose wives have gone the equivalent of what they had spent. And fear Allāh, in whom you are believers.
gloss: [cond: IF WIFE LEAVE TO DISBELIEVER , YOU WIN] , GIVE HUSBAND SAME THEY SPEND . FEAR-GOD ALLAH , YOU BELIEVE .

en: But [on one occasion] when they saw a transaction or a diversion, [O Muḥammad], they rushed to it and left you standing. Say, "What is with Allāh is better than diversion and than a transaction, and Allāh is the best of providers."
gloss: [top: WHEN THEY SEE TRADE , PLAY] , RUN TO IT , LEAVE YOU STAND . SAY , [aff: WITH ALLAH , BETTER THAN PLAY , TRADE . ALLAH BEST PROVIDE] .

en: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.
gloss: [rs-a: NUH SAY , MY LORD , ME CALL MY PEOPLE NIGHT , DAY] ,

en: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.
gloss: [rs-a: NUH SAY , MY LORD , NOT LEAVE DISBELIEVER ON EARTH] .

en: The lightning almost snatches away their sight. Every time it lights [the way] for them, they walk therein; but when darkness comes over them, they stand [still]. And if Allāh had willed, He could have taken away their hearing and their sight. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.
gloss: LIGHTNING ALMOST TAKE EYE . [top: LIGHT] , WALK . [top: DARK] , STAND . [cond: IF ALLAH WANT] , TAKE HEAR , SEE . ALLAH POWER OVER ALL THING .

en: There shall be no compulsion in [acceptance of] the religion. The right course has become distinct from the wrong. So whoever disbelieves in ṭāghūt and believes in Allāh has grasped the most trustworthy handhold with no break in it. And Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.
gloss: [aff: FORCE NONE IN RELIGION] . RIGHT CLEAR FROM WRONG . PERSON DENY FALSE-GOD , BELIEVE ALLAH , HOLD ROPE STRONG MOST , NEVER BREAK . ALLAH HEAR , KNOW .

en: And if a woman fears from her husband contempt or evasion, there is no sin upon them if they make terms of settlement between them - and settlement is best. And present in [human] souls is stinginess. But if you do good and fear Allāh - then indeed Allāh is ever, of what you do, Aware.
gloss: [cond: IF WOMAN FEAR HUSBAND HATE , TURN-AWAY] , [neg: SIN NONE] MAKE PEACE BETWEEN . PEACE BEST . SOUL STINGY . [cond: IF DO GOOD , FEAR-GOD] , ALLAH AWARE YOUR DO .

en: And likewise, to many of the polytheists their partners have made [to seem] pleasing the killing of their children in order to bring about their destruction and to cover them with confusion in their religion. And if Allāh had willed, they would not have done so. So leave them and that which they invent.
gloss: SAME , PARTNER MAKE MANY POLYTHEIST KILL CHILD LOOK GOOD , DESTROY THEM , MIX RELIGION . [cond: IF ALLAH WANT] , NOT DO . LEAVE THEM , THEIR INVENT .

en: [Remember, O Muḥammad], when Allāh showed them to you in your dream as few; and if He had shown them to you as many, you [believers] would have lost courage and would have disputed in the matter [of whether to fight], but Allāh saved [you from that]. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
gloss: ALLAH SHOW YOU IN DREAM THEM FEW . [cond: IF SHOW MANY] , YOU WEAK , ARGUE . BUT ALLAH SAVE . IX KNOW INSIDE CHEST .

en: And prepare against them whatever you are able of power and of steeds of war by which you may terrify the enemy of Allāh and your enemy and others besides them whom you do not know [but] whom Allāh knows. And whatever you spend in the cause of Allāh will be fully repaid to you, and you will not be wronged.
gloss: PREPARE AGAINST THEM POWER YOU CAN , HORSE , ALLAH ENEMY , YOUR ENEMY AFRAID , OTHER YOU NOT KNOW , ALLAH KNOW . ANYTHING SPEND ALLAH PATH , PAY FULL , [neg: NOT UNFAIR] .

en: Has there not reached them the news of those before them - the people of Noah and [the tribes of] ʿAad and Thamūd and the people of Abraham and the companions [i.e., dwellers] of Madyan and the towns overturned? Their messengers came to them with clear proofs. And Allāh would never have wronged them, but they were wronging themselves.
gloss: [rhq: NEWS NOT REACH THEM , NUH PEOPLE , fs:AAD , fs:THAMUD , IBRAHIM PEOPLE , fs:MADYAN , CITY OVERTURN] ? MESSENGER COME PROOF CLEAR . ALLAH NOT WRONG THEM , THEY WRONG SELF .

en: And [there are] those [hypocrites] who took for themselves a mosque for causing harm and disbelief and division among the believers and as a station for whoever had warred against Allāh and His Messenger before. And they will surely swear, "We intended only the best." And Allāh testifies that indeed they are liars.
gloss: SOME TAKE MOSQUE HARM , DISBELIEVE , DIVIDE BELIEVER , WAIT FOR PERSON FIGHT ALLAH , MESSENGER BEFORE . [rs-b: SWEAR , WE WANT ONLY GOOD] . ALLAH TESTIFY THEY LIAR .

en: They impatiently urge you to bring about evil before good, while there has already occurred before them similar punishments [to what they demand]. And indeed, your Lord is the possessor of forgiveness for the people despite their wrongdoing, and indeed, your Lord is severe in penalty.
gloss: THEY ASK YOU HURRY EVIL BEFORE GOOD , BUT BEFORE PUNISH SAME HAPPEN . YOUR LORD FORGIVE PEOPLE , EVEN WRONG . YOUR LORD PUNISH STRONG .

en: Then is He who is a maintainer of every soul, [knowing] what it has earned, [like any other]? But to Allāh they have attributed partners. Say, "Name them. Or do you inform Him of that which He knows not upon the earth or of what is apparent [i.e., alleged] of speech?" Rather, their [own] plan has been made attractive to those who disbelieve, and they have been averted from the way. And whomever Allāh sends astray - there will be for him no guide.
gloss: [rhq: IX WATCH EVERY SOUL EARN , SAME OTHER] ? BUT THEY MAKE PARTNER ALLAH . SAY , [rs-a: NAME THEM . [rhq: YOU TELL IX THING IX NOT KNOW ON EARTH , OR ONLY WORD EMPTY]] ? NO , DISBELIEVER PLAN LOOK BEAUTIFUL , BLOCK FROM PATH . PERSON ALLAH LET ASTRAY , GUIDE NONE .

en: O you who have believed, do not take My enemies and your enemies as allies, extending to them affection while they have disbelieved in what came to you of the truth, having driven out the Prophet and yourselves [only] because you believe in Allāh, your Lord. If you have come out for jihād [i.e., fighting or striving] in My cause and seeking means to My approval, [take them not as friends]. You confide to them affection [i.e., instruction], but I am most knowing of what you have concealed and what you have declared. And whoever does it among you has certainly strayed from the soundness of the way.
gloss: BELIEVER , [neg: NOT TAKE MY ENEMY , YOUR ENEMY , FRIEND , SHOW LOVE] . THEY DENY TRUE COME TO YOU-ALL , PUSH-AWAY MESSENGER , YOU , BECAUSE YOU BELIEVE ALLAH , YOUR LORD . [cond: IF YOU LEAVE FOR STRIVE MY PATH , SEEK MY PLEASED] , [rhq: YOU SHOW LOVE SECRET] ? ME KNOW HIDE , SHOW . PERSON DO THAT , ASTRAY FROM PATH STRAIGHT .

en: O Prophet, when you [Muslims] divorce women, divorce them for [the commencement of] their waiting period and keep count of the waiting period, and fear Allāh, your Lord. Do not turn them out of their [husbands'] houses, nor should they [themselves] leave [during that period] unless they are committing a clear immorality. And those are the limits [set by] Allāh. And whoever transgresses the limits of Allāh has certainly wronged himself. You know not; perhaps Allāh will bring about after that a [different] matter.
gloss: PROPHET , [top: WHEN YOU-ALL DIVORCE WOMAN] , DIVORCE FOR WAITING TIME , COUNT WAITING TIME . FEAR-GOD ALLAH , YOUR LORD . [neg: NOT PUSH-AWAY THEM FROM HOUSE , THEY NOT LEAVE] , ONLY IF DO SIN CLEAR . THAT ALLAH LIMIT . PERSON EXCEED ALLAH LIMIT , WRONG SELF . YOU NOT KNOW , MAYBE ALLAH MAKE NEW THING AFTER .

en: And when they meet those who believe, they say, "We believe"; but when they are alone with their evil ones, they say, "Indeed, we are with you; we were only mockers."
gloss: [top: MEET BELIEVER] , [rs-b: SAY , WE BELIEVE] . [top: ALONE WITH DEVIL] , [rs-b: SAY , WE WITH YOU , WE ONLY MOCK] .

en: O you who have believed, prescribed for you is legal retribution for those murdered - the free for the free, the slave for the slave, and the female for the female. But whoever overlooks from his brother [i.e., the killer] anything, then there should be a suitable follow-up and payment to him [i.e., the deceased's heir or legal representative] with good conduct. This is an alleviation from your Lord and a mercy. But whoever transgresses after that will have a painful punishment.
gloss: BELIEVER , DECREE YOU RETRIBUTION KILL , FREE FOR FREE , SLAVE FOR SLAVE , WOMAN FOR WOMAN . [cond: IF BROTHER PARDON] , FOLLOW FAIR , PAY GOOD . THAT LIGHT-WEIGHT FROM LORD , MERCY . PERSON TRANSGRESS AFTER , PUNISH PAIN .

en: But if one fears from the bequeather [some] error or sin and corrects that which is between them [i.e., the concerned parties], there is no sin upon him. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
gloss: [cond: IF FEAR BEQUEST MISTAKE , SIN , FIX BETWEEN] , [neg: SIN NONE] . ALLAH FORGIVE , MERCIFUL .

en: They ask you about wine and gambling. Say, "In them is great sin and [yet, some] benefit for people. But their sin is greater than their benefit." And they ask you what they should spend. Say, "The excess [beyond needs]." Thus Allāh makes clear to you the verses [of revelation] that you might give thought
gloss: THEY ASK YOU ABOUT WINE , GAMBLE . SAY , [rs-a: SIN BIG , SOME BENEFIT PEOPLE . SIN BIGGER THAN BENEFIT] . ASK WHAT SPEND . SAY , [rs-a: MORE THAN NEED] . SAME , ALLAH EXPLAIN VERSE , MAYBE THINK

en: Allāh does not impose blame upon you for what is unintentional in your oaths, but He imposes blame upon you for what your hearts have earned. And Allāh is Forgiving and Forbearing.
gloss: ALLAH [neg: NOT BLAME OATH EMPTY] , BLAME HEART EARN . ALLAH FORGIVE , PATIENT .

en: And those who are taken in death among you and leave wives behind - for their wives is a bequest: maintenance for one year without turning [them] out. But if they leave [of their own accord], then there is no blame upon you for what they do with themselves in an acceptable way. And Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.
gloss: PEOPLE DIE , LEAVE WIFE , BEQUEST WIFE , FOOD ONE YEAR , NOT EXPEL . [cond: IF LEAVE] , [neg: BLAME NONE] THEIR DO FAIR . ALLAH MIGHTY , WISE .

en: He will speak to the people in the cradle and in maturity and will be of the righteous."
gloss: [rs-c: TALK PEOPLE BABY , OLD , RIGHTEOUS] .

en: And He will teach him writing and wisdom and the Torah and the Gospel
gloss: [rs-c: IX TEACH IX WRITE , WISDOM , fs:TAWRAT , fs:INJIL] ,

en: And they [i.e., the disbelievers] planned, but Allāh planned. And Allāh is the best of planners.
gloss: THEY PLAN , ALLAH PLAN . ALLAH BEST PLAN .

en: And whoever invents about Allāh untruth after that - then those are [truly] the wrongdoers.
gloss: PERSON INVENT LIE ABOUT ALLAH AFTER , WRONGDOER .

en: They are [varying] degrees in the sight of Allāh, and Allāh is Seeing of whatever they do.
gloss: LEVEL DIFFERENT WITH ALLAH . ALLAH SEE THEIR DO .

en: That is only Satan who frightens [you] of his supporters. So fear them not, but fear Me, if you are [indeed] believers.
gloss: THAT ONLY DEVIL MAKE AFRAID FRIEND . [neg: NOT FEAR THEM] , FEAR ME , IF BELIEVER .

en: And whoever among you cannot [find] the means to marry free, believing women, then [he may marry] from those whom your right hands possess of believing slave girls. And Allāh is most knowing about your faith. You [believers] are of one another. So marry them with the permission of their people and give them their due compensation [i.e., mahr] according to what is acceptable. [They should be] chaste, neither [of] those who commit unlawful intercourse randomly nor those who take [secret] lovers. But once they are sheltered in marriage, if they should commit adultery, then for them is half the punishment for free [unmarried] women. This [allowance] is for him among you who fears affliction [i.e., sin], but to be patient is better for you. And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
gloss: PERSON CANNOT MARRY FREE BELIEVER WOMAN , MARRY BELIEVER SLAVE WOMAN . ALLAH KNOW BEST YOUR FAITH , YOU FROM EACH-OTHER . MARRY PERMISSION FAMILY , GIVE DOWRY FAIR , CHASTITY , NOT ADULTERY , NOT SECRET FRIEND . [top: MARRIED , DO IMMORALITY] , PUNISH HALF FREE WOMAN . THIS FOR PERSON FEAR SIN . PATIENT BETTER . ALLAH FORGIVE , MERCIFUL .

en: If you avoid the major sins which you are forbidden, We will remove from you your lesser sins and admit you to a noble entrance [into Paradise].
gloss: [cond: IF AVOID SIN BIG FORBID] , WE REMOVE SIN SMALL , ENTER PLACE HONOR .

en: Wherever you may be, death will overtake you, even if you should be within towers of lofty construction. But if good comes to them, they say, "This is from Allāh"; and if evil befalls them, they say, "This is from you." Say, "All [things] are from Allāh." So what is [the matter] with those people that they can hardly understand any statement?
gloss: WHEREVER YOU , DEATH CATCH , EVEN BUILDING HIGH STRONG . [top: GOOD COME] , [rs-b: SAY , FROM ALLAH] . [top: EVIL HIT] , [rs-b: SAY , FROM YOU] . SAY , [rs-a: ALL FROM ALLAH] . [wh: WHAT WRONG THESE PEOPLE , ALMOST NOT UNDERSTAND WORD] ?

en: Whoever intercedes for a good cause will have a share [i.e., reward] therefrom; and whoever intercedes for an evil cause will have a portion [i.e., burden] therefrom. And ever is Allāh, over all things, a Keeper.
gloss: PERSON INTERCEDE GOOD , GET SHARE . PERSON INTERCEDE EVIL , GET PART . ALLAH GUARD ALL THING .

en: [Be warned of] the Day when Allāh will assemble the messengers and say, "What was the response you received?" They will say, "We have no knowledge. Indeed, it is You who is Knower of the unseen" -
gloss: DAY ALLAH GATHER MESSENGER+ , [rs-c: SAY , [wh: PEOPLE ANSWER YOU WHAT]] ? [rs-b: SAY , WE NOT KNOW . YOU KNOW UNSEEN] .

en: And they say, "Why was there not sent down to him an angel?" But if We had sent down an angel, the matter would have been decided; then they would not be reprieved.
gloss: [rs-b: THEY SAY , [wh: WHY ANGEL NOT SEND-DOWN IX]] ? [cond: IF WE SEND-DOWN ANGEL] , MATTER FINISH , NOT DELAY .

en: And [mention, O Muḥammad], the Day We will gather them all together; then We will say to those who associated others with Allāh, "Where are your 'partners' that you used to claim [with Him]?"
gloss: DAY WE GATHER ALL , SAY POLYTHEIST , [rs-c: [wh: WHERE YOUR PARTNER YOU CLAIM]] ?

en: But your people have denied it while it is the truth. Say, "I am not over you a manager [i.e., authority]."
gloss: YOUR PEOPLE DENY , IT TRUE . SAY , [rs-a: ME NOT GUARDIAN OVER YOU] .

en: [They are] eight mates - of the sheep, two and of the goats, two. Say, "Is it the two males He has forbidden or the two females or that which the wombs of the two females contain? Inform me with knowledge, if you should be truthful."
gloss: EIGHT PAIR , SHEEP TWO , GOAT TWO . SAY , [rs-a: [rhq: IX FORBID TWO MAN , TWO WOMAN , OR INSIDE STOMACH] ? TELL ME WITH KNOWLEDGE , IF YOU TRUE] .

en: [Satan] said, "Reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
gloss: [rs-b: IX SAY , DELAY ME UNTIL DAY RESURRECT] .

en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "My Lord has ordered justice and that you direct yourselves [to the Qiblah] at every place [or time] of prostration, and invoke Him, sincere to Him in religion." Just as He originated you, you will return [to life] -
gloss: SAY , [rs-a: MY LORD COMMAND FAIR , FACE EVERY PRAY PLACE , CALL IX , RELIGION SINCERE . SAME IX BEGIN YOU , YOU RETURN] .

en: And do not sit on every path, threatening and averting from the way of Allāh those who believe in Him, seeking to make it [seem] deviant. And remember when you were few and He increased you. And see how was the end of the corrupters.
gloss: [rs-a: NOT SIT EVERY PATH , THREATEN , BLOCK BELIEVER FROM ALLAH PATH , WANT CROOKED . REMEMBER YOU FEW , IX MAKE MANY . LOOK CORRUPT END HOW] .

en: Those who denied Shuʿayb - it was as though they had never resided there. Those who denied Shuʿayb - it was they who were the losers.
gloss: PEOPLE DENY SHUAYB , SAME NEVER LIVE THERE . PEOPLE DENY SHUAYB , THEY LOSER .

en: Said the eminent among the people of Pharaoh, "Indeed, this is a learned magician
gloss: [rs-b: PHARAOH PEOPLE LEADER+ SAY , THIS MAGIC KNOW MUCH] ,

en: Who wants to expel you from your land [through magic], so what do you instruct?"
gloss: [rs-b: WANT EXPEL YOU FROM LAND . [wh: YOU COMMAND WHAT]] ?

en: But when good [i.e., provision] came to them, they said, "This is ours [by right]." And if a bad [condition] struck them, they saw an evil omen in Moses and those with him. Unquestionably, their fortune is with Allāh, but most of them do not know.
gloss: [top: GOOD COME] , [rs-b: SAY , THIS FOR US] . [top: BAD HIT] , BLAME MUSA , PEOPLE WITH IX . [aff: THEIR LUCK WITH ALLAH] . BUT MOST [neg: NOT KNOW] .

en: Indeed, those [worshippers] - destroyed is that in which they are [engaged], and worthless is whatever they were doing."
gloss: [rs-a: THESE , THEIR DO DESTROY , WORK WORTHLESS] .

en: He said, "Is it other than Allāh I should desire for you as a god while He has preferred you over the worlds?"
gloss: [rs-a: [rhq: ME SEEK GOD FOR YOU BESIDES ALLAH , IX FAVOR YOU OVER WORLD]] ?

en: But those who hold fast to the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] and establish prayer - indeed, We will not allow to be lost the reward of the reformers.
gloss: PEOPLE HOLD BOOK , ESTABLISH SALAH , WE [neg: NOT LOSE REWARD FIX PEOPLE] .

en: But Allāh would not punish them while you, [O Muḥammad], are among them, and Allāh would not punish them while they seek forgiveness.
gloss: ALLAH [neg: NOT PUNISH THEM WHILE YOU AMONG] , [neg: NOT PUNISH WHILE ASK FORGIVE] .

en: Had they gone forth with you, they would not have increased you except in confusion, and they would have been active among you, seeking [to cause] you fitnah [i.e., chaos and dissension]. And among you are avid listeners to them. And Allāh is Knowing of the wrongdoers.
gloss: [cond: IF GO WITH YOU] , ADD ONLY CONFUSED , RUSH AMONG YOU , WANT FITNAH . SOME AMONG YOU LISTEN THEM . ALLAH KNOW WRONGDOER .
