en: And among them is he who says, "Permit me [to remain at home] and do not put me to trial." Unquestionably, into trial they have fallen. And indeed, Hell will encompass the disbelievers.
gloss: SOME SAY , [rs-b: ALLOW ME STAY , NOT TEST ME] . [aff: THEY FALL IN TEST] . HELL SURROUND DISBELIEVER .

en: They will swear by Allāh to you when you return to them that you would leave them alone. So leave them alone; indeed they are evil; and their refuge is Hell as recompense for what they had been earning.
gloss: [top: YOU RETURN] , SWEAR ALLAH , YOU LEAVE THEM . LEAVE THEM . THEY DIRTY . HOME HELL , PAY FOR EARN .

en: Take, [O Muḥammad], from their wealth a charity by which you purify them and cause them increase, and invoke [Allāh's blessings] upon them. Indeed, your invocations are reassurance for them. And Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.
gloss: TAKE FROM MONEY CHARITY , MAKE PURE , GROW , ASK BLESS . YOUR DUA PEACE FOR THEM . ALLAH HEAR , KNOW .

en: And when We give the people a taste of mercy after adversity has touched them, at once they conspire against Our verses. Say, "Allāh is swifter in strategy." Indeed, Our messengers [i.e., angels] record that which you conspire.
gloss: [top: WE GIVE PEOPLE TASTE MERCY AFTER HARM] , IMMEDIATELY PLAN AGAINST OUR VERSE . SAY , [rs-a: ALLAH PLAN QUICK] . OUR ANGEL WRITE YOUR PLAN .

en: Indeed, those upon whom the word [i.e., decree] of your Lord has come into effect will not believe,
gloss: PEOPLE LORD WORD TRUE ON , [neg: NOT BELIEVE] ,

en: So do they wait except for like [what occurred in] the days of those who passed on before them? Say, "Then wait; indeed, I am with you among those who wait."
gloss: [rhq: THEY WAIT ONLY SAME DAY+ PEOPLE BEFORE] ? SAY , [rs-a: WAIT , ME WAIT WITH YOU] .

en: Say, "O mankind, the truth has come to you from your Lord, so whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] his soul, and whoever goes astray only goes astray [in violation] against it. And I am not over you a manager."
gloss: SAY , [rs-a: PEOPLE , TRUE COME FROM YOUR LORD . PERSON GUIDE , FOR SELF . PERSON ASTRAY , AGAINST SELF . ME NOT GUARDIAN OVER YOU] .

en: But if We give him a taste of favor after hardship has touched him, he will surely say, "Bad times have left me." Indeed, he is exultant and boastful -
gloss: [cond: IF WE GIVE TASTE FAVOR AFTER HARD] , [rs-b: SAY , BAD GONE FROM ME] . IX HAPPY , BOAST ,

en: He said, "Allāh will only bring it to you if He wills, and you will not cause [Him] failure.
gloss: [rs-a: IX SAY , ALLAH BRING , IF IX WANT . YOU CANNOT ESCAPE] .

en: He said, "If only I had against you some power or could take refuge in a strong support."
gloss: [rs-a: IX SAY , [sad: WISH ME HAVE POWER , OR REFUGE STRONG]] .

en: So when Our command came, We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of layered hard clay, [which were]
gloss: [top: OUR COMMAND COME] , WE TURN CITY UP DOWN , RAIN STONE CLAY LAYER ,

en: As if they had never prospered therein. Then, away with Madyan as Thamūd was taken away.
gloss: SAME NEVER LIVE THERE . [warn: AWAY fs:MADYAN , SAME fs:THAMUD] .

en: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they followed the command of Pharaoh, and the command of Pharaoh was not [at all] discerning.
gloss: TO PHARAOH , LEADER+ . THEY FOLLOW PHARAOH COMMAND . PHARAOH COMMAND NOT RIGHT .

en: And say to those who do not believe, "Work according to your position; indeed, we are working.
gloss: SAY PEOPLE NOT BELIEVE , [rs-a: WORK YOUR WAY , WE WORK] .

en: They said, "O our father, why do you not entrust us with Joseph while indeed, we are to him sincere counselors?
gloss: [rs-c: SAY , OUR FATHER , [wh: WHY YOU NOT TRUST US WITH YUSUF] ? WE SINCERE FOR IX] .

en: They said, "[It is but] a mixture of false dreams, and we are not learned in the interpretation of dreams."
gloss: [rs-c: THEY SAY , DREAM MIX FALSE . WE NOT KNOW EXPLAIN DREAM] .

en: [Jacob] said, "Never will I send him with you until you give me a promise [i.e., oath] by Allāh that you will bring him [back] to me, unless you should be surrounded [i.e., overcome by enemies]." And when they had given their promise, he said, "Allāh, over what we say, is Entrusted."
gloss: [rs-b: YAQUB SAY , ME NEVER SEND IX UNTIL YOU PROMISE ALLAH , YOU BRING IX BACK , UNLESS SURROUND] . [top: THEY PROMISE] , [rs-b: SAY , ALLAH GUARDIAN OUR SAY] .

en: [The brothers] said, "Its recompense is that he in whose bag it is found - he [himself] will be its recompense. Thus do we recompense the wrongdoers."
gloss: [rs-c: THEY SAY , PAY , PERSON BAG FIND , IX PAY . SAME WE PAY WRONGDOER] .

en: So when they entered upon him [i.e., Joseph], they said, "O ʿAzeez, adversity has touched us and our family, and we have come with goods poor in quality, but give us full measure and be charitable to us. Indeed, Allāh rewards the charitable."
gloss: [top: ENTER YUSUF] , [rs-c: SAY , fs:AZIZ , HARM TOUCH US , FAMILY . WE BRING MONEY LITTLE . MEASURE FULL , GIVE CHARITY . ALLAH REWARD CHARITY] .

en: Allāh knows what every female carries and what the wombs lose [prematurely] or exceed. And everything with Him is by due measure.
gloss: ALLAH KNOW EVERY WOMAN CARRY , STOMACH LESS , MORE . EVERYTHING WITH IX MEASURE .

en: For him [i.e., each one] are successive [angels] before and behind him who protect him by the decree of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves. And when Allāh intends for a people ill, there is no repelling it. And there is not for them besides Him any patron.
gloss: ANGEL FRONT , BEHIND , PROTECT IX , ALLAH COMMAND . [aff: ALLAH NOT CHANGE PEOPLE SITUATION UNTIL THEY CHANGE INSIDE SELF] . [top: ALLAH WANT HARM PEOPLE] , [neg: NOBODY STOP] . BESIDES IX , [neg: PROTECTOR NONE] .

en: And to Allāh prostrates whoever is within the heavens and the earth, willingly or by compulsion, and their shadows [as well] in the mornings and the afternoons.
gloss: EVERYONE SKY , EARTH PROSTRATE ALLAH , WILLING OR FORCE , SHADE ALSO , MORNING , EVENING .

en: He sends down from the sky, rain, and valleys flow according to their capacity, and the torrent carries a rising foam. And from that [ore] which they heat in the fire, desiring adornments and utensils, is a foam like it. Thus Allāh presents [the example of] truth and falsehood. As for the foam, it vanishes, [being] cast off; but as for that which benefits the people, it remains on the earth. Thus does Allāh present examples.
gloss: IX SEND-DOWN RAIN , VALLEY FLOW MEASURE , FLOOD CARRY WHITE ON SURFACE . THING THEY BURN FIRE , WANT ADORNMENT , THING USE , WHITE SURFACE SAME . SAME , ALLAH SHOW TRUE , FALSE . WHITE SURFACE DISAPPEAR . THING BENEFIT PEOPLE STAY EARTH . SAME , ALLAH GIVE EXAMPLE .

en: Before him is Hell, and he will be given a drink of purulent water.
gloss: FRONT , HELL , DRINK LIQUID ROTTEN .

en: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples.
gloss: [neg: NOT BELIEVE] . WAY PEOPLE BEFORE ALREADY HAPPEN .

en: And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of Allāh]
gloss: PROTECT FROM EVERY DEVIL EXPEL ,

en: When they entered upon him and said, "Peace." [Abraham] said, "Indeed, we are fearful [i.e., apprehensive] of you."
gloss: [top: THEY ENTER] , [rs-c: SAY , SALAM] . [rs-a: IBRAHIM SAY , WE AFRAID YOU] .

en: And the companions of the thicket [i.e., the people of Madyan] were [also] wrongdoers,
gloss: FOREST COMPANION ALSO WRONGDOER .

en: Who make [equal] with Allāh another deity. But they are going to know.
gloss: MAKE OTHER GOD WITH ALLAH . [warn: LATER KNOW] .

en: They are [in fact] dead, not alive, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected.
gloss: DEAD , NOT ALIVE , [neg: NOT KNOW WHEN RESURRECT] .

en: And your Lord inspired to the bee, "Take for yourself among the mountains, houses [i.e., hives], and among the trees and [in] that which they construct.
gloss: YOUR LORD INSPIRE fs:BEE , [rs-c: MAKE HOME IN MOUNTAIN , TREE , THING PEOPLE BUILD] .

en: And when We substitute a verse in place of a verse - and Allāh is most knowing of what He sends down - they say, "You, [O Muḥammad], are but an inventor [of lies]." But most of them do not know.
gloss: [top: WE CHANGE VERSE FOR VERSE , ALLAH KNOW BEST SEND-DOWN] , [rs-b: THEY SAY , YOU ONLY INVENT] . BUT MOST [neg: NOT KNOW] .

en: [And said], "If you do good, you do good for yourselves; and if you do evil, [you do it] to them [i.e., yourselves]." Then when the final [i.e., second] promise came, [We sent your enemies] to sadden your faces and to enter the masjid [i.e., the temple in Jerusalem], as they entered it the first time, and to destroy what they had taken over with [total] destruction.
gloss: [rs-c: [cond: IF YOU DO GOOD] , FOR SELF . [cond: IF DO EVIL] , AGAINST SELF] . [top: LAST PROMISE COME] , FACE SAD , ENTER MOSQUE SAME FIRST TIME , DESTROY ALL .

en: To each [category] We extend - to these and to those - from the gift of your Lord. And never has the gift of your Lord been restricted.
gloss: EACH , WE GIVE BOTH FROM YOUR LORD GIFT . YOUR LORD GIFT [neg: NOT LIMIT] .

en: All that [i.e., the aforementioned] - its evil is ever, in the sight of your Lord, detested.
gloss: ALL THAT EVIL , YOUR LORD HATE .

en: And We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And when you mention your Lord alone in the Qur’ān, they turn back in aversion.
gloss: WE PUT COVER ON HEART , NOT UNDERSTAND , EAR DEAF . [top: YOU MENTION LORD ALONE IN QURAN] , TURN BACK , DISLIKE .

en: [Allāh] said, "Go, for whoever of them follows you, indeed Hell will be the recompense of [all of] you - an ample recompense.
gloss: [rs-c: ALLAH SAY , GO . PERSON FOLLOW YOU , HELL YOUR PAY , PAY FULL] .

en: And say, "My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance and to exit a sound exit and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority."
gloss: SAY , [rs-a: MY LORD , ENTER ME TRUE ENTER , EXIT ME TRUE EXIT , GIVE ME FROM YOU AUTHORITY HELP] .

en: And nothing has prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them and from asking forgiveness of their Lord except that there [must] befall them the [accustomed] precedent of the former peoples or that the punishment should come [directly] before them.
gloss: [neg: NOTHING STOP PEOPLE BELIEVE] , GUIDE COME , ASK LORD FORGIVE , EXCEPT WAIT SAME PEOPLE BEFORE , OR PUNISH COME FRONT .

en: So when they had passed beyond it, [Moses] said to his boy, "Bring us our morning meal. We have certainly suffered in this, our journey, [much] fatigue."
gloss: [top: PASS] , [rs-a: MUSA SAY SERVANT , BRING OUR FOOD MORNING . OUR TRAVEL TIRED] .

en: So they set out, until when they met a boy, he [i.e., al-Khiḍr] killed him. [Moses] said, "Have you killed a pure soul for other than [having killed] a soul? You have certainly done a deplorable thing."
gloss: GO . [top: MEET BOY] , IX KILL . [rs-a: MUSA SAY , [rhq: YOU KILL SOUL PURE , NOT KILL OTHER] ? YOU DO THING BAD] .

en: But as for one who believes and does righteousness, he will have a reward of the best [i.e., Paradise], and we [i.e., Dhul-Qarnayn] will speak to him from our command with ease."
gloss: [rs-a: PERSON BELIEVE , DO RIGHTEOUS , REWARD BEST . WE TALK IX EASY] .

en: Wherein they abide eternally. They will not desire from it any transfer.
gloss: STAY FOREVER , [neg: NOT WANT MOVE] .

en: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten."
gloss: PAIN BIRTH BRING HER TO DATE-PALM TREE . [rs-b: SAY , [sad: WISH ME DIE BEFORE THIS , FORGOTTEN]] .

en: And warn them, [O Muḥammad], of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded; and [yet], they are in [a state of] heedlessness, and they do not believe.
gloss: WARN THEM DAY REGRET , MATTER FINISH . THEY UNAWARE , NOT BELIEVE .

en: Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise?
gloss: [rhq: IX SEE UNSEEN , OR TAKE PROMISE FROM GRACIOUS] ?

en: They said, "Our Lord, indeed we are afraid that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress."
gloss: [rs-a: THEY SAY , OUR LORD , WE FEAR IX HURRY HURT US , OR TRANSGRESS] .

en: Eat [therefrom] and pasture your livestock. Indeed in that are signs for those of intelligence.
gloss: EAT , FEED ANIMAL . SIGN-PROOF FOR PEOPLE UNDERSTAND .

en: He will say, "My Lord, why have you raised me blind while I was [once] seeing?"
gloss: [rs-b: IX SAY , MY LORD , [wh: WHY YOU GATHER ME BLIND , BEFORE ME SEE]] ?

en: We have certainly sent down to you a Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] in which is your mention. Then will you not reason?
gloss: WE SEND-DOWN YOU BOOK , YOUR REMINDER INSIDE . [rhq: YOU NOT UNDERSTAND] ?

en: And how many a city which was unjust have We shattered and produced after it another people.
gloss: [rhq: HOW-MANY CITY UNJUST WE BREAK , CREATE OTHER PEOPLE AFTER] ?

en: Uff to you and to what you worship instead of Allāh. Then will you not use reason?"
gloss: [rs-a: [warn: UGH YOU , THING YOU WORSHIP BESIDES ALLAH] . [rhq: YOU NOT UNDERSTAND]] ?

en: And of the devils [i.e., jinn] were those who dived for him and did work other than that. And We were of them a guardian.
gloss: SOME DEVIL SWIM DEEP FOR IX , DO OTHER WORK . WE GUARD THEM .

en: Had these [false deities] been [actual] gods, they would not have come to it, but all are eternal therein.
gloss: [cond: IF THESE GOD TRUE] , NOT ENTER . ALL STAY FOREVER .

en: And [We brought forth] a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food [i.e., olives] for those who eat.
gloss: TREE GROW FROM MOUNTAIN fs:SINAI , GIVE OIL , FOOD FOR EAT .

en: And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful.
gloss: PERSON SCALE HEAVY , THEY WIN .

en: And the fifth [oath will be] that the curse of Allāh be upon him if he should be of the liars.
gloss: NUMBER FIVE , ALLAH CURSE ON IX , IF IX LIAR .

en: And the fifth [oath will be] that the wrath of Allāh be upon her if he was of the truthful.
gloss: NUMBER FIVE , ALLAH ANGRY ON HER , IF IX TRUE .

en: And if you do not find anyone therein, do not enter them until permission has been given you. And if it is said to you, "Go back," then go back; it is purer for you. And Allāh is Knowing of what you do.
gloss: [cond: IF NOBODY INSIDE] , [neg: NOT ENTER] UNTIL PERMISSION . [cond: IF SAY GO BACK] , GO BACK , MORE PURE . ALLAH KNOW YOUR DO .

en: Never think that the disbelievers are causing failure [to Allāh] upon the earth. Their refuge will be the Fire - and how wretched the destination.
gloss: [neg: NEVER THINK DISBELIEVER ESCAPE ON EARTH] . HOME FIRE , [warn: DESTINATION WRETCHED] .

en: And We will approach [i.e., regard] what they have done of deeds and make them as dust dispersed.
gloss: WE LOOK THEIR DO , MAKE DUST SCATTER .

en: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,
gloss: GRACIOUS SERVANT WALK EARTH HUMBLE . [top: IGNORANT TALK THEM] , SAY , [happy: SALAM] .

en: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering;
gloss: SAY , [rs-a: OUR LORD , REMOVE FROM US HELL PUNISH . PUNISH STAY FOREVER] .

en: Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence.
gloss: STAY FOREVER . HOME GOOD , PLACE GOOD .

en: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?
gloss: [rhq: THEY NOT LOOK EARTH , HOW-MANY WE GROW EVERY KIND GOOD] ?

en: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."
gloss: [rs-a: THEY BLAME ME SIN , ME FEAR THEY KILL ME] .

en: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me judgement [i.e., wisdom and prophet hood] and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.
gloss: [rs-a: ME FLEE FROM YOU , FEAR . THEN MY LORD GIVE ME WISDOM , MAKE ME MESSENGER] .

en: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.
gloss: [rs-b: PHARAOH SAY LEADER+ AROUND , THIS MAGIC KNOW MUCH] .

en: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.
gloss: PARADISE BRING CLOSE FOR FEAR-GOD .

en: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?
gloss: [rhq: NOT SIGN-PROOF FOR THEM , ISRAIL CHILD KNOWLEDGE PEOPLE KNOW IT] ?

en: Say, "Perhaps it is close behind you [i.e., very near] - some of that for which you are impatient.
gloss: SAY , [rs-a: MAYBE CLOSE BEHIND YOU , SOME THING YOU HURRY] .

en: And she said to his sister, "Follow him"; so she watched him from a distance while they perceived not.
gloss: SHE SAY SISTER , [rs-c: FOLLOW IX] . SISTER WATCH FROM FAR , THEY NOT AWARE .

en: He said, "My Lord, for the favor You bestowed upon me, I will never be an assistant to the criminals."
gloss: [rs-a: MY LORD , BECAUSE YOUR FAVOR ON ME , ME NEVER HELP SINNER] .

en: And We have [repeatedly] conveyed to them the word [i.e., the Qur’ān] that they might be reminded.
gloss: WE CONVEY THEM WORD , MAYBE REMEMBER .

en: But the information will be unapparent to them that Day, so they will not [be able to] ask one another.
gloss: THAT DAY NEWS HIDDEN FROM THEM , [neg: NOT ASK EACH-OTHER] .

en: And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will be in despair.
gloss: DAY HOUR COME , SINNER DESPAIR .

en: [Or] of those who have divided their religion and become sects, every faction rejoicing in what it has.
gloss: PEOPLE DIVIDE RELIGION , BECOME GROUP+ , EACH GROUP HAPPY OWN .

en: Then He proportioned him and breathed into him from His [created] soul and made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful.
gloss: THEN SHAPE IX , BLOW IN IX SPIRIT , GIVE YOU HEAR , SEE , HEART . YOU THANK LITTLE .

en: And rely upon Allāh; and sufficient is Allāh as Disposer of affairs.
gloss: TRUST ALLAH . ALLAH ENOUGH GUARDIAN .

en: The Prophet is more worthy of the believers than themselves, and his wives are [in the position of] their mothers. And those of [blood] relationship are more entitled [to inheritance] in the decree of Allāh than the [other] believers and the emigrants, except that you may do to your close associates a kindness [through bequest]. That was in the Book inscribed.
gloss: PROPHET CLOSER BELIEVER THAN SELF . IX WIFE+ THEIR MOTHER . RELATIVE INHERIT FIRST , ALLAH BOOK , BEFORE OTHER BELIEVER , EMIGRATE , EXCEPT YOU DO KIND FOR FRIEND . THAT WRITE IN BOOK .

en: There the believers were tested and shaken with a severe shaking.
gloss: THERE BELIEVER TEST , SHAKE STRONG .

en: Whether you reveal a thing or conceal it, indeed Allāh is ever, of all things, Knowing.
gloss: YOU SHOW THING OR HIDE , ALLAH KNOW ALL THING .

en: And those who harm believing men and believing women for [something] other than what they have earned [i.e., deserved] have certainly borne upon themselves a slander and manifest sin.
gloss: PEOPLE HURT BELIEVER MAN , WOMAN , WITHOUT REASON , CARRY LIE , SIN CLEAR .

en: [This is] the established way of Allāh with those who passed on before; and you will not find in the way of Allāh any change.
gloss: ALLAH WAY WITH PEOPLE BEFORE . YOU [neg: NEVER FIND ALLAH WAY CHANGE] .

en: Say, "Indeed, my Lord projects the truth, Knower of the unseen."
gloss: SAY , [rs-a: MY LORD THROW TRUE , KNOW UNSEEN] .

en: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register.
gloss: [aff: ALLAH RESURRECT DEAD , WRITE THEIR DO BEFORE , THEIR FOOTSTEPS] . EVERYTHING ALLAH COUNT IN BOOK CLEAR .

en: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.
gloss: [sad: WOE SERVANT] . [neg: MESSENGER COME , THEY ALWAYS MOCK] .

en: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship.
gloss: SIGN-PROOF FOR THEM , ALLAH CARRY THEIR CHILD IN SHIP FULL .

en: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.
gloss: THEY , THEIR WIFE , IN SHADE , SIT COUCH .

en: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.
gloss: [neg: NOT LET THEIR WORD MAKE YOU SAD] . ALLAH KNOW HIDE , SHOW .

en: Then inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created them [i.e., men] from sticky clay.
gloss: ASK THEM , [rhq: THEY HARD CREATE , OR OTHER WE CREATE] ? WE CREATE THEM FROM CLAY STICK .

en: Rather, he [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.
gloss: NO , IX BRING TRUE , CONFIRM MESSENGER BEFORE .

en: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,
gloss: PASS AROUND CUP FROM SPRING FLOW ,

en: Is that [i.e., Paradise] a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqūm?
gloss: [rhq: THIS BETTER , OR TREE fs:ZAQQUM] ?

en: So inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?
gloss: ASK THEM , [rhq: YOUR LORD HAVE DAUGHTER , THEY HAVE SON] ?

en: And Our word [i.e., decree] has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,
gloss: OUR WORD BEFORE , FOR OUR SERVANT MESSENGER ,

en: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.
gloss: GARDEN FOREVER , DOOR OPEN FOR THEM .

en: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age.
gloss: WITH THEM WOMAN EYE LOOK-DOWN , AGE SAME .

en: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.
gloss: THIS , LET TASTE , WATER BOIL , ROTTEN LIQUID ,

en: Indeed, that is truth [i.e., reality] - the quarreling of the people of the Fire.
gloss: THAT TRUE , FIRE PEOPLE ARGUE .

en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I do not ask you for it [i.e., the Qur’ān] any payment, and I am not of the pretentious.
gloss: SAY , [rs-a: ME NOT ASK YOU PAYMENT . ME NOT PRETEND] .

en: To whom will come a torment disgracing him and on whom will descend an enduring punishment."
gloss: [rs-a: WHO GET PUNISH SHAME , WHO GET PUNISH FOREVER] .

en: Or [lest] it say when it sees the punishment, "If only I had another turn so I could be among the doers of good."
gloss: [rs-b: OR SEE PUNISH , SAY , [cond: IF ME GO BACK] , ME DO GOOD] .

en: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? They were more numerous than themselves and greater in strength and in impression on the land, but they were not availed by what they used to earn.
gloss: [rhq: THEY NOT TRAVEL LAND , LOOK PEOPLE BEFORE , END HOW] ? BEFORE MANY MORE , STRONGER , MARK LAND MORE . BUT THEIR EARN NOT HELP .

en: And He placed on it [i.e., the earth] firmly set mountains over its surface, and He blessed it and determined therein its [creatures'] sustenance in four days without distinction - for [the information of] those who ask.
gloss: IX PUT MOUNTAIN FIRM , BLESS EARTH , MEASURE FOOD FOUR DAY , EQUAL FOR PEOPLE ASK .

en: Thus has He revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and to those before you - Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
gloss: SAME , ALLAH REVEAL TO YOU , TO PEOPLE BEFORE . ALLAH POWER , WISE .

en: And whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters [worthy] of resolve.
gloss: [aff: PERSON PATIENT , FORGIVE , THAT STRONG DETERMINE] .

en: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons?
gloss: [rhq: ALLAH TAKE DAUGHTER FROM CREATION , GIVE YOU SON] ?

en: So We took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.
gloss: ALLAH PUNISH THEM . SEE RESULT DENIER HOW .

en: And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers], We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount.
gloss: [cond: IF NOT PEOPLE BECOME ONE NATION] , ALLAH MAKE FOR DISBELIEVER HOUSE ROOF SILVER , STAIRS CLIMB ,

en: And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them.
gloss: [cond: IF ALLAH TAKE YOU AWAY] , ALLAH PUNISH THEM ,

en: Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability.
gloss: OR SHOW YOU PROMISE . ALLAH CAN .

en: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?"
gloss: [rs-b: WHY NOT BRACELET GOLD , ANGEL COME WITH IX] ?

en: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another] on the earth.
gloss: [cond: IF ALLAH WANT] , MAKE ANGEL FROM YOU , SUCCESSOR ON EARTH .

en: So turn aside from them and say, "Peace." But they are going to know.
gloss: SO TURN-AWAY THEM , SAY , PEACE . FUTURE THEY KNOW .

en: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allāh. Indeed, I have come to you with clear evidence.
gloss: [rs-a: NOT PROUD AGAINST ALLAH . ME BRING PROOF CLEAR] .

en: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.
gloss: IX CALL LORD , [rs-a: THESE PEOPLE SINNER] .

en: [Allāh said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.
gloss: [rs-c: TRAVEL NIGHT WITH MY SERVANT . THEY FOLLOW YOU] .

en: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.
gloss: ASK EVERY FRUIT , SAFE .

en: And when it was said, 'Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth and the Hour [is coming] - no doubt about it,' you said, 'We know not what is the Hour. We assume only assumption, and we are not convinced.'"
gloss: [top: WHEN TELL , ALLAH PROMISE TRUE , HOUR NOT DOUBT] , [rs-b: YOU SAY , WE NOT KNOW HOUR , WE THINK GUESS , NOT SURE] .

en: Those are the companions of Paradise, abiding eternally therein as reward for what they used to do.
gloss: THOSE PEOPLE GARDEN , STAY FOREVER , REWARD THEIR DO .

en: But he who does not respond to the Caller of Allāh will not cause failure [to Him] upon earth, and he will not have besides Him any protectors. Those are in manifest error."
gloss: [rs-b: PERSON NOT ANSWER ALLAH CALLER , CAN NOT ESCAPE ON EARTH , NOT PROTECTOR . THOSE ASTRAY CLEAR] .

en: Those [who do so] are the ones that Allāh has cursed, so He deafened them and blinded their vision.
gloss: THOSE ALLAH CURSE , MAKE DEAF , BLIND .

en: That is because they followed what angered Allāh and disliked [what earns] His pleasure, so He rendered worthless their deeds.
gloss: BECAUSE FOLLOW THING ALLAH ANGRY , HATE ALLAH PLEASED . SO DO LOST .

en: [This is] the established way of Allāh which has occurred before. And never will you find in the way of Allāh any change.
gloss: ALLAH WAY BEFORE . [neg: YOU NOT FIND ALLAH WAY CHANGE] .

en: Indeed, those who call you, [O Muḥammad], from behind the chambers - most of them do not use reason.
gloss: PEOPLE CALL YOU FROM BEHIND ROOM , MOST NOT USE MIND .

en: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.
gloss: [rhq: ALLAH TIRED FIRST CREATION] ? NO , THEY DOUBT NEW CREATION .

en: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.
gloss: TRUMPET BLOW . THAT DAY PROMISE .

en: [Allāh] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the threat [i.e., warning].
gloss: [rs-c: ALLAH SAY , NOT ARGUE BEFORE ME . ME ALREADY WARN YOU] .

en: The word [i.e., decree] will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."
gloss: [rs-c: MY WORD NOT CHANGE . ME NOT OPPRESS SERVANT] .

en: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allāh] and keeper [of His covenant].
gloss: [rs-c: THIS PROMISE FOR EVERY PERSON RETURN , KEEP] ,

en: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].
gloss: [aff: IN THIS , REMINDER FOR PERSON HAVE HEART , LISTEN , WITNESS] .

en: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration [i.e., prayer].
gloss: NIGHT SUBHANALLAH , AFTER PROSTRATE .
